level_description: Intermediate level, understanding main points and producing simple connected text.

translation.en: The department at a university or college that deals with applications for enrollment.
translation.uz: Universitet yoki kollejda qabul arizalari bilan shug'ullanadigan bo'lim.
translation.ru: Отдел в университете или колледже, занимающийся заявлениями на поступление.

example: You should contact the admissions office for information on how to apply.
The admissions office reviews thousands of applications each year.
I went to the admissions office to ask about financial aid options.

quiz.correct_answer: The department at a university or college that deals with applications for enrollment.

en: The place where students pick up their course materials or textbooks.
A specific room where exams are held for all university courses.
The library section dedicated to research and academic publications.
uz: Talabalar o'quv materiallari yoki darsliklarini oladigan joy.
Barcha universitet kurslari uchun imtihonlar o'tkaziladigan maxsus xona.
Kutubxonaning tadqiqot va ilmiy nashrlarga bag'ishlangan bo'limi.
ru: Место, где студенты забирают свои учебные материалы или учебники.
Специальная комната, где проводятся экзамены по всем университетским курсам.
Раздел библиотеки, посвященный исследованиям и академическим публикациям.

translation.en: A task or piece of work allocated to someone as part of a course of study.
translation.uz: O'quv kursi doirasida kimnidir tayinlangan vazifa yoki ish bo'lagi.
translation.ru: Задание или часть работы, выделенные кому-либо в рамках учебного курса.

example: We have a major assignment due next week.
She spent all evening working on her history assignment.
The professor gave us a challenging assignment on critical thinking.

quiz.correct_answer: A task or piece of work allocated to someone as part of a course of study.

en: A period of time taken off from academic studies or work.
A social gathering for students and faculty members.
A short, informal discussion among classmates during a lecture.
uz: Akademik o'qish yoki ishdan bo'sh vaqt.
Talabalar va o'qituvchilar uchun ijtimoiy tadbir.
Ma'ruza davomida sinfdoshlar o'rtasida qisqa, norasmiy muhokama.
ru: Период времени, взятый для отдыха от академических занятий или работы.
Общественное собрание для студентов и преподавателей.
Короткое, неформальное обсуждение между одноклассниками во время лекции.

translation.en: A first university degree, typically lasting three or four years.
translation.uz: Birinchi universitet darajasi, odatda uch yoki to'rt yil davom etadi.
translation.ru: Первая университетская степень, обычно продолжительностью три или четыре года.

example: He earned his bachelor's degree in economics.
Many jobs require at least a bachelor's degree.
She is currently pursuing a bachelor's degree in psychology.

quiz.correct_answer: A first university degree, typically lasting three or four years.

en: A short diploma course completed in less than one year.
A postgraduate qualification obtained after a master's degree.
A certification for vocational training in a specific trade.
uz: Bir yildan kamroq muddatda yakunlanadigan qisqa diplom kursi.
Magistratura darajasidan keyin olingan aspirantura malakasi.
Muayyan kasbiy ta'lim uchun sertifikat.
ru: Короткий дипломный курс, завершенный менее чем за один год.
Квалификация последипломного образования, полученная после степени магистра.
Сертификация для профессионального обучения по определенной специальности.

translation.en: The grounds and buildings of a university, college, or school.
translation.uz: Universitet, kollej yoki maktabning hududi va binolari.
translation.ru: Территория и здания университета, колледжа или школы.

example: The university campus is very beautiful.
Students live in dorms on campus.
The new library building is located in the center of campus.

quiz.correct_answer: The grounds and buildings of a university, college, or school.

en: A small classroom used for private tutoring sessions.
A local public park popular among students for relaxation.
An off-campus apartment complex for student housing.
uz: Shaxsiy repetitorlik mashg'ulotlari uchun ishlatiladigan kichik sinf xonasi.
Talabalar orasida dam olish uchun mashhur bo'lgan mahalliy jamoat parki.
Talabalar turar joyi uchun universitetdan tashqaridagi kvartira majmuasi.
ru: Небольшой класс, используемый для частных занятий с репетитором.
Местный общественный парк, популярный среди студентов для отдыха.
Комплекс апартаментов за пределами кампуса для проживания студентов.

translation.en: Written or practical work done by a student during a course, assessed as part of the final grade.
translation.uz: Kurs davomida talaba tomonidan bajariladigan yozma yoki amaliy ish, yakuniy bahoning bir qismi sifatida baholanadi.
translation.ru: Письменная или практическая работа, выполняемая студентом во время курса, оцениваемая как часть итоговой оценки.

example: My final grade depends heavily on coursework.
He found the coursework challenging but rewarding.
Make sure to submit all coursework on time.

quiz.correct_answer: Written or practical work done by a student during a course, assessed as part of the final grade.

en: A list of recommended books for leisure reading.
Activities that students participate in outside of regular classes.
The formal lectures delivered by professors in a large hall.
uz: Bo'sh vaqtni o'qish uchun tavsiya etilgan kitoblar ro'yxati.
Talabalar oddiy darslardan tashqari ishtirok etadigan tadbirlar.
Professorlar tomonidan katta zalda o'tkaziladigan rasmiy ma'ruzalar.
ru: Список рекомендованных книг для досуга.
Мероприятия, в которых студенты участвуют вне обычных занятий.
Официальные лекции, читаемые профессорами в большом зале.

translation.en: A senior official in a college or university, often in charge of a faculty or department.
translation.uz: Kollej yoki universitetdagi katta mansabdor shaxs, ko'pincha fakultet yoki bo'lim boshlig'i.
translation.ru: Старший должностное лицо в колледже или университете, часто отвечающий за факультет или кафедру.

example: The Dean of Students handles disciplinary issues.
She met with the Dean to discuss her academic progress.
The Dean announced new policies for the upcoming semester.

quiz.correct_answer: A senior official in a college or university, often in charge of a faculty or department.

en: A student who has just started their first year of studies.
A junior faculty member responsible for teaching entry-level classes.
A person responsible for maintaining the university grounds.
uz: O'qishning birinchi yilini yangi boshlagan talaba.
Boshlang'ich darslarni o'qitish uchun mas'ul bo'lgan kichik o'qituvchi.
Universitet hududini saqlash uchun mas'ul shaxs.
ru: Студент, который только что начал свой первый год обучения.
Младший преподаватель, ответственный за преподавание вводных курсов.
Человек, отвечающий за содержание территории университета.

translation.en: A large bedroom for a number of people in a school or institution.
translation.uz: Maktab yoki muassasada bir nechta odam uchun katta yotoqxona.
translation.ru: Большая спальня для нескольких человек в школе или учреждении.

example: Many first-year students live in the dorms.
My dormitory room was quite small but cozy.
They organized a social event in the common area of the dormitory.

quiz.correct_answer: A large bedroom for a number of people in a school or institution.

en: A specialized laboratory for scientific experiments at a university.
A building containing only lecture halls and administrative offices.
A cafeteria or dining hall serving meals to students on campus.
uz: Universitetda ilmiy tajribalar uchun ixtisoslashgan laboratoriya.
Faqat ma'ruza zallari va ma'muriy ofislarni o'z ichiga olgan bino.
Talabalarga kampusda ovqat xizmat ko'rsatadigan oshxona yoki ovqatlanish zali.
ru: Специализированная лаборатория для научных экспериментов в университете.
Здание, содержащее только лекционные залы и административные кабинеты.
Кафетерий или столовая, где подают еду студентам на территории кампуса.

translation.en: A course that a student can choose to take, not a required one.
translation.uz: Talaba tanlashi mumkin bo'lgan kurs, majburiy emas.
translation.ru: Курс, который студент может выбрать для изучения, не обязательный.

example: I chose photography as my elective this semester.
Students must complete two electives to graduate.
Are there any interesting electives offered in the arts department?

quiz.correct_answer: A course that a student can choose to take, not a required one.

en: A mandatory course that all students must complete to graduate.
A seminar focused on advanced research methods in a specific field.
A short workshop designed to improve practical skills in a subject.
uz: Barcha talabalar bitirish uchun tugallashi kerak bo'lgan majburiy kurs.
Muayyan sohadagi ilg'or tadqiqot usullariga bag'ishlangan seminar.
Mavzudagi amaliy ko'nikmalarni oshirish uchun mo'ljallangan qisqa seminar.
ru: Обязательный курс, который все студенты должны пройти для получения диплома.
Семинар, посвященный передовым методам исследования в конкретной области.
Короткий семинар, предназначенный для улучшения практических навыков по предмету.

translation.en: The act of officially registering for a course, school, or program.
translation.uz: Kurs, maktab yoki dasturga rasman ro'yxatdan o'tish harakati.
translation.ru: Действие по официальной регистрации на курс, в школу или программу.

example: Enrollment for the new semester opens next week.
The university saw a record increase in enrollment this year.
Late enrollment may result in additional fees.

quiz.correct_answer: The act of officially registering for a course, school, or program.

en: The process of withdrawing from a class before the deadline.
A ceremony where students receive their academic degrees.
The completion of all required assignments for a specific course.
uz: Muddat tugashidan oldin darsdan chiqib ketish jarayoni.
Talabalar o'z akademik darajalarini oladigan marosim.
Muayyan kurs uchun barcha talab qilinadigan topshiriqlarni yakunlash.
ru: Процесс отзыва из класса до установленного срока.
Церемония, на которой студенты получают свои ученые степени.
Завершение всех обязательных заданий по конкретному курсу.

translation.en: A group of departments in a university or college, or the teaching staff.
translation.uz: Universitet yoki kollejdagi bo'limlar guruhi yoki o'qituvchilar tarkibi.
translation.ru: Группа кафедр в университете или колледже, или преподавательский состав.

example: The Faculty of Arts offers many different courses.
She is a new member of the history faculty.
The faculty meeting will discuss changes to the curriculum.

quiz.correct_answer: A group of departments in a university or college, or the teaching staff.

en: The main administrative building where student records are kept.
A student organization that plans social events on campus.
A specific academic discipline, like mathematics or literature.
uz: Talabalik hujjatlari saqlanadigan asosiy ma'muriy bino.
Kampusda ijtimoiy tadbirlarni rejalashtiradigan talabalar tashkiloti.
Matematika yoki adabiyot kabi o'ziga xos akademik fan.
ru: Главное административное здание, где хранятся студенческие записи.
Студенческая организация, которая планирует социальные мероприятия на территории кампуса.
Конкретная академическая дисциплина, такая как математика или литература.

translation.en: To complete a course of study at a school, college, or university.
translation.uz: Maktab, kollej yoki universitetda o'quv kursini tugatish.
translation.ru: Завершить курс обучения в школе, колледже или университете.

example: My sister is going to graduate next year.
He graduated with honors from a prestigious university.
After I graduate, I plan to travel abroad for a year.

quiz.correct_answer: To complete a course of study at a school, college, or university.

en: To apply for financial aid to cover educational expenses.
To temporarily suspend your studies for personal reasons.
To transfer from one academic program to another within a university.
uz: Ta'lim xarajatlarini qoplash uchun moliyaviy yordam so'rash.
Shaxsiy sabablarga ko'ra o'qishni vaqtincha to'xtatib turish.
Universitet ichida bir akademik dasturdan boshqasiga o'tish.
ru: Подать заявку на финансовую помощь для покрытия расходов на образование.
Временно приостановить обучение по личным причинам.
Перевестись из одной академической программы в другую в рамках университета.

translation.en: A period of work experience offered by an organization for a limited period of time.
translation.uz: Tashkilot tomonidan cheklangan muddatga taklif etiladigan ish tajribasi davri.
translation.ru: Период стажировки, предлагаемый организацией на ограниченный период времени.

example: She completed an internship at a law firm last summer.
An internship can be a great way to gain practical experience.
Many companies offer paid internships to university students.

quiz.correct_answer: A period of work experience offered by an organization for a limited period of time.

en: A full-time, permanent job with a high level of responsibility.
A short training seminar focused on theoretical knowledge.
A long-term volunteer position without any financial compensation.
uz: Yuqori mas'uliyatli to'liq stavkali, doimiy ish.
Nazariy bilimlarga qaratilgan qisqa muddatli o'quv seminari.
Moliyaviy kompensatsiyasiz uzoq muddatli ko'ngilli lavozimi.
ru: Постоянная работа на полный рабочий день с высоким уровнем ответственности.
Короткий обучающий семинар, посвященный теоретическим знаниям.
Долгосрочная волонтерская позиция без финансовой компенсации.

translation.en: A postgraduate academic degree awarded by universities.
translation.uz: Universitetlar tomonidan beriladigan magistrlik darajasi.
translation.ru: Академическая степень магистра, присуждаемая университетами.

example: He decided to pursue a master's degree after his bachelor's.
A master's degree often opens up more career opportunities.
Her master's thesis focused on environmental policy.

quiz.correct_answer: A postgraduate academic degree awarded by universities.

en: The initial degree that students earn after high school.
A professional certification for a specific vocational skill.
A short-term course designed for personal enrichment, not a degree.
uz: O'rta maktabdan keyin talabalar oladigan dastlabki daraja.
Muayyan kasbiy ko'nikma uchun professional sertifikat.
Shaxsiy boyitish uchun mo'ljallangan qisqa muddatli kurs, daraja emas.
ru: Первоначальная степень, которую студенты получают после окончания средней школы.
Профессиональная сертификация для конкретного профессионального навыка.
Краткосрочный курс, предназначенный для личного обогащения, а не для получения степени.

translation.en: A teacher of the highest rank in a university or college.
translation.uz: Universitet yoki kollejdagi eng yuqori martabali o'qituvchi.
translation.ru: Преподаватель высшего ранга в университете или колледже.

example: Professor Smith teaches advanced physics.
Many students admire their favorite professor.
The professor published a new research paper last month.

quiz.correct_answer: A teacher of the highest rank in a university or college.

en: A student who assists with administrative tasks at school.
A librarian who helps students find books and resources.
A guest speaker invited to give a single lecture.
uz: Maktabda ma'muriy ishlarga yordam beradigan talaba.
Talabalarga kitob va resurslar topishda yordam beradigan kutubxonachi.
Yagona ma'ruza o'qishga taklif qilingan mehmon ma'ruzachi.
ru: Студент, который помогает с административными задачами в школе.
Библиотекарь, который помогает студентам найти книги и ресурсы.
Приглашенный докладчик, приглашенный для чтения одной лекции.

translation.en: An amount of money given by a school, university, or organization to a student to help pay for their studies.
translation.uz: Maktab, universitet yoki tashkilot tomonidan talabaga o'qishi uchun to'lashga yordam berish uchun beriladigan pul miqdori.
translation.ru: Сумма денег, предоставляемая школой, университетом или организацией студенту для оплаты его обучения.

example: She received a scholarship to study abroad.
Applying for scholarships can significantly reduce educational costs.
The university offers various scholarships based on academic merit.

quiz.correct_answer: An amount of money given by a school, university, or organization to a student to help pay for their studies.

en: A loan that students must repay with interest after graduation.
A monthly payment from parents to support their child's education.
Money earned by a student through part-time employment during studies.
uz: Talabalar bitirgandan keyin foizlar bilan qaytarishi kerak bo'lgan kredit.
Bolaning ta'limini qo'llab-quvvatlash uchun ota-onalardan olinadigan oylik to'lov.
O'qish davomida talaba tomonidan yarim stavkali ishdan topilgan pul.
ru: Кредит, который студенты должны погасить с процентами после окончания учебы.
Ежемесячная выплата от родителей для поддержки образования их ребенка.
Деньги, заработанные студентом на неполной занятости во время учебы.

translation.en: A half-year term in a school or university.
translation.uz: Maktab yoki universitetda yarim yillik muddat.
translation.ru: Полугодовой семестр в школе или университете.

example: This semester, I'm taking five courses.
Exams are held at the end of each semester.
The spring semester begins in January.

quiz.correct_answer: A half-year term in a school or university.

en: A short break between classes on a typical school day.
The entire duration of a bachelor's degree program.
A one-week holiday period during the academic year.
uz: Oddiy o'quv kunida darslar orasidagi qisqa tanaffus.
Bakalavr darajasi dasturining butun davomiyligi.
O'quv yili davomida bir haftalik ta'til davri.
ru: Короткий перерыв между занятиями в обычный учебный день.
Вся продолжительность программы бакалавриата.
Период недельных каникул в течение учебного года.

translation.en: Money borrowed by a student from a bank or government to pay for their education, which must be repaid.
translation.uz: Talaba tomonidan bank yoki hukumatdan o'qishi uchun olingan pul, bu qaytarilishi kerak.
translation.ru: Деньги, взятые студентом в долг у банка или правительства для оплаты образования, которые должны быть возвращены.

example: Many students rely on student loans to finance their studies.
Managing student loan debt can be challenging after graduation.
He's trying to pay off his student loan as quickly as possible.

quiz.correct_answer: Money borrowed by a student from a bank or government to pay for their education, which must be repaid.

en: Financial aid given to students that does not need to be paid back.
Money provided by parents to cover their child's living expenses.
Funds received from working a part-time job while attending school.
uz: Talabalarga qaytarilishi shart bo'lmagan moliyaviy yordam.
Bolaning yashash xarajatlarini qoplash uchun ota-onalar tomonidan beriladigan pul.
Maktabda o'qiyotganda yarim kunlik ishdan olingan mablag'lar.
ru: Финансовая помощь, предоставляемая студентам, которую не нужно возвращать.
Деньги, предоставляемые родителями для покрытия расходов на проживание их ребенка.
Средства, полученные от работы неполный рабочий день во время учебы.

translation.en: A long essay or dissertation involving personal research, written by a candidate for a university degree.
translation.uz: Universitet darajasi uchun nomzod tomonidan yozilgan shaxsiy tadqiqotni o'z ichiga olgan uzun insho yoki dissertatsiya.
translation.ru: Длинное эссе или диссертация, включающая личное исследование, написанная кандидатом на университетскую степень.

example: She dedicated two years to her master's thesis.
His thesis explored the impact of social media on politics.
Students must defend their thesis before a panel of professors.

quiz.correct_answer: A long essay or dissertation involving personal research, written by a candidate for a university degree.

en: A short informal paper written as a weekly class assignment.
A summary of a textbook chapter assigned for reading.
A list of academic goals set by a student for a particular course.
uz: Haftalik dars topshirig'i sifatida yozilgan qisqa norasmiy ish.
O'qish uchun berilgan darslik bobining qisqacha mazmuni.
Talaba tomonidan ma'lum bir kurs uchun belgilangan akademik maqsadlar ro'yxati.
ru: Короткая неформальная работа, написанная в качестве еженедельного классного задания.
Краткое изложение главы учебника, предназначенной для чтения.
Список академических целей, установленных студентом для конкретного курса.

translation.en: A period of instruction given by a university or college tutor to an individual or small group.
translation.uz: Universitet yoki kollej o'qituvchisi tomonidan shaxsga yoki kichik guruhga beriladigan o'qitish davri.
translation.ru: Период обучения, проводимый преподавателем университета или колледжа для одного человека или небольшой группы.

example: I have a weekly tutorial with my English literature tutor.
Tutorials provide a great opportunity for personalized feedback.
Make sure to prepare your questions for the tutorial session.

quiz.correct_answer: A period of instruction given by a university or college tutor to an individual or small group.

en: A large lecture delivered to hundreds of students in an auditorium.
A formal examination taken at the end of an academic semester.
A self-study guide for learning a new language independently.
uz: Auditoriyada yuzlab talabalarga o'qitiladigan katta ma'ruza.
Akademik semestr oxirida olinadigan rasmiy imtihon.
Yangi tilni mustaqil o'rganish uchun o'z-o'zini o'rganish qo'llanmasi.
ru: Большая лекция, читаемая сотням студентов в аудитории.
Формальный экзамен, сдаваемый в конце академического семестра.
Руководство для самостоятельного изучения нового языка.

translation.en: A person who applies for a job or a position.
translation.uz: Ish yoki lavozimga ariza beruvchi shaxs.
translation.ru: Человек, который подает заявление на работу или должность.

example: We received many applications for the job, but only a few qualified applicants.
Each applicant was asked to provide a detailed résumé and cover letter.
The company will interview the most promising applicants next week.

quiz.correct_answer: A person who applies for a job or a position.

en: Someone who is currently employed by a company or organization.
An individual who conducts job interviews for potential hires.
A manager responsible for overseeing a team of employees.
uz: Hozirda kompaniya yoki tashkilotda ishlaydigan shaxs.
Potentsial ishchilarni ishga qabul qilish uchun suhbatlar o'tkazadigan shaxs.
Xodimlar jamoasini nazorat qilish uchun mas'ul menejer.
ru: Человек, который в настоящее время работает в компании или организации.
Человек, проводящий собеседования с потенциальными сотрудниками.
Менеджер, ответственный за надзор за командой сотрудников.

translation.en: To make a formal request, typically in writing, for a job, course, or permission.
translation.uz: Ish, kurs yoki ruxsat uchun rasmiy so'rov yuborish, odatda yozma ravishda.
translation.ru: Сделать официальный запрос, обычно в письменной форме, на работу, курс или разрешение.

example: I'm going to apply for that marketing job.
You need to apply for the visa before you travel.
Many students apply for financial aid to support their studies.

quiz.correct_answer: To make a formal request, typically in writing, for a job, course, or permission.

en: To receive a promotion to a higher position within a company.
To reject a job offer because it doesn't meet your expectations.
To conduct an interview with a candidate for an open vacancy.
uz: Kompaniya ichida yuqori lavozimga ko'tarilish.
Ish taklifini rad etish, chunki u sizning kutganingizni qondirmaydi.
Ochiq lavozimga nomzod bilan suhbat o'tkazish.
ru: Получить повышение на более высокую должность в компании.
Отклонить предложение о работе, потому что оно не соответствует вашим ожиданиям.
Провести собеседование с кандидатом на открытую вакансию.

translation.en: The progression of jobs one holds over time, often in a particular field.
translation.uz: Vaqt o'tishi bilan egallagan ish joylari rivojlanishi, ko'pincha ma'lum bir sohada.
translation.ru: Прогрессия должностей, которые человек занимает с течением времени, часто в определенной области.

example: She's planning her career path carefully.
Many people change their career path several times in their lives.
His career path led him from an entry-level position to a CEO role.

quiz.correct_answer: The progression of jobs one holds over time, often in a particular field.

en: A single, specific job that someone holds for a short period.
A training program designed to prepare individuals for a new role.
The salary and benefits package associated with a particular job.
uz: Kimdir qisqa vaqt davomida egallab turgan bitta, aniq ish.
Shaxslarni yangi rolga tayyorlash uchun mo'ljallangan o'quv dasturi.
Ma'lum bir ish bilan bog'liq bo'lgan maosh va imtiyozlar paketi.
ru: Одна конкретная работа, которую кто-то занимает в течение короткого периода.
Программа обучения, предназначенная для подготовки людей к новой роли.
Пакет зарплаты и льгот, связанных с конкретной работой.

translation.en: A formal and legally binding agreement between two or more parties.
translation.uz: Ikki yoki undan ortiq tomonlar o'rtasidagi rasmiy va qonuniy kuchga ega kelishuv.
translation.ru: Официальное и юридически обязывающее соглашение между двумя или более сторонами.

example: Read your employment contract carefully before signing.
The company offered him a two-year contract.
Breaching the contract could lead to serious legal consequences.

quiz.correct_answer: A formal and legally binding agreement between two or more parties.

en: A brief, informal discussion about job responsibilities.
A company's annual report detailing its financial performance.
A list of professional references provided by a job seeker.
uz: Ish vazifalari haqida qisqa, norasmiy muhokama.
Kompaniyaning moliyaviy faoliyati tafsilotlari ko'rsatilgan yillik hisobot.
Ish qidiruvchi tomonidan taqdim etilgan kasbiy tavsiyalar ro'yxati.
ru: Краткое неформальное обсуждение должностных обязанностей.
Ежегодный отчет компании, подробно описывающий ее финансовые показатели.
Список профессиональных рекомендаций, предоставленных соискателем.

translation.en: A detailed written account of your education, qualifications, and previous occupations.
translation.uz: Ta'limingiz, malakangiz va oldingi kasblaringiz haqida batafsil yozma hisobot.
translation.ru: Подробное письменное описание вашего образования, квалификации и предыдущих занятий.

example: My CV includes all my academic achievements and work experience.
For academic positions, a detailed CV is usually required.
He updated his CV before applying for the research grant.

quiz.correct_answer: A detailed written account of your education, qualifications, and previous occupations.

en: A short summary of a job interview discussion with a candidate.
A formal letter written by a manager to dismiss an employee.
A brief document listing only personal interests and hobbies.
uz: Nomzod bilan ish suhbati muhokamasining qisqacha xulosasi.
Menejer tomonidan xodimni ishdan bo'shatish uchun yozilgan rasmiy xat.
Faqat shaxsiy qiziqishlar va hobbilarni ko'rsatadigan qisqa hujjat.
ru: Краткое изложение результатов собеседования с кандидатом.
Официальное письмо, написанное менеджером для увольнения сотрудника.
Краткий документ, содержащий только личные интересы и хобби.

translation.en: To officially remove someone from their job, typically because of poor performance or misconduct.
translation.uz: Kimnidir ishidan rasman chetlatish, odatda yomon ishlashi yoki noto'g'ri xatti-harakati tufayli.
translation.ru: Официально уволить кого-либо с работы, как правило, из-за плохой работы или неправомерного поведения.

example: The company decided to dismiss him for insubordination.
She was dismissed from her position due to budget cuts.
Employees can be dismissed for serious breaches of company policy.

quiz.correct_answer: To officially remove someone from their job, typically because of poor performance or misconduct.

en: To give an employee a promotion to a more senior role.
To offer a new employee a training program or mentorship.
To provide positive feedback on an employee's excellent work.
uz: Xodimni yuqori lavozimga ko'tarish.
Yangi xodimga o'quv dasturi yoki murabbiylikni taklif qilish.
Xodimning a'lo ishi haqida ijobiy fikr bildirish.
ru: Повысить сотрудника до более высокой должности.
Предложить новому сотруднику программу обучения или наставничества.
Дать положительный отзыв об отличной работе сотрудника.

translation.en: A person employed for wages or salary, especially at non-executive level.
translation.uz: Ish haqi yoki maosh uchun ishlaydigan shaxs, ayniqsa ijrochi bo'lmagan darajada.
translation.ru: Человек, работающий за заработную плату или оклад, особенно на неисполнительном уровне.

example: The company has over 500 employees worldwide.
Every employee receives health insurance benefits.
New employees undergo a thorough orientation program.

quiz.correct_answer: A person employed for wages or salary, especially at non-executive level.

en: An individual who hires and manages staff within a business.
A consultant who provides expert advice to multiple companies.
The owner or founder of a company or small business.
uz: Biznesda xodimlarni ishga oladigan va boshqaradigan shaxs.
Bir nechta kompaniyalarga ekspert maslahatlarni taqdim etadigan konsultant.
Kompaniya yoki kichik biznesning egasi yoki asoschisi.
ru: Человек, который нанимает и управляет персоналом в бизнесе.
Консультант, предоставляющий экспертные консультации нескольким компаниям.
Владелец или учредитель компании или малого бизнеса.

translation.en: A person or organization that employs people.
translation.uz: Odamlarni ishga oladigan shaxs yoki tashkilot.
translation.ru: Человек или организация, которые нанимают людей.

example: My current employer offers flexible working hours.
Finding a good employer is crucial for career satisfaction.
The employer is responsible for providing a safe work environment.

quiz.correct_answer: A person or organization that employs people.

en: An individual who is looking for a job or employment opportunity.
A company that offers training programs to job seekers.
A government agency that regulates labor laws and wages.
uz: Ish yoki ish imkoniyatini izlayotgan shaxs.
Ish qidiruvchilarga o'quv dasturlarini taklif qiluvchi kompaniya.
Mehnat qonunlari va ish haqini tartibga soluvchi davlat agentligi.
ru: Человек, который ищет работу или возможности трудоустройства.
Компания, предлагающая программы обучения для соискателей.
Государственное учреждение, регулирующее трудовое законодательство и заработную плату.

translation.en: Working the full number of hours considered normal for a job.
translation.uz: Ish uchun normal hisoblangan to'liq soat ishlamoq.
translation.ru: Работа полное количество часов, считающееся нормальным для работы.

example: She's looking for a full-time position.
Most full-time jobs offer benefits like health insurance.
He started his career with a part-time role, then moved to full-time.

quiz.correct_answer: Working the full number of hours considered normal for a job.

en: Working only a few hours a week, less than standard.
Having a job that involves traveling frequently for business.
Being self-employed and managing your own work schedule.
uz: Haftasiga faqat bir necha soat ishlash, standartdan kamroq.
Tez-tez ish safari bilan bog'liq ishga ega bo'lish.
O'z-o'zini ish bilan ta'minlash va o'z ish jadvalini boshqarish.
ru: Работать всего несколько часов в неделю, меньше стандартного.
Иметь работу, которая предполагает частые командировки.
Быть самозанятым и управлять своим рабочим графиком.

translation.en: To employ someone for wages.
translation.uz: Kimnidir ish haqi evaziga ishga olish.
translation.ru: Нанять кого-либо за заработную плату.

example: The company plans to hire five new staff members.
They decided to hire a consultant to improve efficiency.
We are looking to hire a highly skilled software engineer.

quiz.correct_answer: To employ someone for wages.

en: To formally dismiss an employee due to poor performance.
To transfer an employee to a different department within the company.
To give an employee a promotion to a more senior position.
uz: Yomon ishlashi tufayli xodimni rasman ishdan bo'shatish.
Xodimni kompaniya ichidagi boshqa bo'limga o'tkazish.
Xodimni yuqori lavozimga ko'tarish.
ru: Официально уволить сотрудника из-за плохой работы.
Перевести сотрудника в другой отдел в компании.
Повысить сотрудника до более высокой должности.

translation.en: A formal account of an employee's responsibilities.
translation.uz: Xodimning vazifalari haqida rasmiy hisobot.
translation.ru: Официальное описание обязанностей сотрудника.

example: Read the job description carefully before applying.
The job description clearly outlines the required skills.
My job description was updated to include new responsibilities.

quiz.correct_answer: A formal account of an employee's responsibilities.

en: A document summarizing a company's financial goals for the year.
A list of professional references provided by a job applicant.
A training manual for new employees to learn company procedures.
uz: Kompaniyaning yil uchun moliyaviy maqsadlarini umumlashtiruvchi hujjat.
Ish qidiruvchi tomonidan taqdim etilgan kasbiy tavsiyalar ro'yxati.
Yangi xodimlar uchun kompaniya tartib-qoidalarini o'rganish uchun o'quv qo'llanma.
ru: Документ, содержащий сводку финансовых целей компании на год.
Список профессиональных рекомендаций, предоставленных соискателем.
Учебное пособие для новых сотрудников по изучению процедур компании.

translation.en: A period of absence from work granted to a mother before and after the birth of her child.
translation.uz: Bolaning tug'ilishidan oldin va keyin onaga beriladigan ishdan ta'til muddati.
translation.ru: Период отсутствия на работе, предоставляемый матери до и после рождения ребенка.

example: She's currently on maternity leave.
Many companies offer extended maternity leave benefits.
He covered her duties while she was on maternity leave.

quiz.correct_answer: A period of absence from work granted to a mother before and after the birth of her child.

en: A short break taken during the workday for lunch or rest.
Time off granted for personal development or further education.
A temporary suspension from work due to disciplinary reasons.
uz: Tushlik yoki dam olish uchun ish kuni davomida olingan qisqa tanaffus.
Shaxsiy rivojlanish yoki qo'shimcha ta'lim uchun berilgan ta'til.
Intizomiy sabablarga ko'ra ishdan vaqtincha chetlatish.
ru: Короткий перерыв, взятый во время рабочего дня на обед или отдых.
Отпуск, предоставленный для личного развития или дальнейшего образования.
Временное отстранение от работы по дисциплинарным причинам.

translation.en: Working less than the full number of hours considered normal for a job.
translation.uz: Ish uchun normal hisoblangan soatdan kamroq ishlash.
translation.ru: Работа меньше полного количества часов, считающегося нормальным для работы.

example: She works part-time while studying at university.
Many students take on part-time jobs to earn extra money.
The company offers flexible part-time roles for parents.

quiz.correct_answer: Working less than the full number of hours considered normal for a job.

en: Working extremely long hours, often overtime, to meet deadlines.
Being unemployed and actively seeking full-time work.
Managing a personal business venture from home independently.
uz: Muddatlarni bajarish uchun juda uzoq soatlar, ko'pincha qo'shimcha ish vaqti ishlash.
Ishsiz bo'lish va to'liq vaqtli ish izlash.
Uydan turib shaxsiy biznesni mustaqil boshqarish.
ru: Работа сверхурочно, часто сверхурочно, для выполнения сроков.
Быть безработным и активно искать работу на полный рабочий день.
Самостоятельное ведение личного бизнеса из дома.

translation.en: A regular payment made during a person's retirement from an investment fund to which that person or their employer has contributed.
translation.uz: Odamning pensiya yoshida o'sha shaxs yoki uning ish beruvchisi hissa qo'shgan investitsiya fondidan muntazam to'lov.
translation.ru: Регулярная выплата, производимая во время выхода человека на пенсию из инвестиционного фонда, в который этот человек или его работодатель вносили взносы.

example: He's been contributing to his pension fund for 30 years.
A good pension plan is an important benefit for employees.
She started receiving her pension after retiring at 65.

quiz.correct_answer: A regular payment made during a person's retirement from an investment fund to which that person or their employer has contributed.

en: A bonus payment received by employees at the end of the year.
Money reimbursed for work-related travel and entertainment expenses.
A payment made to employees when they are sick and cannot work.
uz: Yil oxirida xodimlar tomonidan olingan bonus to'lovi.
Ish bilan bog'liq sayohat va ko'ngilochar xarajatlar uchun qoplangan pul.
Kasallik tufayli ishlay olmaydigan xodimlarga to'lanadigan to'lov.
ru: Премиальная выплата, получаемая сотрудниками в конце года.
Деньги, возмещаемые за командировочные и представительские расходы.
Выплата, производимая сотрудникам, когда они больны и не могут работать.

translation.en: A period during which a new employee is tested to see if they are suitable for a job.
translation.uz: Yangi xodim ishga mos kelishini sinab ko'rish davri.
translation.ru: Период, в течение которого новый сотрудник проверяется на пригодность к работе.

example: The first three months are usually a probation period.
He successfully completed his probation period and became a permanent employee.
During the probation period, regular performance reviews are conducted.

quiz.correct_answer: A period during which a new employee is tested to see if they are suitable for a job.

en: A short break taken by employees for personal errands.
The time off granted for a major national holiday.
A mandatory training program for all senior management.
uz: Xodimlar tomonidan shaxsiy ishlar uchun olingan qisqa tanaffus.
Yirik milliy bayram uchun berilgan ta'til.
Barcha yuqori darajadagi menejerlar uchun majburiy o'quv dasturi.
ru: Короткий перерыв, взятый сотрудниками для личных дел.
Отгул, предоставленный в связи с крупным национальным праздником.
Обязательная программа обучения для всего высшего руководства.

translation.en: An official record showing that you have successfully finished a course of study or training.
translation.uz: Ta'lim yoki trening kursini muvaffaqiyatli tugatganingizni ko'rsatuvchi rasmiy yozuv.
translation.ru: Официальная запись, подтверждающая успешное завершение курса обучения или тренировки.

example: What qualifications do you have for this role?
Her qualifications include a master's degree and five years of experience.
The job requires strong technical qualifications and communication skills.

quiz.correct_answer: An official record showing that you have successfully finished a course of study or training.

en: A list of personal hobbies and interests outside of work.
The amount of salary an employee receives each month.
A performance review document from a previous employer.
uz: Ishdan tashqari shaxsiy hobbi va qiziqishlar ro'yxati.
Xodim har oy oladigan maosh miqdori.
Oldingi ish beruvchidan olingan ish faoliyati to'g'risidagi hujjat.
ru: Список личных хобби и интересов вне работы.
Размер заработной платы, которую сотрудник получает каждый месяц.
Документ о проверке производительности от предыдущего работодателя.

translation.en: To find new people to join a company, organization, or armed forces.
translation.uz: Kompaniya, tashkilot yoki qurolli kuchlarga yangi odamlarni topish.
translation.ru: Найти новых людей для вступления в компанию, организацию или вооруженные силы.

example: The company is looking to recruit more software engineers.
We need to recruit a diverse workforce.
They are recruiting for various positions across different departments.

quiz.correct_answer: To find new people to join a company, organization, or armed forces.

en: To provide training and development opportunities for existing staff.
To evaluate the performance of current employees annually.
To dismiss employees who are no longer needed by the company.
uz: Mavjud xodimlar uchun o'quv va rivojlanish imkoniyatlarini taqdim etish.
Hozirgi xodimlarning ish faoliyatini har yili baholash.
Kompaniya tomonidan endi kerak bo'lmagan xodimlarni ishdan bo'shatish.
ru: Предоставлять возможности обучения и развития существующему персоналу.
Ежегодно оценивать производительность текущих сотрудников.
Увольнять сотрудников, которые больше не нужны компании.

translation.en: A system of working in which different groups of workers take turns working during different parts of the day or night.
translation.uz: Ishchilarning turli guruhlari kun yoki tunning turli qismlarida navbatma-navbat ishlaydigan ish tizimi.
translation.ru: Система работы, при которой различные группы работников поочередно работают в разное время суток или ночи.

example: Many nurses and doctors do shift work.
Shift work can be challenging for maintaining a regular sleep schedule.
The factory operates 24/7 with three shifts of workers.

quiz.correct_answer: A system of working in which different groups of workers take turns working during different parts of the day or night.

en: A flexible work arrangement allowing employees to choose their hours.
Working from home using a computer and internet connection.
A type of job that involves frequent travel to different locations.
uz: Xodimlarga o'z ish soatlarini tanlash imkonini beruvchi moslashuvchan ish tartibi.
Kompyuter va internet orqali uydan ishlash.
Turli joylarga tez-tez sayohat qilishni o'z ichiga olgan ish turi.
ru: Гибкий график работы, позволяющий сотрудникам выбирать свои часы.
Работа из дома с использованием компьютера и подключения к Интернету.
Тип работы, который предполагает частые поездки в разные места.

translation.en: A period of time during which an employee is absent from work due to illness.
translation.uz: Xodimning kasalligi tufayli ishdan bo'lmagan vaqt oralig'i.
translation.ru: Период времени, в течение которого сотрудник отсутствует на работе по болезни.

example: She called in sick and took a day of sick leave.
Employees are allowed a certain number of paid sick leave days per year.
He was on sick leave for two weeks after his surgery.

quiz.correct_answer: A period of time during which an employee is absent from work due to illness.

en: Time off granted for personal holidays or vacation.
A period of rest taken during a long workday.
Leave taken for family emergencies or personal appointments.
uz: Shaxsiy ta'tillar yoki dam olish uchun berilgan ta'til.
Uzoq ish kuni davomida olingan dam olish davri.
Oilaviy favqulodda holatlar yoki shaxsiy uchrashuvlar uchun olingan ta'til.
ru: Отпуск, предоставленный для личных праздников или отпуска.
Период отдыха, взятый во время длительного рабочего дня.
Отпуск, взятый по семейным обстоятельствам или для личных встреч.

translation.en: All the people employed by a particular organization.
translation.uz: Ma'lum bir tashkilot tomonidan ishga qabul qilingan barcha odamlar.
translation.ru: Все люди, работающие в конкретной организации.

example: The company has a friendly and supportive staff.
Training new staff members is an important part of management.
The entire staff participated in the annual team-building event.

quiz.correct_answer: All the people employed by a particular organization.

en: The group of managers who oversee all company operations.
Individuals who provide services as independent contractors.
The physical equipment and tools used in an office environment.
uz: Kompaniyaning barcha operatsiyalarini nazorat qiluvchi menejerlar guruhi.
Mustaqil pudratchi sifatida xizmat ko'rsatuvchi shaxslar.
Ofis muhitida ishlatiladigan jismoniy uskunalar va asboblar.
ru: Группа менеджеров, которые контролируют все операции компании.
Лица, оказывающие услуги в качестве независимых подрядчиков.
Физическое оборудование и инструменты, используемые в офисной среде.

translation.en: A refusal to work organized by a body of employees as a form of protest.
translation.uz: Ishchilar tashkiloti tomonidan norozilik shakli sifatida ishlashdan bosh tortish.
translation.ru: Отказ от работы, организованный группой сотрудников в знак протеста.

example: The workers decided to go on strike for better wages.
The strike caused significant disruption to public transport.
Negotiations are underway to end the teachers' strike.

quiz.correct_answer: A refusal to work organized by a body of employees as a form of protest.

en: A mandatory training session for all new employees.
A company picnic organized for staff and their families.
A formal review of an employee's annual performance.
uz: Barcha yangi xodimlar uchun majburiy o'quv mashg'uloti.
Xodimlar va ularning oilalari uchun tashkil etilgan kompaniya piknigi.
Xodimning yillik ish faoliyatini rasmiy ko'rib chiqish.
ru: Обязательный учебный курс для всех новых сотрудников.
Корпоративный пикник, организованный для сотрудников и их семей.
Официальный ежегодный обзор производительности сотрудника.

translation.en: The combined action of a group of people, especially when effective and efficient.
translation.uz: Odamlar guruhining birgalikdagi harakati, ayniqsa samarali va tejamli bo'lsa.
translation.ru: Совместное действие группы людей, особенно когда оно эффективно и продуктивно.

example: Successful projects often depend on strong teamwork.
Teamwork is essential in our department.
The coach emphasized the importance of teamwork for winning the championship.

quiz.correct_answer: The combined action of a group of people, especially when effective and efficient.

en: The individual effort of a single employee on a task.
A competitive event where individuals compete against each other.
The process of making independent decisions without consultation.
uz: Bir xodimning vazifa bo'yicha individual harakati.
Shaxslarning bir-biriga qarshi raqobatlashadigan musobaqasi.
Maslahatlashmasdan mustaqil qarorlar qabul qilish jarayoni.
ru: Индивидуальные усилия одного сотрудника над задачей.
Соревновательное мероприятие, где люди соревнуются друг с другом.
Процесс принятия независимых решений без консультаций.

translation.en: Without a job but available to work.
translation.uz: Ishsiz, ammo ishlashga tayyor.
translation.ru: Безработный, но доступный для работы.

example: The number of unemployed people has increased this quarter.
She's been unemployed for six months and is actively looking for a job.
Government programs aim to help the unemployed find work.

quiz.correct_answer: Without a job but available to work.

en: Someone who is currently working full-time in their chosen profession.
A person who has retired from their job and is no longer working.
An individual who is employed but dissatisfied with their current role.
uz: Hozirda tanlagan kasbida to'liq vaqtli ishlayotgan kishi.
Ishdan nafaqaga chiqqan va endi ishlamaydigan shaxs.
Ishlaydigan, lekin hozirgi rolidan norozi bo'lgan shaxs.
ru: Человек, который в настоящее время работает на полную ставку по выбранной профессии.
Человек, вышедший на пенсию и больше не работающий.
Человек, который трудоустроен, но недоволен своей текущей ролью.

translation.en: A place where people work, such as an office or factory.
translation.uz: Odamlar ishlaydigan joy, masalan, ofis yoki zavod.
translation.ru: Место, где люди работают, например, офис или фабрика.

example: Our workplace has a very positive atmosphere.
Safety regulations are strictly enforced in the workplace.
He enjoys socializing with his colleagues outside the workplace.

quiz.correct_answer: A place where people work, such as an office or factory.

en: A building used solely for residential purposes, like an apartment.
A public park or recreational area for leisure activities.
A school or university campus for educational purposes.
uz: Faqat turar-joy maqsadlarida ishlatiladigan bino, masalan, kvartira.
Bo'sh vaqt o'tkazish uchun jamoat parki yoki dam olish hududi.
Ta'lim maqsadlarida ishlatiladigan maktab yoki universitet kampusi.
ru: Здание, используемое исключительно для жилых целей, например, квартира.
Общественный парк или зона отдыха для досуга.
Школьный или университетский кампус для образовательных целей.

translation.en: Someone you know slightly, but who is not a close friend.
translation.uz: Tanishingiz bo'lgan, ammo yaqin do'stingiz bo'lmagan kishi.
translation.ru: Человек, которого вы немного знаете, но который не является близким другом.

example: He's more of an acquaintance than a close friend; we only meet at work.
I ran into an old acquaintance at the supermarket the other day.
She has many acquaintances but only a few true friends she can count on.

quiz.correct_answer: Someone you know slightly, but who is not a close friend.

en: A very close friend with whom you share all your secrets and experiences.
A family member you see only once a year on special occasions.
A person you have just met for the very first time.
uz: Barcha sirlaringiz va tajribalaringizni baham ko'radigan juda yaqin do'st.
Yiliga bir marta maxsus bayramlarda ko'rishadigan oila a'zosi.
Yaqinda birinchi marta tanishgan odam.
ru: Очень близкий друг, с которым вы делитесь всеми своими секретами и переживаниями.
Член семьи, которого вы видите только раз в год по особым случаям.
Человек, с которым вы только что познакомились впервые.

translation.en: A close connection or feeling of friendship between two or more people.
translation.uz: Ikki yoki undan ortiq odam o'rtasidagi yaqin aloqa yoki do'stlik hissi.
translation.ru: Тесная связь или чувство дружбы между двумя или более людьми.

example: They formed a strong bond during their time studying abroad together.
The bond between a mother and child is incredibly powerful.
Team-building exercises helped to create a stronger bond among colleagues.

quiz.correct_answer: A close connection or feeling of friendship between two or more people.

en: A formal agreement or contract that connects two parties legally.
A physical chain or rope used to tie things together securely.
A sudden, brief argument or disagreement between individuals.
uz: Ikki tomonni qonuniy ravishda bog'laydigan rasmiy kelishuv yoki shartnoma.
Narsalarni mahkam bog'lash uchun ishlatiladigan jismoniy zanjir yoki arqon.
Shaxslar o'rtasidagi to'satdan, qisqa tortishuv yoki kelishmovchilik.
ru: Официальное соглашение или контракт, связывающий две стороны юридически.
Физическая цепь или веревка, используемая для надежного связывания вещей.
Внезапная, короткая ссора или разногласие между людьми.

translation.en: To make two people or groups of people friendly again after they have argued.
translation.uz: Janjallashib qolgan ikki kishi yoki guruhni yana do'stona munosabatlarga keltirish.
translation.ru: Снова помирить двух людей или группы людей после ссоры.

example: It's difficult to reconcile after such a big argument, but we'll try.
She hopes to reconcile with her sister before the holidays begin.
They decided to reconcile their differences and move forward as a team.

quiz.correct_answer: To make two people or groups of people friendly again after they have argued.

en: To completely forget about a past conflict and never mention it again.
To avoid someone you had an argument with so you don't fight again.
To strongly disagree with someone and refuse to compromise at all.
uz: O'tmishdagi mojaroni butunlay unutish va uni boshqa hech qachon eslamaslik.
Janjallashib qolgan odamdan qochish, shunda yana janjal bo'lmasligi uchun.
Kimdir bilan qattiq kelishmovchilikka borish va hech qanday murosaga kelmaslik.
ru: Полностью забыть о прошлом конфликте и никогда больше о нем не упоминать.
Избегать того, с кем вы поссорились, чтобы снова не поссориться.
Категорически не соглашаться с кем-либо и полностью отказываться от компромиссов.

translation.en: To be disloyal to someone who trusts you, often by revealing their secrets.
translation.uz: Sizga ishonadigan kishiga sodiq bo'lmaslik, ko'pincha ularning sirlarini oshkor qilish orqali.
translation.ru: Быть неверным тому, кто вам доверяет, часто раскрывая его секреты.

example: I felt completely betrayed when my friend told my secret to everyone.
She would never betray her principles for personal gain, no matter what.
His actions made her feel betrayed and deeply hurt by his dishonesty.

quiz.correct_answer: To be disloyal to someone who trusts you, often by revealing their secrets.

en: To strongly support someone and always stand by their side in every situation.
To openly discuss your personal feelings and thoughts with someone.
To forgive someone for a past mistake and move past the issue.
uz: Kimnidir qattiq qo'llab-quvvatlash va har qanday vaziyatda doimo yonida turish.
Shaxsiy his-tuyg'ularingiz va fikrlaringizni kimdir bilan ochiq muhokama qilish.
Kimnidir o'tmishdagi xatosi uchun kechirish va muammoni unutish.
ru: Решительно поддерживать кого-либо и всегда быть на его стороне в любой ситуации.
Открыто обсуждать свои личные чувства и мысли с кем-либо.
Простить кого-либо за прошлую ошибку и забыть о проблеме.

translation.en: Providing encouragement or emotional help to someone, especially in difficult times.
translation.uz: Kimnidir rag'batlantirish yoki hissiy yordam ko'rsatish, ayniqsa qiyin paytlarda.
translation.ru: Оказывать поддержку или эмоциональную помощь кому-либо, особенно в трудные времена.

example: My parents have always been very supportive of my career choices.
It's important to have supportive friends who believe in you.
She offered supportive words to her colleague after he lost the project.

quiz.correct_answer: Providing encouragement or emotional help to someone, especially in difficult times.

en: Being very critical and always finding fault with others' actions.
Ignoring someone's problems and offering no assistance at all.
Relying heavily on others for your own emotional well-being.
uz: Juda tanqidiy bo'lish va doimo boshqalarning harakatlarida xato topish.
Kimningdir muammolarini e'tiborsiz qoldirish va umuman yordam bermaslik.
O'z hissiy farovonligingiz uchun boshqalarga juda bog'liq bo'lish.
ru: Быть очень критичным и всегда находить недостатки в действиях других.
Игнорировать чьи-либо проблемы и совсем не предлагать помощи.
Сильно зависеть от других в своем эмоциональном благополучии.

translation.en: To have an argument with someone and stop being friendly with them.
translation.uz: Kimdir bilan janjallashish va ular bilan do'stona munosabatlarni to'xtatish.
translation.ru: Поссориться с кем-то и перестать быть с ним дружелюбным.

example: They often fall out over small things, but they always make up quickly.
I hope we don't fall out over this misunderstanding; it's not worth it.
They fell out about money and haven't spoken since last Christmas.

quiz.correct_answer: To have an argument with someone and stop being friendly with them.

en: To discover new shared interests with a friend and strengthen your bond.
To accidentally lose something important during a social gathering.
To suddenly become very tired and decide to go to sleep.
uz: Do'st bilan yangi umumiy qiziqishlarni topish va aloqalarni mustahkamlash.
Ijtimoiy yig'ilish paytida tasodifan muhim narsani yo'qotish.
To'satdan juda charchash va uxlashga qaror qilish.
ru: Найти новые общие интересы с другом и укрепить вашу связь.
Случайно потерять что-то важное во время общественного мероприятия.
Внезапно очень устать и решить лечь спать.

translation.en: To have a friendly relationship with someone, without arguments.
translation.uz: Janjallarsiz, kimdir bilan do'stona munosabatda bo'lish.
translation.ru: Иметь дружеские отношения с кем-то, без ссор и конфликтов.

example: My brother and I always get along well, even though we're very different.
It's important for team members to get along and work effectively.
Despite their different opinions, they manage to get along perfectly fine.

quiz.correct_answer: To have a friendly relationship with someone, without arguments.

en: To agree with someone on every single topic and never disagree.
To completely avoid talking to someone, even if you share a space.
To compete with someone to see who is better at something.
uz: Kimdir bilan har bir mavzuda kelishish va hech qachon kelishmovchilikka bormaslik.
Kimdir bilan umuman gaplashmaslik, hatto bitta joyni baham ko'rsangiz ham.
Kimdir bilan biror narsada kim yaxshiroq ekanini bilish uchun raqobatlashish.
ru: Соглашаться с кем-либо по каждому вопросу и никогда не спорить.
Полностью избегать общения с кем-либо, даже если вы находитесь в одном помещении.
Соревноваться с кем-либо, чтобы выяснить, кто лучше в чем-либо.

translation.en: To believe that someone is good and honest and will not harm you.
translation.uz: Kimnidir yaxshi va halol deb bilish va sizga zarar yetkazmasligiga ishonish.
translation.ru: Верить, что кто-то хороший и честный и не причинит вам вреда.

example: It takes a long time to build trust in a new relationship.
I trust her completely with my deepest secrets.
Once trust is broken, it's very hard to repair and rebuild.

quiz.correct_answer: To believe that someone is good and honest and will not harm you.

en: To doubt someone's intentions and constantly question their actions.
To rely on someone to do something for you, even if you don't know them.
To pretend to believe someone while secretly planning against them.
uz: Kimningdir niyatlariga shubha qilish va ularning harakatlarini doimo savolga tutish.
Kimnidir tanimasangiz ham, siz uchun biror narsa qilishiga ishonish.
Kimdirga ishonayotgandek ko'rinish, lekin yashirincha unga qarshi reja tuzish.
ru: Сомневаться в чьих-либо намерениях и постоянно сомневаться в их действиях.
Полагаться на кого-то в выполнении чего-либо, даже если вы их не знаете.
Притворяться, что верите кому-то, тайно строя против него планы.

translation.en: The quality of being faithful and committed to someone or something.
translation.uz: Kimnidir yoki biror narsaga sodiq va sadoqatli bo'lish sifati.
translation.ru: Качество быть верным и преданным кому-либо или чему-либо.

example: His loyalty to his friends is admirable; he always stands by them.
Brand loyalty is important for businesses to ensure repeat customers.
She showed great loyalty to her company by refusing competing offers.

quiz.correct_answer: The quality of being faithful and committed to someone or something.

en: The ability to quickly change your mind or allegiances.
The act of being dishonest and unreliable in relationships.
A feeling of strong dislike or animosity towards someone.
uz: Fikringizni yoki sadoqatingizni tez o'zgartirish qobiliyati.
Munosabatlarda vafosiz va ishonchsiz bo'lish harakati.
Kimdirga nisbatan kuchli yoqtirmaslik yoki dushmanlik hissi.
ru: Способность быстро менять свое мнение или привязанности.
Действие быть нечестным и ненадежным в отношениях.
Чувство сильной неприязни или враждебности к кому-либо.

translation.en: To tell someone about something secret or private because you trust them.
translation.uz: Kimnidirga sir yoki shaxsiy narsani aytish, chunki unga ishonasiz.
translation.ru: Рассказать кому-либо о чем-то секретном или личном, потому что вы ему доверяете.

example: She confided in her best friend about her deepest fears.
It's important to have someone you can confide in when you're feeling down.
He confided that he was thinking of changing jobs soon.

quiz.correct_answer: To tell someone about something secret or private because you trust them.

en: To argue loudly and publicly with someone you know well.
To demand that someone tell you their private thoughts and feelings.
To keep all your personal information strictly to yourself.
uz: Yaxshi bilgan odamingiz bilan baland ovozda va ommaviy ravishda janjallashish.
Kimdirning shaxsiy fikrlari va his-tuyg'ularini aytishni talab qilish.
Barcha shaxsiy ma'lumotlaringizni qat'iy ravishda o'zingizda saqlash.
ru: Громко и публично спорить с хорошо знакомым человеком.
Требовать от кого-либо, чтобы он рассказал вам свои личные мысли и чувства.
Хранить всю свою личную информацию строго при себе.

translation.en: Felt or done by two or more people towards each other equally.
translation.uz: Ikki yoki undan ortiq kishi tomonidan bir-biriga nisbatan teng ravishda his qilingan yoki qilingan.
translation.ru: Чувствуемый или совершаемый двумя или более людьми в равной степени по отношению друг к другу.

example: They have a mutual respect for each other's opinions.
Their friendship is based on mutual interests and shared values.
We discovered we had a mutual friend who introduced us.

quiz.correct_answer: Felt or done by two or more people towards each other equally.

en: Felt only by one person towards another, without reciprocation.
Something that is extremely rare and happens very infrequently.
A type of formal agreement that is legally binding for all parties.
uz: Faqat bir kishi tomonidan boshqasiga nisbatan his qilingan, javobsiz.
Juda kam uchraydigan va juda kamdan-kam sodir bo'ladigan narsa.
Barcha tomonlar uchun qonuniy kuchga ega bo'lgan rasmiy kelishuv turi.
ru: Испытываемое только одним человеком по отношению к другому, без взаимности.
Что-то чрезвычайно редкое и происходящее очень нечасто.
Тип официального соглашения, имеющего юридическую силу для всех сторон.

translation.en: A disagreement or argument, often a serious one.
translation.uz: Kelishmovchilik yoki janjal, ko'pincha jiddiy.
translation.ru: Разногласие или спор, часто серьезный.

example: They had a dispute over who should pay for the dinner.
The two countries are trying to resolve their border dispute peacefully.
The dispute continued for months without any clear resolution.

quiz.correct_answer: A disagreement or argument, often a serious one.

en: A strong and immediate agreement on a particular point or idea.
A fun and casual discussion among friends with differing views.
A formal meeting to celebrate an important event or achievement.
uz: Ma'lum bir nuqta yoki g'oya bo'yicha kuchli va zudlik bilan kelishuv.
Har xil fikrlarga ega do'stlar orasida qiziqarli va norasmiy muhokama.
Muhim voqea yoki yutuqni nishonlash uchun rasmiy uchrashuv.
ru: Сильное и немедленное согласие по определенному пункту или идее.
Веселая и непринужденная дискуссия среди друзей с различными взглядами.
Официальная встреча для празднования важного события или достижения.

translation.en: The ability to understand and share the feelings of another person.
translation.uz: Boshqa odamning his-tuyg'ularini tushunish va ularni baham ko'rish qobiliyati.
translation.ru: Способность понимать и разделять чувства другого человека.

example: Having empathy is crucial for building strong, lasting relationships.
She showed great empathy towards her struggling colleague.
Developing empathy helps you to connect with people on a deeper level.

quiz.correct_answer: The ability to understand and share the feelings of another person.

en: The ability to control your own emotions and not show them to others.
A strong feeling of anger or frustration towards someone else.
The state of being completely indifferent to others' problems.
uz: O'z his-tuyg'ularingizni nazorat qilish va ularni boshqalarga ko'rsatmaslik qobiliyati.
Kimdirga nisbatan kuchli g'azab yoki umidsizlik hissi.
Boshqalarning muammolariga butunlay befarq bo'lish holati.
ru: Способность контролировать свои эмоции и не показывать их другим.
Сильное чувство гнева или разочарования по отношению к кому-либо другому.
Состояние полного безразличия к чужим проблемам.

translation.en: A brother or sister.
translation.uz: Aka yoki opa.
translation.ru: Брат или сестра.

example: I have two siblings, an older brother and a younger sister.
Sibling rivalry is common in many families, especially when growing up.
She enjoys spending time with her siblings during the holidays.

quiz.correct_answer: A brother or sister.

en: A close friend who you grew up with since childhood.
A distant relative, such as a cousin or an aunt.
A parent's sibling, meaning your aunt or uncle.
uz: Bolalikdan birga o'sgan yaqin do'st.
Uzoq qarindosh, masalan, amakivachcha yoki xola.
Otaning yoki onaning akasi/opasi, ya'ni amakingiz yoki xolangiz.
ru: Близкий друг, с которым вы выросли с детства.
Дальний родственник, такой как двоюродный брат или тетя.
Брат или сестра родителя, то есть ваша тетя или дядя.

translation.en: Casual conversation about other people's private lives, often involving rumors.
translation.uz: Boshqa odamlarning shaxsiy hayoti haqida tasodifiy suhbat, ko'pincha mish-mishlarni o'z ichiga oladi.
translation.ru: Случайный разговор о личной жизни других людей, часто включающий слухи.

example: I try to avoid office gossip because it can lead to problems.
She loves to gossip about all the latest news from their neighborhood.
Spreading gossip can seriously damage someone's reputation and trust.

quiz.correct_answer: Casual conversation about other people's private lives, often involving rumors.

en: A formal discussion or debate about an important political issue.
A detailed report on the latest financial market trends.
An in-depth analysis of a scientific discovery or new technology.
uz: Muhim siyosiy masala bo'yicha rasmiy munozara yoki bahs.
Eng so'nggi moliyaviy bozor tendensiyalari haqida batafsil hisobot.
Ilmiy kashfiyot yoki yangi texnologiyaning chuqur tahlili.
ru: Формальная дискуссия или дебаты по важному политическому вопросу.
Подробный отчет о последних тенденциях финансового рынка.
Углубленный анализ научного открытия или новой технологии.

translation.en: To find a satisfactory solution to a problem, difficulty, or dispute.
translation.uz: Muammo, qiyinchilik yoki nizoni qoniqarli hal qilish.
translation.ru: Найти удовлетворительное решение проблемы, трудности или спора.

example: They managed to resolve their differences and continue working together.
We need to resolve this issue quickly before it gets worse.
It took a long time to resolve the conflict between the two families.

quiz.correct_answer: To find a satisfactory solution to a problem, difficulty, or dispute.

en: To completely ignore a problem and hope it disappears on its own.
To create new problems or difficulties for other people to deal with.
To postpone dealing with a situation until a later, indefinite time.
uz: Muammoni butunlay e'tiborsiz qoldirish va uning o'z-o'zidan yo'qolishiga umid qilish.
Boshqa odamlar uchun yangi muammolar yoki qiyinchiliklar yaratish.
Vaziyatni keyinchalik, noma'lum muddatga qoldirish.
ru: Полностью игнорировать проблему и надеяться, что она исчезнет сама по себе.
Создавать новые проблемы или трудности для других людей.
Откладывать решение проблемы на неопределенное время.

translation.en: Competition or animosity among brothers and sisters.
translation.uz: Aka-ukalar va opa-singillar o'rtasidagi raqobat yoki dushmanlik.
translation.ru: Соперничество или вражда между братьями и сестрами.

example: Sibling rivalry is a common part of growing up in a large family.
Their constant arguments were a clear example of sibling rivalry.
Parents often struggle to manage sibling rivalry effectively.

quiz.correct_answer: Competition or animosity among brothers and sisters.

en: A very strong bond of affection and closeness between siblings.
The act of sharing toys and possessions equally with your siblings.
When siblings work together perfectly without any disagreements.
uz: Aka-ukalar o'rtasidagi juda kuchli mehribonlik va yaqinlik rishtasi.
O'yinchoqlar va mulklarni aka-ukalar bilan teng ravishda bo'lishish harakati.
Aka-ukalar hech qanday kelishmovchiliklarsiz birga mukammal ishlashi.
ru: Очень крепкая связь привязанности и близости между братьями и сестрами.
Равное разделение игрушек и имущества с братьями и сестрами.
Когда братья и сестры работают вместе идеально, без разногласий.

translation.en: A group of friends who regularly spend time together.
translation.uz: Muntazam ravishda birga vaqt o'tkazadigan do'stlar guruhi.
translation.ru: Группа друзей, которые регулярно проводят время вместе.

example: She has a small but very loyal circle of friends.
It's nice to expand your circle of friends as you meet new people.
His circle of friends celebrated his birthday with a surprise party.

quiz.correct_answer: A group of friends who regularly spend time together.

en: A single, very close friend with whom you share everything.
A formal club or organization that meets only once a year.
A list of distant relatives you rarely interact with.
uz: Hamma narsani baham ko'radigan bitta, juda yaqin do'st.
Yiliga bir marta uchrashadigan rasmiy klub yoki tashkilot.
Kamdan-kam muloqot qiladigan uzoq qarindoshlar ro'yxati.
ru: Единственный, очень близкий друг, с которым вы делитесь всем.
Официальный клуб или организация, которая встречается только раз в год.
Список дальних родственников, с которыми вы редко общаетесь.

translation.en: To gradually become less close or friendly with someone.
translation.uz: Kimdir bilan asta-sekin kamroq yaqin yoki do'stona bo'lib qolish.
translation.ru: Постепенно становиться менее близким или дружелюбным с кем-либо.

example: After university, we slowly started to drift apart as our lives changed.
It's sad when old friends drift apart over time due to distance.
They didn't argue, they just drifted apart naturally.

quiz.correct_answer: To gradually become less close or friendly with someone.

en: To become extremely close friends very quickly and easily.
To have a sudden and very serious argument with someone.
To travel to different places in the world together as friends.
uz: Juda tez va osonlik bilan juda yaqin do'st bo'lish.
Kimdir bilan to'satdan va juda jiddiy janjallashish.
Do'stlar sifatida dunyoning turli joylariga birga sayohat qilish.
ru: Стать чрезвычайно близкими друзьями очень быстро и легко.
Внезапно и очень серьезно поссориться с кем-либо.
Путешествовать по миру вместе как друзья.

translation.en: A particular type or style of literature, art, music, or film.
translation.uz: Adabiyot, san'at, musiqa yoki filmlarning muayyan turi yoki uslubi.
translation.ru: Определенный тип или стиль литературы, искусства, музыки или кино.

example: My favorite film genre is science fiction, especially space operas.
This book falls into the crime fiction genre, with a detective main character.
What musical genre do you prefer listening to in your free time?

quiz.correct_answer: A particular type or style of literature, art, music, or film.

en: The main plot or storyline of a book or movie.
A specific character or actor who plays a lead role in a production.
The total running time of a movie from beginning to end.
uz: Kitob yoki filmning asosiy syujeti yoki hikoyasi.
Ishlab chiqarishda bosh rolni ijro etuvchi aniq qahramon yoki aktyor.
Filmning boshidan oxirigacha bo'lgan umumiy davomiyligi.
ru: Основной сюжет или сюжетная линия книги или фильма.
Конкретный персонаж или актер, исполняющий главную роль в постановке.
Общая продолжительность фильма от начала до конца.

translation.en: The sequence of events and actions that make up the main story of a book or film.
translation.uz: Kitob yoki filmning asosiy hikoyasini tashkil etuvchi voqealar va harakatlar ketma-ketligi.
translation.ru: Последовательность событий и действий, составляющих основную историю книги или фильма.

example: The plot of the movie was very complicated, with many twists and turns.
I enjoy books with a strong, engaging plot that keeps me guessing.
The plot thickens when the detective discovers a new piece of evidence.

quiz.correct_answer: The sequence of events and actions that make up the main story of a book or film.

en: The main character's personality and their emotional development.
The director's overall vision and artistic style for the film.
The background music and sound effects used in a cinematic production.
uz: Asosiy qahramonning shaxsiyati va uning hissiy rivojlanishi.
Rejissyorning filmga bo'lgan umumiy qarashi va badiiy uslubi.
Kinoproduktsiyada ishlatiladigan fon musiqasi va ovoz effektlari.
ru: Личность главного героя и его эмоциональное развитие.
Общее видение режиссера и художественный стиль фильма.
Фоновая музыка и звуковые эффекты, используемые в кинопроизводстве.

translation.en: A critical assessment of a book, film, or play, often published in a newspaper or online.
translation.uz: Kitob, film yoki spektaklning tanqidiy baholanishi, ko'pincha gazeta yoki onlayn nashr etiladi.
translation.ru: Критическая оценка книги, фильма или пьесы, часто публикуемая в газете или в интернете.

example: I always read reviews before deciding which movie to watch.
The newspaper published a very positive review of the new restaurant.
Can you write a review of the concert you attended last night?

quiz.correct_answer: A critical assessment of a book, film, or play, often published in a newspaper or online.

en: A brief summary of the main characters and setting of a story.
An official document that allows you to borrow books from a library.
A detailed list of all the actors and crew involved in a film production.
uz: Hikoyaning asosiy qahramonlari va joylashuvi haqida qisqacha xulosa.
Kutubxonadan kitoblarni olish imkonini beruvchi rasmiy hujjat.
Film ishlab chiqarishda ishtirok etgan barcha aktyorlar va ijodiy guruhning batafsil ro'yxati.
ru: Краткое изложение главных героев и места действия истории.
Официальный документ, позволяющий брать книги в библиотеке.
Подробный список всех актеров и съемочной группы, задействованных в кинопроизводстве.

translation.en: To send out programs on television or radio, or to make them available online.
translation.uz: Televizor yoki radio orqali dasturlarni uzatish yoki ularni onlayn tarzda taqdim etish.
translation.ru: Передавать программы по телевидению или радио, или делать их доступными онлайн.

example: The Olympic Games will be broadcast live all over the world.
Many news channels broadcast 24 hours a day with constant updates.
They decided to broadcast the concert live on their social media page.

quiz.correct_answer: To send out programs on television or radio, or to make them available online.

en: To privately share a message or document with only one person.
To store recorded programs on a hard drive for future viewing at home.
To write a detailed script for a television show before filming begins.
uz: Xabar yoki hujjatni faqat bir kishi bilan shaxsiy tarzda bo'lishish.
Yozib olingan dasturlarni keyinchalik uyda ko'rish uchun qattiq diskda saqlash.
Suratga olish boshlanishidan oldin televizion shou uchun batafsil ssenariy yozish.
ru: Лично делиться сообщением или документом только с одним человеком.
Хранить записанные программы на жестком диске для последующего просмотра дома.
Написать подробный сценарий для телешоу до начала съемок.

translation.en: One of the parts into which a television or radio series is divided.
translation.uz: Televizion yoki radio serialining bo'linadigan qismlaridan biri.
translation.ru: Одна из частей, на которые делится телевизионный или радиосериал.

example: I watched three episodes of the new series last night; it's so addictive.
The season finale was a thrilling episode that left everyone shocked.
Each episode focuses on a different historical event from the past.

quiz.correct_answer: One of the parts into which a television or radio series is divided.

en: The main theme song played at the beginning of a television series.
A commercial break during a TV show that advertises products.
The entire collection of all seasons of a particular TV show.
uz: Televizion serialning boshida ijro etiladigan asosiy mavzu qo'shig'i.
Mahsulotlarni reklama qiluvchi televizion shou paytidagi reklama tanaffusi.
Muayyan teleko'rsatuvning barcha fasllarining butun to'plami.
ru: Основная музыкальная тема, звучащая в начале телесериала.
Рекламная пауза во время телешоу, рекламирующая товары.
Вся коллекция всех сезонов конкретного телешоу.

translation.en: The title of a news story printed in large letters, usually at the top of an article.
translation.uz: Yangilik hikoyasining katta harflar bilan, odatda maqolaning tepasida yozilgan sarlavhasi.
translation.ru: Заголовок новостной статьи, напечатанный крупными буквами, обычно вверху статьи.

example: The headline on the front page screamed about the latest political scandal.
I just read a shocking headline about the economy this morning.
Journalists try to write catchy headlines to attract more readers.

quiz.correct_answer: The title of a news story printed in large letters, usually at the top of an article.

en: A small, detailed paragraph summarizing the end of a news report.
The name of the newspaper or magazine where an article is published.
A short biography of the journalist who wrote the news story.
uz: Yangilik hisobotining oxirini umumlashtiruvchi kichik, batafsil paragraf.
Maqola chop etilgan gazeta yoki jurnalning nomi.
Yangilik hikoyasini yozgan jurnalistning qisqacha tarjimai holi.
ru: Небольшой, подробный абзац, подводящий итог новостного сообщения.
Название газеты или журнала, где опубликована статья.
Краткая биография журналиста, написавшего новостную статью.

translation.en: To arrange to receive a publication regularly or to pay to use an online service.
translation.uz: Nashrni muntazam olishni tashkil qilish yoki onlayn xizmatdan foydalanish uchun to'lash.
translation.ru: Оформить подписку на регулярное получение публикации или платить за использование онлайн-сервиса.

example: I decided to subscribe to that streaming service to watch exclusive shows.
Many people subscribe to online newspapers to get their daily news.
Don't forget to subscribe to the channel so you don't miss any new videos.

quiz.correct_answer: To arrange to receive a publication regularly or to pay to use an online service.

en: To actively cancel a service or publication that you no longer want.
To create new content for a website or a social media platform yourself.
To borrow something from a library for a limited period of time.
uz: Endi istamagan xizmatingiz yoki nashringizni faol ravishda bekor qilish.
Veb-sayt yoki ijtimoiy media platformasi uchun o'zingiz yangi kontent yaratish.
Kutubxonadan cheklangan muddatga biror narsa olish.
ru: Активно отменить услугу или публикацию, которая вам больше не нужна.
Создавать новый контент для веб-сайта или платформы социальных сетей самостоятельно.
Брать что-либо из библиотеки на ограниченный срок.

translation.en: Something that spreads extremely quickly and widely on the internet, like a video or meme.
translation.uz: Internetda juda tez va keng tarqaladigan narsa, masalan, video yoki mem.
translation.ru: Что-то, что распространяется чрезвычайно быстро и широко в интернете, как видео или мем.

example: That funny cat video went viral overnight and everyone was sharing it.
Companies hope their marketing campaigns will go viral to reach many people.
The challenge quickly became viral on TikTok, with millions participating.

quiz.correct_answer: Something that spreads extremely quickly and widely on the internet, like a video or meme.

en: A type of computer virus that damages software on your device.
An old-fashioned, traditional way of sharing information with close friends.
A highly secretive message that is only known by a small group.
uz: Qurilmangizdagi dasturiy ta'minotni buzadigan kompyuter virusi turi.
Yaqa do'stlar bilan ma'lumot almashishning eski, an'anaviy usuli.
Kichik guruhga ma'lum bo'lgan juda maxfiy xabar.
ru: Тип компьютерного вируса, который повреждает программное обеспечение на вашем устройстве.
Старомодный, традиционный способ обмена информацией с близкими друзьями.
Сверхсекретное сообщение, известное только небольшой группе.
