translation.en: The activity of listening to or watching sound or video directly from the internet.
translation.uz: Ovoz yoki videoni internetdan to'g'ridan-to'g'ri tinglash yoki tomosha qilish faoliyati.
translation.ru: Активность прослушивания или просмотра звука или видео непосредственно из интернета.

example: Many people prefer streaming movies at home instead of going to the cinema.
I spend hours streaming music from my favorite artists every day.
Live streaming of events has become very popular, especially concerts.

quiz.correct_answer: The activity of listening to or watching sound or video directly from the internet.

en: The process of downloading files from the internet to your device.
A method of recording videos on a physical tape or disk for later use.
The act of creating new digital content for personal use and enjoyment.
uz: Internetdan fayllarni qurilmangizga yuklab olish jarayoni.
Videolarni keyinchalik foydalanish uchun jismoniy lentaga yoki diskga yozib olish usuli.
Shaxsiy foydalanish va zavqlanish uchun yangi raqamli kontent yaratish harakati.
ru: Процесс загрузки файлов из интернета на ваше устройство.
Метод записи видео на физическую ленту или диск для последующего использования.
Создание нового цифрового контента для личного использования и удовольствия.

translation.en: An advertisement on television or radio, or in a public place.
translation.uz: Televizor yoki radioda, yoki jamoat joyida ko'rsatiladigan reklama.
translation.ru: Реклама на телевидении или радио, или в общественном месте.

example: I hate it when a good film is interrupted by too many commercials.
The Super Bowl is famous for its expensive and creative commercials.
We saw a commercial for the new car during the news program tonight.

quiz.correct_answer: An advertisement on television or radio, or in a public place.

en: A long, in-depth documentary that explores a specific topic in detail.
A short news report about current events happening around the world.
A popular song played frequently on the radio throughout the day.
uz: Muayyan mavzuni batafsil o'rganadigan uzoq, chuqur hujjatli film.
Butun dunyoda sodir bo'layotgan joriy voqealar haqidagi qisqa yangiliklar hisoboti.
Kun davomida radioda tez-tez ijro etiladigan mashhur qo'shiq.
ru: Длинный, глубокий документальный фильм, подробно исследующий конкретную тему.
Короткий новостной репортаж о текущих событиях, происходящих по всему миру.
Популярная песня, часто звучащая по радио в течение дня.

translation.en: A film or TV program presenting facts about a subject.
translation.uz: Mavzu bo'yicha faktlarni taqdim etuvchi film yoki teleko'rsatuv.
translation.ru: Фильм или телепрограмма, представляющая факты по какой-либо теме.

example: I watched an interesting documentary about ancient Egyptian history.
Many streaming platforms offer a wide range of documentaries.
The director spent years making this powerful documentary.

quiz.correct_answer: A film or TV program presenting facts about a subject.

en: A fictional story with imaginary characters and events for entertainment.
A live performance on stage with actors and a prepared script.
A short musical video designed to promote a new song or album.
uz: Ko'ngil ochish uchun xayoliy qahramonlar va voqealar bilan to'qima hikoya.
Aktyorlar va tayyor ssenariy bilan sahnadagi jonli ijro.
Yangi qo'shiq yoki albomni targ'ib qilish uchun mo'ljallangan qisqa musiqiy video.
ru: Вымышленная история с вымышленными персонажами и событиями для развлечения.
Живое выступление на сцене с актерами и заранее подготовленным сценарием.
Короткий музыкальный видеоклип, предназначенный для продвижения новой песни или альбома.

translation.en: A digital audio file available on the internet, often part of a series.
translation.uz: Internetda mavjud bo'lgan, ko'pincha seriyaning bir qismi bo'lgan raqamli audio fayl.
translation.ru: Цифровой аудиофайл, доступный в интернете, часто являющийся частью серии.

example: I listen to a true crime podcast during my morning commute.
There are podcasts on almost any topic you can imagine.
He started his own podcast about local history and culture.

quiz.correct_answer: A digital audio file available on the internet, often part of a series.

en: A short written article published on a website or blog.
A live video broadcast of an event happening in real-time.
A type of social media platform for sharing short text messages.
uz: Veb-sayt yoki blogda chop etilgan qisqa yozma maqola.
Haqiqiy vaqtda sodir bo'layotgan voqea-hodisaning jonli video translyatsiyasi.
Qisqa matnli xabarlarni almashish uchun ijtimoiy media platformasi turi.
ru: Короткая письменная статья, опубликованная на веб-сайте или в блоге.
Прямая видеотрансляция события, происходящего в реальном времени.
Тип платформы социальных сетей для обмена короткими текстовыми сообщениями.

translation.en: A book or other product that is among those that are sold most.
translation.uz: Eng ko'p sotiladigan kitob yoki boshqa mahsulot.
translation.ru: Книга или другой продукт, который входит в число самых продаваемых.

example: Her latest novel became a bestseller just weeks after its release.
The new smartphone is expected to be a global bestseller this year.
He dreams of writing a bestseller that everyone will read.

quiz.correct_answer: A book or other product that is among those that are sold most.

en: A very old and rare book that is difficult to find anywhere.
A product that is designed for a very small and specific market.
A movie that was extremely popular decades ago but is now forgotten.
uz: Hech qayerda topish qiyin bo'lgan juda eski va noyob kitob.
Juda kichik va aniq bozor uchun mo'ljallangan mahsulot.
O'nlab yillar oldin juda mashhur bo'lgan, ammo hozir unutilgan film.
ru: Очень старая и редкая книга, которую трудно найти где-либо.
Продукт, разработанный для очень маленького и специфического рынка.
Фильм, который был чрезвычайно популярен десятилетия назад, но теперь забыт.

translation.en: People whose job is to give their opinions about films, books, music, etc.
translation.uz: Filmlar, kitoblar, musiqa va boshqalar haqida o'z fikrlarini bildirish ishiga ega bo'lgan odamlar.
translation.ru: Люди, чья работа состоит в том, чтобы высказывать свое мнение о фильмах, книгах, музыке и т.д.

example: The film received mixed reviews from the critics.
Critics praised her performance as groundbreaking and unforgettable.
He ignores what the critics say and enjoys films based on his own taste.

quiz.correct_answer: People whose job is to give their opinions about films, books, music, etc.

en: Individuals who produce and direct films or create musical compositions.
People who are responsible for selling tickets at a cinema or theater.
Audiences who attend cultural events for pure entertainment and relaxation.
uz: Filmlarni ishlab chiqaradigan va rejissyorlik qiladigan yoki musiqiy asarlar yaratadigan shaxslar.
Kinoteatr yoki teatrda chipta sotish uchun mas'ul bo'lgan odamlar.
Sof ko'ngil ochish va dam olish uchun madaniy tadbirlarda ishtirok etadigan tomoshabinlar.
ru: Люди, которые продюсируют и снимают фильмы или создают музыкальные композиции.
Люди, отвечающие за продажу билетов в кинотеатре или театре.
Зрители, посещающие культурные мероприятия исключительно для развлечения и отдыха.

translation.en: Websites and applications that enable users to create and share content or participate in social networking.
translation.uz: Foydalanuvchilarga kontent yaratish va ulashish yoki ijtimoiy tarmoqda ishtirok etish imkonini beruvchi veb-saytlar va ilovalar.
translation.ru: Веб-сайты и приложения, которые позволяют пользователям создавать и делиться контентом или участвовать в социальных сетях.

example: Many people get their news from social media nowadays, rather than newspapers.
She uses social media to connect with friends and share photos.
Be careful what you post on social media; it stays there forever.

quiz.correct_answer: Websites and applications that enable users to create and share content or participate in social networking.

en: Traditional forms of media like print newspapers and broadcast radio.
Private messaging applications used for one-on-one communication only.
Online encyclopedias and databases that provide factual information.
uz: Bosma gazetalar va radio eshittirishlari kabi an'anaviy media shakllari.
Faqat birma-bir muloqot uchun ishlatiladigan shaxsiy xabar almashish ilovalari.
Faktik ma'lumotlarni taqdim etuvchi onlayn ensiklopediyalar va ma'lumotlar bazalari.
ru: Традиционные формы СМИ, такие как печатные газеты и радиовещание.
Приложения для личных сообщений, используемые только для общения один на один.
Онлайн-энциклопедии и базы данных, предоставляющие фактическую информацию.

translation.en: The place in a theatre or cinema where tickets are sold, or a measure of how popular a film or play is by the amount of money it makes.
translation.uz: Teatr yoki kinoteatrda chiptalar sotiladigan joy, yoki film yoki spektaklning qanchalik mashhur ekanligini uning daromadi bilan o'lchash.
translation.ru: Место в театре или кинотеатре, где продаются билеты, или показатель популярности фильма или пьесы по сумме денег, которую он зарабатывает.

example: The new action movie was a huge box office success on its opening weekend.
You can buy tickets for the concert at the box office downstairs.
Despite good reviews, the film did poorly at the box office.

quiz.correct_answer: The place in a theatre or cinema where tickets are sold, or a measure of how popular a film or play is by the amount of money it makes.

en: The stage where actors perform their roles in front of an audience.
The area where film directors edit and produce their cinematic works.
A small, private room where actors prepare for their performances.
uz: Aktyorlar tomoshabinlar oldida o'z rollarini ijro etadigan sahna.
Film rejissyorlari o'zlarining kinematik asarlarini tahrirlaydigan va ishlab chiqaradigan joy.
Aktyorlar o'z chiqishlariga tayyorgarlik ko'radigan kichik, shaxsiy xona.
ru: Сцена, где актеры исполняют свои роли перед зрителями.
Место, где кинорежиссеры монтируют и производят свои кинематографические работы.
Небольшая частная комната, где актеры готовятся к своим выступлениям.

translation.en: The music used in a film or television program.
translation.uz: Film yoki teleko'rsatuvda ishlatiladigan musiqa.
translation.ru: Музыка, используемая в фильме или телевизионной программе.

example: I loved the movie, especially its amazing soundtrack.
The film's soundtrack became very popular and sold millions of copies.
She often listens to movie soundtracks while she's working.

quiz.correct_answer: The music used in a film or television program.

en: The written script that contains all the dialogue and stage directions.
The special visual effects that are added to a movie scene.
The overall story and main plot events of a film production.
uz: Barcha dialoglar va sahna yo'nalishlarini o'z ichiga olgan yozma ssenariy.
Film sahnasiga qo'shiladigan maxsus vizual effektlar.
Film ishlab chiqarishning umumiy hikoyasi va asosiy syujet voqealari.
ru: Письменный сценарий, содержащий все диалоги и сценические указания.
Специальные визуальные эффекты, добавляемые к сцене фильма.
Общая история и основные сюжетные события кинопроизводства.

translation.en: A film, television drama, or play that has been made from a book or play.
translation.uz: Kitob yoki spektakldan ishlangan film, televideniye dramasi yoki spektakl.
translation.ru: Фильм, телевизионная драма или пьеса, созданные по книге или пьесе.

example: The film adaptation of the novel was very well received by audiences.
Many classic books have been turned into successful screen adaptations.
This TV series is an adaptation of a famous historical event.

quiz.correct_answer: A film, television drama, or play that has been made from a book or play.

en: The original, first version of a story before any changes are made.
A critical analysis of a film's artistic merits and technical aspects.
The process of writing an original story specifically for the screen.
uz: Hikoyaning hech qanday o'zgarish kiritilmagan asl, birinchi versiyasi.
Filmning badiiy fazilatlari va texnik jihatlarini tanqidiy tahlil qilish.
Ekran uchun maxsus asl hikoya yozish jarayoni.
ru: Оригинальная, первая версия истории до внесения каких-либо изменений.
Критический анализ художественных достоинств и технических аспектов фильма.
Процесс написания оригинальной истории специально для экрана.

translation.en: Literature that describes imaginary events and people, not real ones.
translation.uz: Tasavvur qilingan voqealar va odamlarni tasvirlaydigan adabiyot, haqiqiy emas.
translation.ru: Литература, описывающая вымышленные события и людей, а не реальные.

example: I mostly read fiction, especially fantasy and historical novels.
This author is known for writing compelling works of historical fiction.
Is this story true, or is it pure fiction you made up?

quiz.correct_answer: Literature that describes imaginary events and people, not real ones.

en: A factual account of real events, often based on true historical records.
News reports and articles that discuss current events and issues.
Textbooks and academic papers that provide scientific information.
uz: Ko'pincha haqiqiy tarixiy yozuvlarga asoslangan, real voqealarning faktik hisoboti.
Joriy voqealar va masalalarni muhokama qiladigan yangiliklar hisobotlari va maqolalar.
Ilmiy ma'lumotlarni taqdim etuvchi darsliklar va akademik maqolalar.
ru: Фактический отчет о реальных событиях, часто основанный на подлинных исторических записях.
Новостные репортажи и статьи, обсуждающие текущие события и проблемы.
Учебники и научные работы, предоставляющие научную информацию.

translation.en: Writing that is based on facts, real events, and real people, such as biography or history.
translation.uz: Faktlarga, haqiqiy voqealarga va haqiqiy odamlarga asoslangan yozuv, masalan, biografiya yoki tarix.
translation.ru: Письменность, основанная на фактах, реальных событиях и реальных людях, таких как биография или история.

example: He prefers reading non-fiction books about science and philosophy.
The library has a large section dedicated to non-fiction works.
Is this a novel or a non-fiction account of the expedition?

quiz.correct_answer: Writing that is based on facts, real events, and real people, such as biography or history.

en: Fictional stories that are entirely made up by the author's imagination.
Poetry and dramatic plays that focus on emotional expression.
Children's storybooks with simple narratives and colorful illustrations.
uz: Muallifning tasavvuri bilan to'liq to'qilgan to'qima hikoyalar.
Hissiy ifodaga e'tibor qaratilgan she'riyat va dramatik pyesalar.
Oddiy hikoyalar va rangli rasmlar bilan bolalar hikoya kitoblari.
ru: Вымышленные истории, полностью придуманные воображением автора.
Поэзия и драматические пьесы, которые сосредоточены на эмоциональном выражении.
Детские сборники рассказов с простыми повествованиями и красочными иллюстрациями.

translation.en: A humorous television series about the daily lives of a group of characters.
translation.uz: Bir guruh qahramonlarning kundalik hayoti haqidagi kulgili televizion serial.
translation.ru: Юмористический телевизионный сериал о повседневной жизни группы персонажей.

example: Friends is a classic American sitcom that is still popular today.
I enjoy watching sitcoms after a long day to relax and laugh.
The new sitcom has a very talented cast and clever writing.

quiz.correct_answer: A humorous television series about the daily lives of a group of characters.

en: A serious drama series that focuses on intense emotional conflicts.
A news program that reports on current events and political issues.
A reality TV show that follows real people in unscripted situations.
uz: Kuchli hissiy mojarolarga qaratilgan jiddiy drama seriali.
Joriy voqealar va siyosiy masalalar haqida xabar beruvchi yangiliklar dasturi.
Skriptsiz vaziyatlarda haqiqiy odamlarni kuzatadigan realiti-shou.
ru: Серьезный драматический сериал, который фокусируется на интенсивных эмоциональных конфликтах.
Новостная программа, которая сообщает о текущих событиях и политических вопросах.
Реалити-шоу, которое следит за реальными людьми в неписаных ситуациях.

translation.en: A television or radio drama series dealing with daily events in the lives of the same group of characters.
translation.uz: Bir guruh qahramonlarning kundalik hayotidagi voqealarni hikoya qiluvchi televizion yoki radio drama seriali.
translation.ru: Телевизионный или радиодраматический сериал, рассказывающий о повседневных событиях в жизни одной и той же группы персонажей.

example: My grandmother loves watching her favorite soap opera every afternoon.
Soap operas are known for their dramatic storylines and cliffhangers.
The characters in this soap opera have been on screen for decades.

quiz.correct_answer: A television or radio drama series dealing with daily events in the lives of the same group of characters.

en: A short, educational documentary about a scientific discovery.
A competitive reality show where participants compete for a prize.
A factual news report about international political affairs.
uz: Ilmiy kashfiyot haqidagi qisqa, ta'limiy hujjatli film.
Ishtirokchilar mukofot uchun raqobatlashadigan raqobatbardosh realiti-shou.
Xalqaro siyosiy masalalar haqidagi faktik yangiliklar hisoboti.
ru: Короткий образовательный документальный фильм о научном открытии.
Соревновательное реалити-шоу, где участники соревнуются за приз.
Фактический новостной репортаж о международных политических делах.

translation.en: A type of newspaper that has small pages, many pictures, and short, often sensational, articles.
translation.uz: Kichik sahifali, ko'p rasmli va qisqa, ko'pincha shov-shuvli maqolalardan iborat gazeta turi.
translation.ru: Тип газеты с маленькими страницами, множеством картинок и короткими, часто сенсационными статьями.

example: He only reads the tabloid newspapers for their celebrity gossip.
Tabloids are often criticized for their lack of serious journalism.
The scandalous headline was typical of a tabloid newspaper.

quiz.correct_answer: A type of newspaper that has small pages, many pictures, and short, often sensational, articles.

en: A serious, academic journal that publishes scientific research papers.
A highly respected newspaper known for its in-depth political analysis.
A magazine focused solely on fashion and high-end lifestyle brands.
uz: Ilmiy tadqiqot maqolalarini nashr etadigan jiddiy, akademik jurnal.
Chuqur siyosiy tahlili bilan tanilgan juda hurmatli gazeta.
Faqat moda va yuqori darajadagi turmush tarzi brendlariga qaratilgan jurnal.
ru: Серьезный академический журнал, публикующий научные исследования.
Уважаемая газета, известная своим глубоким политическим анализом.
Журнал, посвященный исключительно моде и элитным брендам.

translation.en: A newspaper with a large format, generally associated with serious news.
translation.uz: Katta formatli, odatda jiddiy yangiliklar bilan bog'liq bo'lgan gazeta.
translation.ru: Газета большого формата, обычно ассоциирующаяся с серьезными новостями.

example: She prefers reading a broadsheet for its detailed political commentary.
The broadsheet provided an extensive analysis of the economic situation.
Unlike tabloids, broadsheets typically focus on in-depth reporting.

quiz.correct_answer: A newspaper with a large format, generally associated with serious news.

en: A small, compact newspaper that focuses on celebrity gossip.
A comic book with colorful illustrations and simple narratives.
A magazine dedicated to popular culture and entertainment news.
uz: Mashhur shaxslar g'iybatlariga e'tibor qaratadigan kichik, ixcham gazeta.
Rangli rasmlar va oddiy hikoyalar bilan komiks.
Ommabop madaniyat va ko'ngil ochish yangiliklariga bag'ishlangan jurnal.
ru: Маленькая, компактная газета, посвященная сплетням о знаменитостях.
Комикс с красочными иллюстрациями и простыми повествованиями.
Журнал, посвященный популярной культуре и новостям развлечений.

translation.en: A television station and its programs.
translation.uz: Televizion stansiya va uning dasturlari.
translation.ru: Телевизионный канал и его программы.

example: What channel is the football match on tonight?
There are so many channels now, it's hard to choose what to watch.
She constantly switches channels to avoid the commercials.

quiz.correct_answer: A television station and its programs.

en: A short break within a television show for advertisements.
A small button on a remote control for changing TV stations.
The person who presents the news on a television program.
uz: Reklamalar uchun televizion shou ichidagi qisqa tanaffus.
Televizion stansiyalarni o'zgartirish uchun masofadan boshqarish pultidagi kichik tugma.
Televizion dasturda yangiliklarni taqdim etadigan shaxs.
ru: Короткий перерыв в телешоу для рекламы.
Маленькая кнопка на пульте дистанционного управления для переключения телеканалов.
Человек, который ведет новости в телевизионной программе.

translation.en: A person who is proficient in sports and other forms of physical exercise.
translation.uz: Sport va jismoniy mashqlar bilan shug'ullanadigan malakali shaxs.
translation.ru: Человек, искусно занимающийся спортом и другими видами физических упражнений.

example: The athlete trained daily for the marathon.
Being a professional athlete requires immense dedication.
Many young athletes dream of competing in the Olympics.

quiz.correct_answer: A person who is proficient in sports and other forms of physical exercise.

en: Someone who enjoys watching various sports events and competitions.
A coach who trains a team for different sporting events.
A spectator who attends many professional sports matches regularly.
uz: Turli sport tadbirlari va musobaqalarni tomosha qilishni yaxshi ko'radigan kishi.
Turli sport tadbirlari uchun jamoani tayyorlaydigan murabbiy.
Ko'plab professional sport o'yinlariga muntazam qatnaydigan tomoshabin.
ru: Тот, кто любит смотреть различные спортивные мероприятия и соревнования.
Тренер, который тренирует команду для различных спортивных мероприятий.
Зритель, который регулярно посещает многие профессиональные спортивные матчи.

translation.en: A competition to determine a champion, often in sports.
translation.uz: Chempionni aniqlash uchun o'tkaziladigan musobaqa, ko'pincha sportda.
translation.ru: Соревнование для определения чемпиона, часто в спорте.

example: They won the national basketball championship last year.
The team is preparing for the world championship.
It was a thrilling championship match that went into extra time.

quiz.correct_answer: A competition to determine a champion, often in sports.

en: A friendly game played between two teams for practice.
A regular season match that does not affect the standings.
An event where participants showcase their skills without competing.
uz: Ikki jamoa o'rtasida mashg'ulot uchun o'tkaziladigan do'stona o'yin.
Jadvalga ta'sir qilmaydigan muntazam mavsum o'yini.
Ishtirokchilar musobaqalashmasdan o'z mahoratini namoyish etadigan tadbir.
ru: Товарищеская игра, проводимая между двумя командами для тренировки.
Матч регулярного сезона, который не влияет на турнирную таблицу.
Мероприятие, где участники демонстрируют свои навыки без соревнований.

translation.en: A person who trains and instructs athletes or a sports team.
translation.uz: Sportchilarni yoki sport jamoasini o'rgatadigan va yo'naltiradigan shaxs.
translation.ru: Человек, который тренирует и инструктирует спортсменов или спортивную команду.

example: The coach gave them excellent advice before the game.
She decided to become a swimming coach after retiring.
Our new coach focuses on teamwork and strategy.

quiz.correct_answer: A person who trains and instructs athletes or a sports team.

en: A sports commentator who describes a game as it happens live.
An official who makes sure players follow the rules of the sport.
A fan who supports a specific team by attending all their games.
uz: O'yinni jonli ravishda tasvirlaydigan sport sharhlovchisi.
O'yinchilar sport qoidalariga rioya qilishlarini ta'minlaydigan rasmiy.
O'z jamoasini barcha o'yinlariga qatnashib qo'llab-quvvatlaydigan muxlis.
ru: Спортивный комментатор, который описывает игру в прямом эфире.
Официальное лицо, которое следит за соблюдением игроками правил спорта.
Фанатик, который поддерживает определенную команду, посещая все ее игры.

translation.en: An event in which people compete against each other to win.
translation.uz: G'alaba qozonish uchun odamlar bir-biriga qarshi raqobatlashadigan tadbir.
translation.ru: Мероприятие, в котором люди соревнуются друг с другом, чтобы выиграть.

example: There's fierce competition among the top athletes.
He entered a cycling competition last weekend.
The school organized a swimming competition for all students.

quiz.correct_answer: An event in which people compete against each other to win.

en: A casual meeting where people discuss various topics freely.
A performance where artists display their talents without scoring.
A peaceful gathering designed for social interaction and networking.
uz: Odamlar turli mavzularni erkin muhokama qiladigan norasmiy uchrashuv.
San'atkorlar o'z iste'dodlarini ballarsiz namoyish etadigan spektakl.
Ijtimoiy o'zaro aloqa va tarmoq uchun mo'ljallangan tinch yig'ilish.
ru: Неформальная встреча, где люди свободно обсуждают различные темы.
Выступление, где артисты демонстрируют свои таланты без набора очков.
Мирное собрание, предназначенное для социального взаимодействия и нетворкинга.

translation.en: The state of being physically healthy and strong.
translation.uz: Jismonan sog'lom va kuchli bo'lish holati.
translation.ru: Состояние физического здоровья и силы.

example: She goes to the gym to maintain her fitness.
Regular exercise is key to good fitness.
His fitness level improved significantly after consistent training.

quiz.correct_answer: The state of being physically healthy and strong.

en: The ability to understand and express complex emotions.
A measure of one's academic achievements and intellect.
The condition of being financially secure and stable.
uz: Murakkab his-tuyg'ularni tushunish va ifodalash qobiliyati.
O'zining akademik yutuqlari va intellektining o'lchovi.
Moliyaviy jihatdan xavfsiz va barqaror bo'lish holati.
ru: Способность понимать и выражать сложные эмоции.
Показатель академических достижений и интеллекта человека.
Состояние финансовой обеспеченности и стабильности.

translation.en: A building or club where people go to exercise.
translation.uz: Odamlar sport bilan shug'ullanadigan bino yoki klub.
translation.ru: Здание или клуб, куда люди ходят заниматься спортом.

example: I try to go to the gym three times a week.
The gym has a variety of modern equipment.
Joining a gym can help you stay motivated.

quiz.correct_answer: A building or club where people go to exercise.

en: A place where people watch live sports matches regularly.
A restaurant that serves healthy food options for athletes.
A store where sports equipment and apparel are sold.
uz: Odamlar muntazam ravishda jonli sport o'yinlarini tomosha qiladigan joy.
Sportchilar uchun sog'lom ovqatlanish variantlarini taklif qiladigan restoran.
Sport anjomlari va kiyimlari sotiladigan do'kon.
ru: Место, где люди регулярно смотрят спортивные матчи в прямом эфире.
Ресторан, который подает здоровую пищу для спортсменов.
Магазин, где продаются спортивное оборудование и одежда.

translation.en: Running at a slow, regular speed, especially as a form of exercise.
translation.uz: Sekin, muntazam tezlikda yugurish, ayniqsa mashq qilish sifatida.
translation.ru: Бег в медленном, равномерном темпе, особенно в качестве физического упражнения.

example: She enjoys jogging in the park every morning.
Jogging is a great way to improve cardiovascular health.
I saw him jogging along the river path yesterday afternoon.

quiz.correct_answer: Running at a slow, regular speed, especially as a form of exercise.

en: Swimming quickly in a pool for competitive purposes.
Lifting heavy weights repeatedly to build muscle mass.
Performing rapid, short bursts of intense physical activity.
uz: Raqobat maqsadlarida hovuzda tez suzish.
Mushak massasini qurish uchun og'ir vaznlarni qayta-qayta ko'tarish.
Jadal jismoniy faoliyatning tez, qisqa portlashlarini bajarish.
ru: Быстрое плавание в бассейне для соревновательных целей.
Многократное поднятие тяжелых весов для наращивания мышечной массы.
Выполнение быстрых, коротких всплесков интенсивной физической активности.

translation.en: A contest in which people or teams compete against each other.
translation.uz: Odamlar yoki jamoalar bir-biriga qarshi raqobatlashadigan musobaqa.
translation.ru: Соревнование, в котором люди или команды соревнуются друг с другом.

example: The football match was postponed due to heavy rain.
They won the tennis match in straight sets.
Are you going to watch the boxing match tonight?

quiz.correct_answer: A contest in which people or teams compete against each other.

en: A friendly gathering where people share common interests.
A training session for athletes to practice new skills.
An official meeting to discuss rules and regulations of a sport.
uz: Odamlar umumiy qiziqishlarini baham ko'radigan do'stona yig'ilish.
Sportchilar uchun yangi ko'nikmalarni mashq qilish uchun mashg'ulot.
Sport qoidalari va nizomlarini muhokama qilish uchun rasmiy yig'ilish.
ru: Дружеская встреча, где люди делятся общими интересами.
Тренировка для спортсменов для отработки новых навыков.
Официальное собрание для обсуждения правил и положений спорта.

translation.en: The number of points, goals, runs, etc., achieved in a game or contest.
translation.uz: O'yin yoki musobaqada erishilgan ballar, gollar, yugurishlar va boshqalar soni.
translation.ru: Количество очков, голов, пробежек и т.д., набранных в игре или соревновании.

example: What's the current score of the basketball game?
He scored a brilliant goal in the last minute.
The final score was 3-2 in favor of the home team.

quiz.correct_answer: The number of points, goals, runs, etc., achieved in a game or contest.

en: The time limit set for completing a particular sports event.
The specific strategy a team uses to win a difficult match.
The name of the main referee who controls the game flow.
uz: Ma'lum bir sport tadbirini yakunlash uchun belgilangan vaqt chegarasi.
Jamoa qiyin o'yinni yutish uchun foydalanadigan o'ziga xos strategiya.
O'yin jarayonini nazorat qiluvchi bosh hakamning ismi.
ru: Ограничение по времени для завершения определенного спортивного события.
Конкретная стратегия, которую команда использует для победы в сложном матче.
Имя главного судьи, который контролирует ход игры.

translation.en: A session of physical exercise or training.
translation.uz: Jismoniy mashqlar yoki mashg'ulotlar sessiyasi.
translation.ru: Сеанс физических упражнений или тренировок.

example: I had an intense workout at the gym today.
She plans her workout routine carefully each week.
A quick morning workout helps me feel energized for the day.

quiz.correct_answer: A session of physical exercise or training.

en: A social gathering for people to discuss health topics.
A type of healthy meal plan for athletes to follow.
A method of relaxing after strenuous physical activity.
uz: Odamlar sog'liq mavzularini muhokama qilish uchun ijtimoiy yig'ilish.
Sportchilar rioya qilishi kerak bo'lgan sog'lom ovqatlanish rejasi turi.
Jismoniy mashaqqatli faoliyatdan keyin dam olish usuli.
ru: Социальное собрание для обсуждения вопросов здоровья.
Тип плана здорового питания для спортсменов.
Метод расслабления после напряженной физической активности.

translation.en: A way of living that lowers the risk of illness and increases well-being.
translation.uz: Kasallik xavfini kamaytiradigan va farovonlikni oshiradigan turmush tarzi.
translation.ru: Образ жизни, который снижает риск заболеваний и улучшает самочувствие.

example: Eating well and exercising are part of a healthy lifestyle.
She tries to maintain a healthy lifestyle for longevity.
Promoting a healthy lifestyle is crucial for public health.

quiz.correct_answer: A way of living that lowers the risk of illness and increases well-being.

en: A diet plan focused on rapid weight loss over a short period.
A medical treatment designed to cure a specific type of illness.
A financial strategy to save money for future retirement plans.
uz: Qisqa muddat ichida tez vazn yo'qotishga qaratilgan parhez rejasi.
Ma'lum bir kasallik turini davolash uchun mo'ljallangan tibbiy muolaja.
Kelajakdagi pensiya rejalariga pul tejash uchun moliyaviy strategiya.
ru: План диеты, ориентированный на быстрое снижение веса за короткий период.
Медицинское лечение, предназначенное для излечения определенного типа заболевания.
Финансовая стратегия накопления денег для будущих пенсионных планов.

translation.en: The ability to continue doing something for a long time without getting tired.
translation.uz: Uzoq vaqt davomida charchamasdan biror narsani davom ettirish qobiliyati.
translation.ru: Способность продолжать делать что-либо в течение длительного времени, не уставая.

example: Marathon runners need incredible endurance.
Cycling long distances builds endurance.
Her endurance was tested during the challenging hike.

quiz.correct_answer: The ability to continue doing something for a long time without getting tired.

en: The skill to perform complex acrobatic movements easily.
The speed at which an athlete can complete a short race.
The capacity to lift very heavy objects with minimal effort.
uz: Murakkab akrobatik harakatlarni oson bajarish qobiliyati.
Sportchining qisqa masofani bosib o'tish tezligi.
Juda og'ir narsalarni minimal kuch bilan ko'tarish qobiliyati.
ru: Навык легко выполнять сложные акробатические движения.
Скорость, с которой спортсмен может завершить короткую дистанцию.
Способность поднимать очень тяжелые предметы с минимальными усилиями.

translation.en: A large sports ground with stands for spectators.
translation.uz: Tomoshabinlar uchun tribunali katta sport maydoni.
translation.ru: Большая спортивная площадка с трибунами для зрителей.

example: Thousands of fans gathered at the stadium for the concert.
The new stadium has a retractable roof.
They plan to build a multi-purpose stadium in the city center.

quiz.correct_answer: A large sports ground with stands for spectators.

en: A small, indoor gym for private training sessions.
A specialized medical clinic for treating sports injuries.
A shop that sells sports equipment and team jerseys.
uz: Shaxsiy mashg'ulotlar uchun kichik, yopiq sport zali.
Sport jarohatlarini davolash uchun ixtisoslashtirilgan tibbiy klinika.
Sport anjomlari va jamoa liboslari sotiladigan do'kon.
ru: Небольшой крытый спортзал для индивидуальных тренировок.
Специализированная медицинская клиника для лечения спортивных травм.
Магазин, который продает спортивное оборудование и командные майки.

translation.en: Gentle exercise to prepare your body for more strenuous activity.
translation.uz: Jismoniy faoliyatga tayyorlash uchun yengil mashqlar.
translation.ru: Легкие упражнения для подготовки тела к более интенсивной активности.

example: Always do a warm-up before you start running.
The team did a quick warm-up before the game.
A proper warm-up prevents muscle injuries during exercise.

quiz.correct_answer: Gentle exercise to prepare your body for more strenuous activity.

en: A deep stretching routine performed after a workout ends.
A short break taken during an intense training session.
A competitive game played between two teams for points.
uz: Mashg'ulot tugaganidan keyin bajariladigan chuqur cho'zish mashqlari.
Jadal mashg'ulot paytida olinadigan qisqa tanaffus.
Ikki jamoa o'rtasida ochkolar uchun o'ynaladigan raqobatli o'yin.
ru: Глубокая растяжка, выполняемая после окончания тренировки.
Короткий перерыв, сделанный во время интенсивной тренировки.
Соревновательная игра между двумя командами за очки.

translation.en: Gentle exercises to slow your heart rate and body temperature after physical activity.
translation.uz: Jismoniy faoliyatdan keyin yurak urish tezligi va tana haroratini pasaytirish uchun yengil mashqlar.
translation.ru: Легкие упражнения для замедления частоты сердечных сокращений и температуры тела после физической активности.

example: Always do a cool-down after your intense workout.
The cool-down prevents muscle soreness the next day.
We finished our run with a gentle cool-down walk.

quiz.correct_answer: Gentle exercises to slow your heart rate and body temperature after physical activity.

en: A sudden increase in exercise intensity at the start of training.
A period of rest and sleep required before a major competition.
A dietary plan designed to maximize energy intake for performance.
uz: Mashg'ulot boshida jismoniy mashqlar intensivligining to'satdan oshishi.
Katta musobaqadan oldin talab qilinadigan dam olish va uyqu davri.
Ishlash uchun energiya qabulini maksimal darajada oshirishga qaratilgan parhez rejasi.
ru: Внезапное увеличение интенсивности упражнений в начале тренировки.
Период отдыха и сна, необходимый перед крупным соревнованием.
План питания, предназначенный для максимального потребления энергии для повышения производительности.

translation.en: Exercise that strengthens your heart and improves your overall fitness.
translation.uz: Yurakni mustahkamlaydigan va umumiy jismoniy holatni yaxshilaydigan mashq.
translation.ru: Упражнения, которые укрепляют сердце и улучшают общую физическую форму.

example: Running is a great form of cardio.
She does cardio for 30 minutes every morning.
Regular cardio helps maintain a healthy weight.

quiz.correct_answer: Exercise that strengthens your heart and improves your overall fitness.

en: Exercises focused on building strong muscle mass and strength.
Stretching routines that improve flexibility and range of motion.
Activities that help with mental relaxation and stress reduction.
uz: Kuchli mushak massasi va kuchini qurishga qaratilgan mashqlar.
Moslashuvchanlik va harakat doirasini yaxshilaydigan cho'zish mashqlari.
Ruhiy dam olish va stressni kamaytirishga yordam beradigan faoliyatlar.
ru: Упражнения, направленные на наращивание сильной мышечной массы и силы.
Растяжки, которые улучшают гибкость и диапазон движений.
Занятия, которые помогают в умственной релаксации и снижении стресса.

translation.en: Exercises that build muscle strength and endurance, often using weights.
translation.uz: Mushak kuchini va chidamliligini oshiradigan mashqlar, ko'pincha og'irliklar yordamida.
translation.ru: Упражнения, которые развивают мышечную силу и выносливость, часто с использованием весов.

example: Strength training is important for bone health.
He incorporated strength training into his fitness routine.
You should do strength training two to three times a week.

quiz.correct_answer: Exercises that build muscle strength and endurance, often using weights.

en: Activities that improve your balance and coordination skills.
Gentle movements designed to increase body flexibility.
Aerobic exercises that enhance cardiovascular health and stamina.
uz: Muvozanat va koordinatsiya ko'nikmalarini yaxshilaydigan faoliyatlar.
Tana moslashuvchanligini oshirish uchun mo'ljallangan yengil harakatlar.
Yurak-qon tomir sog'lig'i va chidamliligini oshiradigan aerobik mashqlar.
ru: Занятия, которые улучшают ваши навыки равновесия и координации.
Легкие движения, предназначенные для увеличения гибкости тела.
Аэробные упражнения, которые улучшают сердечно-сосудистое здоровье и выносливость.

translation.en: The process of supplying water to the body to prevent dehydration.
translation.uz: Degidratatsiyani oldini olish uchun tanani suv bilan ta'minlash jarayoni.
translation.ru: Процесс обеспечения организма водой для предотвращения обезвоживания.

example: Proper hydration is essential during exercise.
Drink plenty of water for good hydration.
Lack of hydration can lead to fatigue.

quiz.correct_answer: The process of supplying water to the body to prevent dehydration.

en: The state of being overly nourished from excessive food intake.
The process of removing all liquids from your body completely.
The method of preserving food by drying it thoroughly.
uz: Haddan tashqari ovqatlanishdan ortiqcha to'yinganlik holati.
Tanadan barcha suyuqliklarni to'liq olib tashlash jarayoni.
Oziq-ovqatni to'liq quritish orqali saqlash usuli.
ru: Состояние избыточного питания от чрезмерного потребления пищи.
Процесс полного удаления всех жидкостей из вашего тела.
Метод консервации продуктов путем их тщательной сушки.

translation.en: The kinds of food that a person, animal, or community habitually eats.
translation.uz: Shaxs, hayvon yoki jamiyat odatda iste'mol qiladigan oziq-ovqat turlari.
translation.ru: Виды пищи, которые человек, животное или сообщество обычно едят.

example: A balanced diet is important for overall health.
She follows a vegetarian diet.
His diet includes a lot of fruits and vegetables.

quiz.correct_answer: The kinds of food that a person, animal, or community habitually eats.

en: A specific exercise routine designed for muscle growth.
A short-term plan for losing weight rapidly.
A schedule for daily physical activities and sports.
uz: Mushak o'sishi uchun mo'ljallangan maxsus mashqlar rejimi.
Tez vazn yo'qotish uchun qisqa muddatli reja.
Kundalik jismoniy faoliyat va sport uchun jadval.
ru: Специальный комплекс упражнений, предназначенный для роста мышц.
Краткосрочный план для быстрого похудения.
Расписание ежедневных физических нагрузок и занятий спортом.

translation.en: Engaging or ready to engage in physically energetic pursuits.
translation.uz: Jismoniy faoliyat bilan shug'ullanadigan yoki shug'ullanishga tayyor.
translation.ru: Активный или готовый к физически энергичным занятиям.

example: He leads a very active life.
It's important to stay active as you get older.
An active lifestyle reduces the risk of many diseases.

quiz.correct_answer: Engaging or ready to engage in physically energetic pursuits.

en: Feeling tired and ready for a long rest period.
Someone who prefers to read books over playing sports.
Having a calm and relaxed demeanor at all times.
uz: Charchagan va uzoq dam olishga tayyor his qilish.
Sport o'ynashdan ko'ra kitob o'qishni afzal ko'radigan kishi.
Har doim xotirjam va bo'shashgan holatda bo'lish.
ru: Чувство усталости и готовности к длительному отдыху.
Тот, кто предпочитает читать книги, а не заниматься спортом.
Всегда иметь спокойное и расслабленное поведение.

translation.en: How well a person or machine does a piece of work or an activity.
translation.uz: Inson yoki mashina bir ishni yoki faoliyatni qanchalik yaxshi bajarishi.
translation.ru: Насколько хорошо человек или машина выполняет работу или деятельность.

example: The athlete's performance in the race was outstanding.
Good nutrition can improve sports performance.
His performance improved after consistent training.

quiz.correct_answer: How well a person or machine does a piece of work or an activity.

en: The type of equipment used for a specific sporting event.
The duration of a competitive game or match.
A strategy used to confuse opponents in team sports.
uz: Ma'lum bir sport tadbiri uchun ishlatiladigan uskuna turi.
Raqobatli o'yin yoki uchrashuvning davomiyligi.
Jamoa sportlarida raqiblarni chalg'itish uchun ishlatiladigan strategiya.
ru: Тип оборудования, используемого для конкретного спортивного мероприятия.
Продолжительность соревновательной игры или матча.
Стратегия, используемая для запутывания противников в командных видах спорта.

translation.en: An act of defeating an enemy or opponent in a battle, game, or other contest.
translation.uz: Jang, o'yin yoki boshqa musobaqada dushmanni yoki raqibni mag'lub etish harakati.
translation.ru: Акт победы над врагом или противником в битве, игре или другом состязании.

example: The team celebrated their unexpected victory.
It was a hard-fought victory for the underdog.
Every player contributed to the team's victory.

quiz.correct_answer: An act of defeating an enemy or opponent in a battle, game, or other contest.

en: A serious injury sustained during a sporting event.
A tie score where neither team wins the match.
The preparation phase before the start of a competition.
uz: Sport tadbiri davomida olingan jiddiy jarohat.
Hech bir jamoa o'yinni yutmaydigan durang natija.
Musobaqa boshlanishidan oldingi tayyorgarlik bosqichi.
ru: Серьезная травма, полученная во время спортивного мероприятия.
Ничейный счет, когда ни одна из команд не выигрывает матч.
Фаза подготовки перед началом соревнования.

translation.en: An act of losing to an enemy or opponent in a battle, game, or other contest.
translation.uz: Jang, o'yin yoki boshqa musobaqada dushman yoki raqibga yutqazish harakati.
translation.ru: Акт проигрыша врагу или противнику в битве, игре или другом состязании.

example: The team faced a tough defeat in the final.
They learned valuable lessons from their defeat.
Despite the defeat, they remained optimistic.

quiz.correct_answer: An act of losing to an enemy or opponent in a battle, game, or other contest.

en: A winning strategy used by a dominant sports team.
A drawn game where both teams achieve an equal score.
The beginning of a new sports season with many fresh players.
uz: Hukmron sport jamoasi tomonidan qo'llaniladigan g'olib strategiya.
Ikki jamoa bir xil hisobga erishgan durang o'yin.
Ko'plab yangi o'yinchilar bilan yangi sport mavsumining boshlanishi.
ru: Выигрышная стратегия, используемая доминирующей спортивной командой.
Ничейная игра, в которой обе команды набирают равное количество очков.
Начало нового спортивного сезона с множеством новых игроков.

translation.en: The necessary items for a particular purpose.
translation.uz: Ma'lum bir maqsad uchun zarur bo'lgan narsalar.
translation.ru: Необходимые предметы для определенной цели.

example: Make sure you have the right equipment for hiking.
The gym has a lot of new fitness equipment.
Sports equipment can be expensive to buy.

quiz.correct_answer: The necessary items for a particular purpose.

en: The set of rules governing a specific sport or game.
The nutritional guidelines for athletes to follow daily.
The schedule of upcoming games and sports events.
uz: Ma'lum bir sport yoki o'yinni boshqaruvchi qoidalar to'plami.
Sportchilar uchun har kuni rioya qilinishi kerak bo'lgan ovqatlanish ko'rsatmalari.
Kelgusi o'yinlar va sport tadbirlari jadvali.
ru: Набор правил, регулирующих определенный вид спорта или игру.
Рекомендации по питанию для спортсменов, которым нужно следовать ежедневно.
Расписание предстоящих игр и спортивных мероприятий.

translation.en: An official who watches a game or match closely to ensure that the rules are strictly observed.
translation.uz: O'yin yoki o'yinni qoidalarga qat'iy rioya etilishini ta'minlash uchun diqqat bilan kuzatadigan rasmiy.
translation.ru: Должностное лицо, которое внимательно следит за игрой или матчем, чтобы обеспечить строгое соблюдение правил.

example: The referee made a controversial decision.
Players must respect the referee's calls.
A good referee ensures fair play in the game.

quiz.correct_answer: An official who watches a game or match closely to ensure that the rules are strictly observed.

en: A player who scores the winning point in a critical game.
A fan who loudly supports their favorite sports team.
A coach who gives instructions to the team during a break.
uz: Hal qiluvchi o'yinda g'alaba qozongan o'yinchi.
O'zining sevimli sport jamoasini baland ovozda qo'llab-quvvatlaydigan muxlis.
Tanaffus paytida jamoaga ko'rsatmalar beradigan murabbiy.
ru: Игрок, который забивает победное очко в критической игре.
Болельщик, который громко поддерживает свою любимую спортивную команду.
Тренер, который дает указания команде во время перерыва.

translation.en: A person who watches an event, show, or game, especially as part of an audience.
translation.uz: Tadbir, shou yoki o'yinni tomosha qiladigan shaxs, ayniqsa tomoshabinlar orasida.
translation.ru: Человек, который смотрит событие, шоу или игру, особенно как часть аудитории.

example: Thousands of spectators cheered for their team.
The stadium was full of enthusiastic spectators.
Spectators enjoyed the exciting tennis match.

quiz.correct_answer: A person who watches an event, show, or game, especially as part of an audience.

en: A participant actively involved in playing a sport.
An organizer responsible for planning events.
A journalist reporting live from a sports venue.
uz: Sport o'yinida faol ishtirok etuvchi ishtirokchi.
Tadbirlarni rejalashtirish uchun mas'ul tashkilotchi.
Sport maydonchasidan jonli reportaj beruvchi jurnalist.
ru: Участник, активно участвующий в занятиях спортом.
Организатор, ответственный за планирование мероприятий.
Журналист, ведущий прямой репортаж со спортивного объекта.

translation.en: A person who engages in a pursuit, especially a sport, as a pastime rather than as a profession.
translation.uz: Kasb emas, balki sevimli mashg'ulot sifatida biror ish, ayniqsa sport bilan shug'ullanadigan shaxs.
translation.ru: Человек, занимающийся каким-либо делом, особенно спортом, в качестве хобби, а не профессии.

example: He plays football as an amateur, not a professional.
The tournament is open to both amateur and professional athletes.
Many amateur photographers enjoy capturing sports moments.

quiz.correct_answer: A person who engages in a pursuit, especially a sport, as a pastime rather than as a profession.

en: Someone who plays sports for a living and earns money.
A trainer who coaches young athletes for competitions.
An expert who gives professional advice on sports techniques.
uz: Tirikchilik uchun sport o'ynaydigan va pul topadigan kishi.
Yosh sportchilarni musobaqalarga tayyorlaydigan murabbiy.
Sport texnikalari bo'yicha professional maslahatlar beradigan mutaxassis.
ru: Тот, кто занимается спортом ради заработка и получает деньги.
Тренер, который тренирует молодых спортсменов для соревнований.
Эксперт, который дает профессиональные советы по спортивным техникам.

translation.en: A person who engages in a specified activity as their main paid occupation.
translation.uz: Belgilangan faoliyat bilan asosiy pullik kasb sifatida shug'ullanadigan shaxs.
translation.ru: Человек, который занимается определенной деятельностью в качестве своей основной оплачиваемой работы.

example: She became a professional tennis player last year.
Professional athletes train for many hours a day.
The professional football league attracts top talent.

quiz.correct_answer: A person who engages in a specified activity as their main paid occupation.

en: Someone who enjoys sports as a hobby without earning money.
A beginner who is just starting to learn a new sport.
A fan who regularly attends sporting events for entertainment.
uz: Pul topmasdan sportni sevimli mashg'ulot sifatida yoqtiradigan kishi.
Yangi sport turini o'rganishni boshlagan yangi boshlovchi.
Ko'ngilochar maqsadlarda sport tadbirlariga muntazam qatnaydigan muxlis.
ru: Тот, кто занимается спортом в качестве хобби, не зарабатывая денег.
Новичок, который только начинает изучать новый вид спорта.
Болельщик, который регулярно посещает спортивные мероприятия для развлечения.

translation.en: Activity requiring physical effort, carried out to sustain or improve health and fitness.
translation.uz: Jismoniy harakatni talab qiluvchi faoliyat, salomatlik va jismoniy holatni saqlash yoki yaxshilash uchun amalga oshiriladi.
translation.ru: Деятельность, требующая физических усилий, осуществляемая для поддержания или улучшения здоровья и физической формы.

example: Regular exercise is important for a healthy heart.
She does various exercises to stay in shape.
He developed a new exercise routine for his clients.

quiz.correct_answer: Activity requiring physical effort, carried out to sustain or improve health and fitness.

en: A state of complete mental relaxation and inactivity.
A type of food supplement for athletes to increase energy.
The process of reading and studying for an exam seriously.
uz: To'liq ruhiy dam olish va harakatsizlik holati.
Sportchilar uchun energiyani oshirish uchun oziq-ovqat qo'shimchasining turi.
Imtihonga jiddiy tayyorgarlik ko'rish va o'qish jarayoni.
ru: Состояние полного умственного расслабления и бездействия.
Тип пищевой добавки для спортсменов для увеличения энергии.
Процесс серьезного чтения и подготовки к экзамену.

translation.en: A long-term shift in global or regional climate patterns.
translation.uz: Global yoki mintaqaviy iqlim sharoitlaridagi uzoq muddatli o'zgarish.
translation.ru: Долгосрочное изменение глобальных или региональных климатических условий.

example: Climate change is a major threat to our planet.
Scientists are studying the effects of climate change.
Many countries are working to reduce emissions to combat climate change.

quiz.correct_answer: A long-term shift in global or regional climate patterns.

en: Seasonal weather variations that occur annually in specific areas.
Sudden, short-term extreme weather events like hurricanes or floods.
Daily temperature fluctuations in a local area over a week.
uz: Muayyan hududlarda har yili sodir bo'ladigan mavsumiy ob-havo o'zgarishlari.
To'satdan, qisqa muddatli ekstremal ob-havo hodisalari, masalan, bo'ronlar yoki suv toshqinlari.
Bir hafta davomida mahalliy hududdagi kundalik harorat o'zgarishlari.
ru: Сезонные погодные колебания, которые происходят ежегодно в определенных районах.
Внезапные, краткосрочные экстремальные погодные явления, такие как ураганы или наводнения.
Ежедневные колебания температуры в местной области в течение недели.

translation.en: The protection of animals, plants, and natural resources.
translation.uz: Hayvonlar, o'simliklar va tabiiy resurslarni himoya qilish.
translation.ru: Защита животных, растений и природных ресурсов.

example: Wildlife conservation is crucial for biodiversity.
They are involved in the conservation of ancient forests.
Water conservation is important in drought-prone areas.

quiz.correct_answer: The protection of animals, plants, and natural resources.

en: The process of creating new species through genetic engineering.
The exploration of uninhabited natural habitats for resources.
The expansion of urban areas into previously wild landscapes.
uz: Genetik muhandislik orqali yangi turlarni yaratish jarayoni.
Tabiiy resurslar uchun yashash joylari bo'lmagan tabiiy muhitlarni o'rganish.
Shaharlarning avval yovvoyi bo'lgan landshaftlarga kengayishi.
ru: Процесс создания новых видов с помощью генной инженерии.
Исследование необитаемых природных сред обитания для поиска ресурсов.
Расширение городских территорий на ранее дикие ландшафты.

translation.en: The study of the relationships between living organisms and their environment.
translation.uz: Tirik organizmlar va ularning atrof-muhiti o'rtasidagi munosabatlarni o'rganish.
translation.ru: Изучение взаимосвязей между живыми организмами и их окружающей средой.

example: Ecology is an important field for understanding environmental issues.
She is studying marine ecology at the university.
Understanding local ecology helps in planning conservation projects.

quiz.correct_answer: The study of the relationships between living organisms and their environment.

en: The art of creating beautiful landscape designs for gardens.
The historical analysis of human settlements and their impact.
The chemical composition of various types of industrial waste.
uz: Bog'lar uchun chiroyli landshaft dizaynlarini yaratish san'ati.
Inson yashash joylari va ularning ta'sirini tarixiy tahlil qilish.
Turli xil sanoat chiqindilarining kimyoviy tarkibi.
ru: Искусство создания красивых ландшафтных дизайнов для садов.
Исторический анализ человеческих поселений и их влияния.
Химический состав различных видов промышленных отходов.

translation.en: Gases or other substances released into the air, especially from factories or vehicles.
translation.uz: Havoga chiqariladigan gazlar yoki boshqa moddalar, ayniqsa zavodlar yoki transport vositalaridan.
translation.ru: Газы или другие вещества, выбрасываемые в воздух, особенно из заводов или транспортных средств.

example: Vehicle emissions are a major cause of air pollution.
New regulations aim to reduce industrial emissions.
Carbon emissions contribute to the greenhouse effect.

quiz.correct_answer: Gases or other substances released into the air, especially from factories or vehicles.

en: The protective layers that naturally form around certain planets.
The harmless liquids produced by plants during photosynthesis.
Solid waste materials collected from households for disposal.
uz: Ma'lum sayyoralar atrofida tabiiy ravishda hosil bo'ladigan himoya qatlamlari.
Fotosintez paytida o'simliklar tomonidan ishlab chiqariladigan zararsiz suyuqliklar.
Uy xo'jaliklaridan utilizatsiya qilish uchun yig'ilgan qattiq chiqindi materiallar.
ru: Защитные слои, которые естественным образом образуются вокруг некоторых планет.
Безвредные жидкости, производимые растениями во время фотосинтеза.
Твердые отходы, собираемые из домашних хозяйств для утилизации.

translation.en: The natural world, including the land, water, air, plants, and animals.
translation.uz: Tabiiy dunyo, shu jumladan yer, suv, havo, o'simliklar va hayvonlar.
translation.ru: Природный мир, включающий сушу, воду, воздух, растения и животных.

example: We must protect our environment for future generations.
Pollution has a negative impact on the environment.
Living in a clean environment is essential for health.

quiz.correct_answer: The natural world, including the land, water, air, plants, and animals.

en: The internal working mechanisms of complex machinery.
The specific conditions within a confined laboratory setting.
The social customs and traditions of a particular community.
uz: Murakkab mashinalarning ichki ishlash mexanizmlari.
Cheklangan laboratoriya sharoitidagi o'ziga xos sharoitlar.
Ma'lum bir jamoaning ijtimoiy odatlari va an'analari.
ru: Внутренние рабочие механизмы сложного оборудования.
Конкретные условия в замкнутой лабораторной среде.
Социальные обычаи и традиции конкретного сообщества.

translation.en: A gradual increase in the overall temperature of the Earth's atmosphere.
translation.uz: Yer atmosferasining umumiy haroratining asta-sekin oshishi.
translation.ru: Постепенное повышение общей температуры атмосферы Земли.

example: Global warming is causing polar ice caps to melt.
Reducing fossil fuel use helps combat global warming.
The effects of global warming are becoming more apparent.

quiz.correct_answer: A gradual increase in the overall temperature of the Earth's atmosphere.

en: A sudden drop in global temperatures leading to colder climates.
The cyclical warming and cooling of ocean currents globally.
A brief period of unusually warm weather in a specific region.
uz: Global haroratlarning to'satdan pasayishi, bu sovuqroq iqlimga olib keladi.
Okean oqimlarining global miqyosda tsiklik isishi va sovishi.
Ma'lum bir mintaqada g'ayrioddiy issiq ob-havoning qisqa davri.
ru: Внезапное падение глобальных температур, приводящее к более холодному климату.
Циклическое потепление и охлаждение океанических течений по всему миру.
Короткий период необычно теплой погоды в определенном регионе.

translation.en: The presence in or introduction into the environment of a substance or thing that has harmful or poisonous effects.
translation.uz: Atrof-muhitga zararli yoki zaharli ta'sir ko'rsatadigan modda yoki narsaning mavjudligi yoki kiritilishi.
translation.ru: Присутствие или попадание в окружающую среду вещества или вещи, оказывающих вредное или ядовитое воздействие.

example: Air pollution is a serious problem in many cities.
Industrial waste causes water pollution.
Reducing plastic use helps fight ocean pollution.

quiz.correct_answer: The presence in or introduction into the environment of a substance or thing that has harmful or poisonous effects.

en: The natural process of decomposition of organic materials.
The purification of water for safe drinking purposes.
The scientific analysis of minerals found in soil samples.
uz: Organik materiallarning tabiiy parchalanish jarayoni.
Ichimlik suvi uchun suvni tozalash.
Tuproq namunalarida topilgan minerallarning ilmiy tahlili.
ru: Естественный процесс разложения органических материалов.
Очистка воды для безопасного питья.
Научный анализ минералов, найденных в образцах почвы.

translation.en: Convert waste into reusable material.
translation.uz: Chiqindilarni qayta ishlatiladigan materialga aylantirish.
translation.ru: Превращать отходы в повторно используемый материал.

example: Remember to recycle plastic bottles and paper.
Many communities now recycle glass and aluminum cans.
It's important to recycle old electronics responsibly.

quiz.correct_answer: Convert waste into reusable material.

en: To dispose of waste in designated landfill sites only.
To burn waste materials to generate electrical energy.
To transport waste to distant locations for storage.
uz: Chiqindilarni faqat belgilangan chiqindi poligonlarida utilizatsiya qilish.
Elektr energiyasi ishlab chiqarish uchun chiqindi materiallarni yoqish.
Chiqindilarni saqlash uchun uzoq joylarga tashish.
ru: Утилизировать отходы только на специально отведенных свалках.
Сжигать отходы для выработки электроэнергии.
Транспортировать отходы в отдаленные места для хранения.

translation.en: Energy from a source that is not depleted when used, such as wind or solar power.
translation.uz: Foydalanishda tugamaydigan manbadan, masalan, shamol yoki quyosh energiyasidan olinadigan energiya.
translation.ru: Энергия из источника, который не истощается при использовании, например, ветровая или солнечная энергия.

example: Solar panels are a source of renewable energy.
More countries are investing in renewable energy technologies.
Renewable energy can help reduce our reliance on fossil fuels.

quiz.correct_answer: Energy from a source that is not depleted when used, suchators as wind or solar power.

en: Energy generated from burning coal or natural gas.
Energy obtained from underground geothermal reservoirs.
Energy produced from nuclear fission reactions in plants.
uz: Ko'mir yoki tabiiy gaz yoqishdan olinadigan energiya.
Yer osti geotermal zaxiralaridan olinadigan energiya.
O'simliklardagi yadroviy parchalanish reaktsiyalaridan ishlab chiqariladigan energiya.
ru: Энергия, вырабатываемая при сжигании угля или природного газа.
Энергия, получаемая из подземных геотермальных резервуаров.
Энергия, производимая в результате реакций ядерного деления на электростанциях.

translation.en: Able to be maintained at a certain rate or level; environmentally friendly.
translation.uz: Ma'lum bir tezlikda yoki darajada saqlanishi mumkin bo'lgan; ekologik jihatdan toza.
translation.ru: Способный поддерживаться на определенном уровне; экологически чистый.

example: Sustainable development is key to a better future.
They practice sustainable farming methods.
We need to find sustainable solutions to global issues.

quiz.correct_answer: Able to be maintained at a certain rate or level; environmentally friendly.

en: Designed for short-term use with quick disposal afterward.
Focusing only on maximizing immediate economic profits.
Requiring constant external input and resource consumption.
uz: Qisqa muddatli foydalanish uchun mo'ljallangan, keyin tezda utilizatsiya qilinadi.
Faqat tezkor iqtisodiy foydani maksimallashtirishga qaratilgan.
Doimiy tashqi kirish va resurs iste'molini talab qiladi.
ru: Предназначен для краткосрочного использования с последующей быстрой утилизацией.
Сфокусирован только на максимизации немедленной экономической прибыли.
Требующий постоянного внешнего ввода и потребления ресурсов.

translation.en: The dying out or disappearance of a species.
translation.uz: Turlarning yo'q bo'lib ketishi yoki g'oyib bo'lishi.
translation.ru: Вымирание или исчезновение вида.

example: Many animal species are at risk of extinction.
Habitat loss is a major cause of extinction.
Conservation efforts aim to prevent species extinction.

quiz.correct_answer: The dying out or disappearance of a species.

en: The rapid growth in population numbers of a certain animal.
The process of introducing new species to an ecosystem.
The migration of animals to different regions for food.
uz: Ma'lum bir hayvon turining populyatsiyasi sonining tez o'sishi.
Ekotizimga yangi turlarni kiritish jarayoni.
Hayvonlarning oziq-ovqat uchun turli mintaqalarga migratsiyasi.
ru: Быстрый рост численности популяции определенного животного.
Процесс интродукции новых видов в экосистему.
Миграция животных в разные регионы в поисках пищи.

translation.en: The variety of life on Earth, including diversity within and between species and of ecosystems.
translation.uz: Yer yuzidagi hayotning xilma-xilligi, shu jumladan turlar orasidagi va ekotizimlarning xilma-xilligi.
translation.ru: Разнообразие жизни на Земле, включая разнообразие внутри и между видами и экосистемами.

example: Protecting biodiversity is vital for healthy ecosystems.
Rainforests are rich in biodiversity.
Loss of biodiversity affects the balance of nature.

quiz.correct_answer: The variety of life on Earth, including diversity within and between species and of ecosystems.

en: The study of ancient geological formations and rocks.
The number of unique landscapes found in a specific region.
The measurement of oxygen levels in different water bodies.
uz: Qadimgi geologik shakllanishlar va toshlarni o'rganish.
Ma'lum bir mintaqada topilgan noyob landshaftlar soni.
Turli suv havzalaridagi kislorod darajasini o'lchash.
ru: Изучение древних геологических формаций и горных пород.
Количество уникальных ландшафтов, найденных в определенном регионе.
Измерение уровня кислорода в различных водоемах.

translation.en: The total amount of greenhouse gases produced by human activities.
translation.uz: Inson faoliyati natijasida ishlab chiqariladigan issiqxona gazlarining umumiy miqdori.
translation.ru: Общее количество парниковых газов, произведенных деятельностью человека.

example: Reducing your carbon footprint helps the environment.
Flying less can decrease your carbon footprint.
Many companies are trying to lower their carbon footprint.

quiz.correct_answer: The total amount of greenhouse gases produced by human activities.

en: The energy required to power an average household appliance.
The impact of a single person's walking on the planet.
The amount of oxygen consumed by plants during respiration.
uz: O'rtacha uy-ro'zg'or texnikasini quvvatlantirish uchun zarur bo'lgan energiya.
Bir kishining sayyoraga ta'sirining piyoda yurishi.
O'simliklar nafas olish paytida iste'mol qiladigan kislorod miqdori.
ru: Энергия, необходимая для питания среднего бытового прибора.
Влияние ходьбы одного человека на планету.
Количество кислорода, потребляемого растениями во время дыхания.

translation.en: Not harmful to the environment; ecologically sound.
translation.uz: Atrof-muhitga zararli emas; ekologik jihatdan to'g'ri.
translation.ru: Не вредный для окружающей среды; экологически безопасный.

example: We buy eco-friendly cleaning products.
Using public transport is an eco-friendly option.
Many hotels are adopting eco-friendly practices.

quiz.correct_answer: Not harmful to the environment; ecologically sound.

en: Very modern and technologically advanced in its design.
Highly affordable and convenient for daily consumer use.
Designed for luxury and high-end aesthetic appeal.
uz: O'z dizayni bo'yicha juda zamonaviy va texnologik jihatdan ilg'or.
Kundalik iste'molchilar uchun juda arzon va qulay.
Hashamat va yuqori darajadagi estetik jozibadorlik uchun mo'ljallangan.
ru: Очень современный и технологически продвинутый по своему дизайну.
Очень доступный и удобный для повседневного использования потребителями.
Предназначен для роскоши и высококлассного эстетического привлекательности.

translation.en: The natural home or environment of an animal, plant, or other organism.
translation.uz: Hayvon, o'simlik yoki boshqa organizmning tabiiy yashash joyi yoki muhiti.
translation.ru: Естественный дом или среда обитания животного, растения или другого организма.

example: Loss of natural habitat threatens many species.
The rainforest is a rich habitat for many unique animals.
Protecting marine habitats is vital for ocean health.

quiz.correct_answer: The natural home or environment of an animal, plant, or other organism.

en: A type of food preferred by a specific species of animal.
The process of breeding animals in captivity for conservation.
A long journey undertaken by animals for seasonal changes.
uz: Hayvonlarning ma'lum bir turi afzal ko'radigan oziq-ovqat turi.
Tabiatni muhofaza qilish uchun hayvonlarni asirlikda ko'paytirish jarayoni.
Mavsumiy o'zgarishlar uchun hayvonlar tomonidan qilingan uzoq safar.
ru: Тип пищи, предпочитаемый определенным видом животных.
Процесс разведения животных в неволе для сохранения вида.
Длительное путешествие, совершаемое животными для сезонных изменений.

translation.en: Materials or substances such as minerals, forests, water, and fertile land that occur in nature and can be used for economic gain.
translation.uz: Tabiatda mavjud bo'lgan va iqtisodiy foyda uchun ishlatilishi mumkin bo'lgan foydali qazilmalar, o'rmonlar, suv va unumdor yerlar kabi materiallar yoki moddalar.
translation.ru: Материалы или вещества, такие как полезные ископаемые, леса, вода и плодородные земли, которые встречаются в природе и могут быть использованы для получения экономической выгоды.

example: Countries rich in natural resources often have strong economies.
We must manage our natural resources carefully.
Water is a vital natural resource for all life.

quiz.correct_answer: Materials or substances such as minerals, forests, water, and fertile land that occur in nature and can be used for economic gain.

en: Man-made products created through industrial manufacturing processes.
Advanced technologies developed for space exploration missions.
Financial investments made by large corporations for profit.
uz: Sanoat ishlab chiqarish jarayonlari orqali yaratilgan sun'iy mahsulotlar.
Kosmik tadqiqotlar missiyalari uchun ishlab chiqilgan ilg'or texnologiyalar.
Yirik korporatsiyalar tomonidan foyda olish uchun qilingan moliyaviy investitsiyalar.
ru: Продукты, созданные человеком в процессе промышленного производства.
Передовые технологии, разработанные для миссий по исследованию космоса.
Финансовые инвестиции, сделанные крупными корпорациями для получения прибыли.

translation.en: Unwanted or unusable material, substances, or by-products.
translation.uz: Keraksiz yoki foydalanilmaydigan materiallar, moddalar yoki qo'shimcha mahsulotlar.
translation.ru: Ненужный или непригодный материал, вещества или побочные продукты.

example: Proper disposal of hazardous waste is crucial.
We need to reduce our household waste.
The factory produces a lot of industrial waste.

quiz.correct_answer: Unwanted or unusable material, substances, or by-products.

en: Valuable materials that can be easily sold for high profit.
Nutrient-rich soil essential for agricultural growth.
Clean, purified water suitable for drinking and cooking.
uz: Yuqori foyda bilan osongina sotilishi mumkin bo'lgan qimmatbaho materiallar.
Qishloq xo'jaligi o'sishi uchun muhim bo'lgan ozuqa moddalariga boy tuproq.
Ichimlik va pishirish uchun yaroqli toza, tozalangan suv.
ru: Ценные материалы, которые можно легко продать с большой прибылью.
Богатая питательными веществами почва, необходимая для сельскохозяйственного роста.
Чистая, очищенная вода, пригодная для питья и приготовления пищи.

translation.en: The process of replanting trees in areas where forests have been removed.
translation.uz: O'rmonlar kesilgan joylarda daraxtlarni qayta ekish jarayoni.
translation.ru: Процесс повторной посадки деревьев в районах, где леса были вырублены.

example: Reforestation projects help combat deforestation.
The government launched a massive reforestation program.
Reforestation is vital for restoring degraded ecosystems.

quiz.correct_answer: The process of replanting trees in areas where forests have been removed.

en: The natural decay of dead plant matter in a forest.
The illegal cutting down of trees for timber production.
The process of converting forest land into agricultural fields.
uz: O'rmondagi o'lik o'simlik moddalarining tabiiy parchalanishi.
Yog'och ishlab chiqarish uchun daraxtlarni noqonuniy kesish.
O'rmon yerlarini qishloq xo'jaligi ekin maydonlariga aylantirish jarayoni.
ru: Естественное разложение мертвых растительных остатков в лесу.
Незаконная вырубка деревьев для производства древесины.
Процесс преобразования лесных угодий в сельскохозяйственные поля.

translation.en: The process of capturing carbon dioxide from industrial sources and storing it, preventing it from entering the atmosphere.
translation.uz: Sanoat manbalaridan karbonat angidridni ushlab qolish va uni saqlash jarayoni, uning atmosferaga chiqishini oldini oladi.
translation.ru: Процесс улавливания углекислого газа из промышленных источников и его хранения, предотвращая попадание в атмосферу.

example: Carbon capture technology is still developing.
Some power plants are exploring carbon capture solutions.
Effective carbon capture could help reduce global emissions.

quiz.correct_answer: The process of capturing carbon dioxide from industrial sources and storing it, preventing it from entering the atmosphere.

en: The natural release of carbon dioxide from decaying organic matter.
The scientific method of measuring carbon levels in ancient ice cores.
The conversion of carbon into a useful energy source for industry.
uz: Chirigan organik moddalardan karbonat angidridning tabiiy ajralib chiqishi.
Qadimgi muz yadrolarida uglerod darajasini o'lchashning ilmiy usuli.
Uglerodni sanoat uchun foydali energiya manbaiga aylantirish.
ru: Естественный выброс углекислого газа из разлагающихся органических веществ.
Научный метод измерения уровня углерода в древних ледяных кернах.
Преобразование углерода в полезный источник энергии для промышленности.

translation.en: Tourism directed toward exotic, often threatened, natural environments, intended to support conservation efforts.
translation.uz: Ekzotik, ko'pincha xavf ostida bo'lgan tabiiy muhitlarga qaratilgan turizm, tabiatni muhofaza qilish harakatlarini qo'llab-quvvatlashga qaratilgan.
translation.ru: Туризм, направленный на экзотические, часто находящиеся под угрозой исчезновения, природные среды, призванный поддерживать усилия по сохранению.

example: Eco-tourism helps local communities protect their environment.
Many national parks promote eco-tourism.
We chose an eco-tourism package for our trip to the rainforest.

quiz.correct_answer: Tourism directed toward exotic, often threatened, natural environments, intended to support conservation efforts.

en: Mass tourism focused on large city attractions and shopping.
Adventure travel involving extreme sports in urban settings.
Luxury travel that emphasizes comfort and high-end services.
uz: Katta shahar diqqatga sazovor joylari va xarid qilishga qaratilgan ommaviy turizm.
Shahar sharoitida ekstremal sport turlarini o'z ichiga olgan sarguzasht sayohati.
Qulaylik va yuqori darajadagi xizmatlarga urg'u beradigan hashamatli sayohat.
ru: Массовый туризм, ориентированный на крупные городские достопримечательности и шопинг.
Приключенческий туризм, включающий экстремальные виды спорта в городских условиях.
Роскошный туризм, подчеркивающий комфорт и высококлассные услуги.

translation.en: A place where waste is buried under the ground.
translation.uz: Chiqindilar yer ostiga ko'miladigan joy.
translation.ru: Место, где отходы закапываются под землю.

example: Most household waste still goes to landfills.
Landfills can cause environmental pollution.
We need to reduce the amount of waste sent to landfill.

quiz.correct_answer: A place where waste is buried under the ground.

en: A facility for treating wastewater before it returns to nature.
A factory that recycles plastic and glass materials efficiently.
A power plant that generates electricity from renewable sources.
uz: Oqova suvlarni tabiatga qaytarishdan oldin tozalash inshooti.
Plastik va shisha materiallarni samarali qayta ishlaydigan zavod.
Qayta tiklanadigan manbalardan elektr energiyasi ishlab chiqaradigan elektr stantsiyasi.
ru: Сооружение для очистки сточных вод перед их возвращением в природу.
Завод, эффективно перерабатывающий пластиковые и стеклянные материалы.
Электростанция, вырабатывающая электроэнергию из возобновляемых источников.

translation.en: The trapping of the sun's warmth in a planet's lower atmosphere due to the greater transparency of the atmosphere to visible radiation from the sun than to infrared radiation emitted from the planet's surface.
translation.uz: Quyosh issiqligining sayyora quyi atmosferasida ushlanib qolishi, chunki atmosfera quyoshdan kelayotgan ko'rinadigan radiatsiyaga sayyora yuzasidan chiqarilgan infraqizil radiatsiyadan ko'ra ko'proq shaffofdir.
translation.ru: Удержание солнечного тепла в нижней атмосфере планеты из-за большей прозрачности атмосферы для видимого излучения от Солнца, чем для инфракрасного излучения, испускаемого с поверхности планеты.

example: The greenhouse effect is necessary for life on Earth, but too much is harmful.
Increased greenhouse gases lead to an enhanced greenhouse effect.
Scientists study the greenhouse effect to understand climate change.

quiz.correct_answer: The trapping of the sun's warmth in a planet's lower atmosphere due to the greater transparency of the atmosphere to visible radiation from the sun than to infrared radiation emitted from the planet's surface.

en: The cooling process that occurs when ice melts in the polar regions rapidly.
The reflection of sunlight off the Earth's surface into outer space.
The daily cycle of temperature changes between day and night.
uz: Qutbiy hududlarda muz tez eriganda sodir bo'ladigan sovutish jarayoni.
Quyosh nurining Yer yuzasidan tashqi fazoga qaytishi.
Kunduz va tun o'rtasidagi harorat o'zgarishlarining kunlik tsikli.
ru: Процесс охлаждения, который происходит, когда лед в полярных регионах быстро тает.
Отражение солнечного света от поверхности Земли в космическое пространство.
Ежедневный цикл изменения температуры между днем и ночью.

translation.en: A layer in the Earth's stratosphere that protects living organisms from harmful ultraviolet radiation from the sun.
translation.uz: Yer stratosferasidagi qatlam bo'lib, tirik organizmlarni quyoshdan keladigan zararli ultrabinafsha nurlanishidan himoya qiladi.
translation.ru: Слой в стратосфере Земли, который защищает живые организмы от вредного ультрафиолетового излучения Солнца.

example: The ozone layer is vital for protecting life on Earth.
Chemicals like CFCs caused damage to the ozone layer.
Efforts were made to heal the hole in the ozone layer.

quiz.correct_answer: A layer in the Earth's stratosphere that protects living organisms from harmful ultraviolet radiation from the sun.

en: The dense core of the Earth that generates its magnetic field.
A protective membrane found around certain plant cells.
The deepest part of the ocean where no sunlight can penetrate.
uz: Magnit maydonini hosil qiluvchi Yerning zich yadrosi.
Ba'zi o'simlik hujayralari atrofida joylashgan himoya membranasi.
Okeanning eng chuqur qismi, u erda quyosh nuri kira olmaydi.
ru: Плотное ядро Земли, которое генерирует ее магнитное поле.
Защитная мембрана, обнаруженная вокруг некоторых растительных клеток.
Самая глубокая часть океана, куда не проникает солнечный свет.

translation.en: Decayed organic material used as a plant fertilizer.
translation.uz: O'simlik o'g'iti sifatida ishlatiladigan chirigan organik material.
translation.ru: Перегнивший органический материал, используемый в качестве удобрения для растений.

example: We put our food waste in the compost bin.
