Compost enriches the soil in our garden.
Making compost helps reduce household waste.

quiz.correct_answer: Decayed organic material used as a plant fertilizer.

en: A type of harmful chemical used to control pests in farming.
A sterile substance used to disinfect surgical instruments.
A synthetic fiber used in the manufacturing of clothing.
uz: Dehqonchilikda zararkunandalarni nazorat qilish uchun ishlatiladigan zararli kimyoviy modda turi.
Jarrohlik asboblarini dezinfektsiya qilish uchun ishlatiladigan steril modda.
Kiyim ishlab chiqarishda ishlatiladigan sintetik tola.
ru: Тип вредного химического вещества, используемого для борьбы с вредителями в сельском хозяйстве.
Стерильное вещество, используемое для дезинфекции хирургических инструментов.
Синтетическое волокно, используемое в производстве одежды.

translation.en: The impact of something, especially a person's or company's activities, on the environment.
translation.uz: Biror narsaning, ayniqsa inson yoki kompaniya faoliyatining atrof-muhitga ta'siri.
translation.ru: Влияние чего-либо, особенно деятельности человека или компании, на окружающую среду.

example: We aim to reduce our environmental footprint.
Their carbon footprint is quite large.
Living locally can shrink your ecological footprint.

quiz.correct_answer: The impact of something, especially a person's or company's activities, on the environment.

en: A direct financial contribution made to a charity organization.
A physical mark left by a foot or shoe on a surface.
The design specifications for a new building construction.
uz: Xayriya tashkilotiga qilingan to'g'ridan-to'g'ri moliyaviy hissa.
Yuzada oyoq yoki poyabzal tomonidan qoldirilgan jismoniy iz.
Yangi bino qurilishi uchun dizayn spetsifikatsiyalari.
ru: Прямой финансовый вклад в благотворительную организацию.
Физический след, оставленный ногой или обувью на поверхности.
Проектные спецификации для нового строительства.

translation.en: The accumulation of plastic products in the environment that adversely affects wildlife, wildlife habitat, or humans.
translation.uz: Atrof-muhitda plastik mahsulotlarning to'planishi, bu yovvoyi tabiatga, yovvoyi tabiatning yashash joylariga yoki odamlarga salbiy ta'sir ko'rsatadi.
translation.ru: Накопление пластиковых изделий в окружающей среде, которое негативно влияет на дикую природу, среду обитания диких животных или людей.

example: Plastic pollution is a growing concern for oceans.
Reducing single-use plastics helps combat plastic pollution.
Marine animals are often harmed by plastic pollution.

quiz.correct_answer: The accumulation of plastic products in the environment that adversely affects wildlife, wildlife habitat, or humans.

en: The process of transforming plastic into new reusable items.
The industrial manufacturing of new plastic materials.
A natural process where organic materials decompose quickly.
uz: Plastikni yangi qayta ishlatiladigan narsalarga aylantirish jarayoni.
Yangi plastik materiallarning sanoat ishlab chiqarilishi.
Organik materiallar tez parchalanadigan tabiiy jarayon.
ru: Процесс превращения пластика в новые многоразовые изделия.
Промышленное производство новых пластмассовых материалов.
Естественный процесс быстрого разложения органических материалов.

translation.en: To deplete the stock of fish in a body of water by too much fishing.
translation.uz: Baliqlarni haddan tashqari ko'p ovlash orqali suv havzasidagi baliq zaxirasini kamaytirish.
translation.ru: Истощать запасы рыбы в водоеме из-за чрезмерного рыболовства.

example: Overfishing has severely reduced fish populations.
Sustainable fishing practices can prevent overfishing.
Many governments are implementing measures against overfishing.

quiz.correct_answer: To deplete the stock of fish in a body of water by too much fishing.

en: The controlled breeding of fish in large aquaculture farms.
The illegal hunting of protected wildlife species on land.
The natural migration patterns of marine animals for breeding.
uz: Katta akvakultura fermalarida baliqlarni nazorat ostida ko'paytirish.
Quruqlikda himoyalangan yovvoyi tabiat turlarini noqonuniy ovlash.
Dengiz hayvonlarining ko'payish uchun tabiiy migratsiya namunalari.
ru: Контролируемое разведение рыбы на крупных аквакультурных фермах.
Незаконная охота на охраняемые виды диких животных на суше.
Естественные миграционные пути морских животных для размножения.

translation.en: The action of clearing a wide area of trees.
translation.uz: Keng daraxtzor maydonini tozalash harakati.
translation.ru: Действие по расчистке большой площади деревьев.

example: Deforestation is a major cause of habitat loss for many animals.
We need to stop deforestation to protect our planet's lungs.
The rate of deforestation in the Amazon rainforest is alarming.

quiz.correct_answer: The action of clearing a wide area of trees.

en: The process of planting new trees to replace old ones.
The natural growth of a forest over many centuries.
The controlled burning of small forest areas to prevent large fires.
uz: Eski daraxtlarni almashtirish uchun yangi daraxtlar ekish jarayoni.
Ko'p asrlar davomida o'rmonning tabiiy o'sishi.
Katta yong'inlarning oldini olish uchun kichik o'rmon maydonlarini nazorat ostida yoqish.
ru: Процесс посадки новых деревьев взамен старых.
Естественный рост леса на протяжении многих веков.
Контролируемое выжигание небольших участков леса для предотвращения крупных пожаров.

translation.en: Rainfall made sufficiently acidic by atmospheric pollution that it causes harm to forests and lakes.
translation.uz: Atmosfera ifloslanishi tufayli etarlicha kislotali bo'lib, o'rmonlar va ko'llarga zarar etkazadigan yomg'ir.

example: The greenhouse effect is necessary for life on Earth, but too much is harmful.
Increased greenhouse gases lead to an enhanced greenhouse effect.
Scientists study the greenhouse effect to understand climate change.

quiz.correct_answer: Rainfall made sufficiently acidic by atmospheric pollution that it causes harm to forests and lakes.

en: Rainfall made sufficiently acidic by atmospheric pollution that it causes harm to forests and lakes.
The cooling process that occurs when ice melts in the polar regions rapidly.
The reflection of sunlight off the Earth's surface into outer space.
The daily cycle of temperature changes between day and night.
uz: Atmosfera ifloslanishi tufayli etarlicha kislotali bo'lib, o'rmonlar va ko'llarga zarar etkazadigan yomg'ir.
Qutbiy hududlarda muz tez eriganda sodir bo'ladigan sovutish jarayoni.
Quyosh nurining Yer yuzasidan tashqi fazoga qaytishi.
Kunduz va tun o'rtasidagi harorat o'zgarishlarining kunlik tsikli.
ru: Осадки, ставшие достаточно кислыми из-за загрязнения атмосферы, что наносит вред лесам и озерам.
Процесс охлаждения, который происходит, когда лед в полярных регионах быстро тает.
Отражение солнечного света от поверхности Земли в космическое пространство.
Ежедневный цикл изменения температуры между днем и ночью.

translation.en: A piece of writing in a newspaper or magazine, or on a website.
translation.uz: Gazeta, jurnal yoki veb-saytdagi yozma asar.
translation.ru: Произведение, написанное для газеты, журнала или веб-сайта.

example: I read an interesting **article** about climate change this morning.
She writes daily **articles** for a popular online blog.
The magazine features an **article** on healthy eating.

quiz.correct_answer: A piece of writing in a newspaper or magazine, or on a website.

en: A small advertisement found at the bottom of a web page display.
A photographic image used to specifically illustrate a news story.
A televised report on current events that is shown live to viewers.
uz: Veb-sahifaning pastki qismida joylashgan kichik reklama.
Yangiliklar hikoyasini tasvirlash uchun ishlatiladigan fotosurat.
Tomoshabinlarga jonli efirda ko'rsatiladigan joriy voqealar haqidagi televizion reportaj.
ru: Маленькое рекламное объявление внизу веб-страницы.
Фотографическое изображение, используемое для иллюстрации новостного сюжета.
Телевизионный репортаж о текущих событиях, показываемый зрителям в прямом эфире.

translation.en: A person who collects and reports news for newspapers, radio, or television.
translation.uz: Gazetalar, radio yoki televideniye uchun yangiliklar yig'uvchi va ularni xabar qiluvchi shaxs.
translation.ru: Человек, который собирает и сообщает новости для газет, радио или телевидения.

example: The **reporter** interviewed witnesses at the scene of the accident.
She always wanted to be a foreign **reporter** and travel the world.
A brave **reporter** exposed the truth behind the scandal.

quiz.correct_answer: A person who collects and reports news for newspapers, radio, or television.

en: Someone who simply sells newspapers on a street corner location.
A person who primarily prints books and magazines for mass publication.
An editor who reviews and precisely corrects written articles for publication.
uz: Ko'cha burchagida gazeta sotadigan odam.
Asosan ommaviy nashr qilish uchun kitob va jurnallar chop etadigan shaxs.
Nashr qilish uchun yozma maqolalarni ko'rib chiqadigan va aniq tuzatadigan muharrir.
ru: Кто-то, кто просто продает газеты на углу улицы.
Человек, который в основном печатает книги и журналы для массовой публикации.
Редактор, который просматривает и точно исправляет написанные статьи для публикации.

translation.en: A meeting at which a reporter asks questions of someone.
translation.uz: Jurnalistning kimdandir savollar so'raydigan uchrashuvi.
translation.ru: Встреча, на которой репортер задает вопросы кому-либо.

example: The Prime Minister gave an exclusive **interview** to the BBC.
I watched an interesting **interview** with the author.
She prepared well for her job **interview** tomorrow.

quiz.correct_answer: A meeting at which a reporter asks questions of someone.

en: A formal speech given by a politician to a very large audience.
A written summary of an important news event or recent update.
A public debate between two opposing political candidates on TV.
uz: Siyosatchi tomonidan juda katta auditoriyaga qilingan rasmiy nutq.
Muhim yangilik yoki so'nggi yangilanishning yozma xulosasi.
Televizorda ikki qarama-qarshi siyosiy nomzod o'rtasidagi ommaviy munozara.
ru: Официальная речь политика перед очень большой аудиторией.
Письменное изложение важного новостного события или недавнего обновления.
Публичные дебаты между двумя противоборствующими политическими кандидатами по телевидению.

translation.en: Important things that are happening in the world now.
translation.uz: Hozirgi vaqtda dunyoda sodir bo'layotgan muhim voqealar.
translation.ru: Важные события, происходящие в мире в настоящее время.

example: Our class discusses **current events** every Friday morning.
Keeping up with **current events** is important for general knowledge.
The newspaper provides good coverage of **current events**.

quiz.correct_answer: Important things that are happening in the world now.

en: Historical facts from the distant past that are no longer relevant.
Future predictions about what might possibly happen in society.
Personal opinions and feelings about various different topics.
uz: Uzoq o'tmishdagi, hozirgi kunda ahamiyatsiz bo'lgan tarixiy faktlar.
Jamiyatda nima sodir bo'lishi mumkinligi haqidagi kelajak bashoratlari.
Turli xil mavzular bo'yicha shaxsiy fikrlar va his-tuyg'ular.
ru: Исторические факты из далекого прошлого, которые больше не актуальны.
Будущие предсказания о том, что может произойти в обществе.
Личные мнения и чувства по различным темам.

translation.en: A place, person, or thing from which information comes.
translation.uz: Ma'lumot keladigan joy, shaxs yoki narsa.
translation.ru: Место, человек или вещь, откуда исходит информация.

example: Always check the **source** of your news to ensure accuracy.
The journalist would not reveal their confidential **source**.
Reputable news organizations always cite their **sources**.

quiz.correct_answer: A place, person, or thing from which information comes.

en: The main topic or primary subject of a newspaper article.
A type of media platform like general television or radio.
The physical location where a news story specifically takes place.
uz: Gazeta maqolasining asosiy mavzusi yoki boshlang'ich ob'ekti.
Umumiy televideniye yoki radio kabi media platformasi turi.
Yangilik hikoyasi sodir bo'ladigan jismoniy joy.
ru: Основная тема или главный предмет газетной статьи.
Тип медиа-платформы, такой как общее телевидение или радио.
Физическое место, где конкретно происходит новостной сюжет.

translation.en: False information presented as news, often to mislead people.
translation.uz: Yangilik sifatida taqdim etilgan, ko'pincha odamlarni chalg'itish uchun soxta ma'lumot.
translation.ru: Ложная информация, представленная как новости, часто для введения в заблуждение.

example: Be careful not to believe everything you read, there's a lot of **fake news**.
Social media has contributed to the rapid spread of **fake news** stories.
It's important to differentiate between real news and **fake news**.

quiz.correct_answer: False information presented as news, often to mislead people.

en: Breaking news that is announced very suddenly on television.
Satirical content meant purely for entertainment and humor.
Opinion pieces that express personal viewpoints on various issues.
uz: Televizorda juda to'satdan e'lon qilingan shoshilinch yangiliklar.
Faqat ko'ngilochar va hazil uchun mo'ljallangan satirik mazmun.
Turli masalalar bo'yicha shaxsiy nuqtai nazarni ifodalovchi fikr maqolalari.
ru: Срочные новости, которые объявляются очень внезапно по телевидению.
Сатирический контент, предназначенный исключительно для развлечения и юмора.
Статьи-мнения, выражающие личные точки зрения по различным вопросам.

translation.en: A strong feeling for or against one thing or one group, usually unfair.
translation.uz: Biror narsaga yoki bir guruhga nisbatan kuchli his-tuyg'u, odatda adolatsiz.
translation.ru: Сильное чувство за или против чего-либо или группы, обычно несправедливое.

example: News channels sometimes show **bias** towards a particular political party.
It's hard to find a truly neutral report without any **bias**.
The article revealed a clear **bias** against the new policy.

quiz.correct_answer: A strong feeling for or against one thing or one group, usually unfair.

en: A balanced and objective viewpoint on all sides of an issue.
A comprehensive analysis of facts presented clearly and openly.
The ability to report information without any personal feelings involved.
uz: Masalaning barcha tomonlari bo'yicha muvozanatli va xolis nuqtai nazar.
Aniqlik va ochiqlik bilan taqdim etilgan faktlarning har tomonlama tahlili.
Shaxsiy his-tuyg'ularsiz ma'lumotlarni xabar qilish qobiliyati.
ru: Сбалансированная и объективная точка зрения по всем сторонам вопроса.
Всесторонний анализ фактов, представленных ясно и открыто.
Способность сообщать информацию без каких-либо личных чувств.

translation.en: A newspaper, television channel, or website that provides news and information.
translation.uz: Yangiliklar va ma'lumotlarni taqdim etadigan gazeta, telekanal yoki veb-sayt.
translation.ru: Газета, телеканал или веб-сайт, предоставляющие новости и информацию.

example: Which **media outlet** do you trust for your daily news updates?
Different **media outlets** often present the same story with a different focus.
A new online **media outlet** has launched, focusing on local news.

quiz.correct_answer: A newspaper, television channel, or website that provides news and information.

en: An individual journalist who writes for various news organizations.
A type of social media platform for sharing personal photos and updates.
A specialized software program used for editing video content.
uz: Turli xil yangiliklar tashkilotlari uchun yozadigan individual jurnalist.
Shaxsiy fotosuratlar va yangilanishlarni ulashish uchun ijtimoiy media platformasi turi.
Video kontentini tahrirlash uchun ishlatiladigan ixtisoslashtirilgan dastur.
ru: Отдельный журналист, который пишет для различных новостных организаций.
Тип платформы социальных сетей для обмена личными фотографиями и обновлениями.
Специализированная программа для редактирования видеоконтента.

translation.en: A person who is in charge of a newspaper, magazine, or part of a publishing house and decides what will be published.
translation.uz: Gazeta, jurnal yoki nashriyotning bir qismiga mas'ul shaxs bo'lib, nimalar nashr etilishini hal qiladi.
translation.ru: Человек, отвечающий за газету, журнал или часть издательства, и решающий, что будет опубликовано.

example: The **editor** approved the final version of the story.
She sent her manuscript to the book **editor**.
The chief **editor** makes important decisions about content.

quiz.correct_answer: A person who is in charge of a newspaper, magazine, or part of a publishing house and decides what will be published.

en: Someone who delivers newspapers to homes in the morning.
A photographer who takes pictures for news articles.
A person who sells advertising space in a publication.
uz: Ertalab uylarga gazeta tarqatadigan odam.
Yangiliklar maqolalari uchun suratga oladigan fotosuratchi.
Nashrda reklama joyini sotadigan shaxs.
ru: Тот, кто доставляет газеты домой по утрам.
Фотограф, который делает снимки для новостных статей.
Человек, который продает рекламное место в публикации.

translation.en: The first page of a newspaper, usually containing the most important news.
translation.uz: Gazetaning birinchi sahifasi, odatda eng muhim yangiliklarni o'z ichiga oladi.
translation.ru: Первая страница газеты, обычно содержащая самые важные новости.

example: The major story was on the **front page** of every newspaper.
The photo of the rescued child made the **front page**.
They debated which story should go on the **front page**.

quiz.correct_answer: The first page of a newspaper, usually containing the most important news.

en: The last page of a newspaper, where sports results are listed.
A special section inside the newspaper dedicated to finance.
The section of a website that contains archived articles.
uz: Gazetaning oxirgi sahifasi, sport natijalari ro'yxati berilgan.
Gazeta ichidagi moliyaga bag'ishlangan maxsus bo'lim.
Arxivlangan maqolalarni o'z ichiga olgan veb-sayt bo'limi.
ru: Последняя страница газеты, где перечислены спортивные результаты.
Специальный раздел внутри газеты, посвященный финансам.
Раздел веб-сайта, содержащий архивные статьи.

translation.en: An official examination of the facts about a situation or a crime.
translation.uz: Vaziyat yoki jinoyat haqidagi faktlarni rasmiy tekshirish.
translation.ru: Официальное расследование фактов о ситуации или преступлении.

example: The police launched an **investigation** into the mysterious disappearance.
Journalists conduct in-depth **investigations** to uncover the truth.
The report is based on a thorough **investigation** of the incident.

quiz.correct_answer: An official examination of the facts about a situation or a crime.

en: A public debate held between political candidates.
A brief summary of an event provided to the public.
A casual discussion about daily events and activities.
uz: Siyosiy nomzodlar o'rtasida o'tkazilgan ommaviy munozara.
Jamoatchilikka taqdim etilgan voqea haqida qisqacha xulosa.
Kundalik voqealar va faoliyatlar haqida tasodifiy muhokama.
ru: Публичные дебаты между политическими кандидатами.
Краткое изложение события, предоставленное общественности.
Непринужденная беседа о повседневных событиях и занятиях.

translation.en: A spoken or written description of an event as it happens, or a series of notes explaining something.
translation.uz: Voqea sodir bo'layotgan paytda og'zaki yoki yozma tasvirlash, yoki nimadirni tushuntiruvchi bir qator izohlar.
translation.ru: Устное или письменное описание события по мере его развития, или ряд примечаний, объясняющих что-либо.

example: The sports announcer provided live **commentary** on the football match.
The news channel often has political **commentary** after the main news.
Her book includes valuable **commentary** on ancient texts.

quiz.correct_answer: A spoken or written description of an event as it happens, or a series of notes explaining something.

en: The main breaking news story of the day without any added context.
A factual report that simply lists events without interpretation.
A short commercial break during a television program.
uz: Kunlik asosiy shoshilinch yangiliklar hikoyasi, qo'shimcha kontekstsiz.
Voqealarni talqinsiz shunchaki sanab o'tadigan faktik hisobot.
Televizion dastur davomida qisqa reklama tanaffusi.
ru: Главная срочная новость дня без какого-либо дополнительного контекста.
Фактический отчет, который просто перечисляет события без интерпретации.
Короткая рекламная пауза во время телевизионной программы.

translation.en: Intended to cause great excitement or interest, often by presenting facts in an exaggerated way.
translation.uz: Katta hayajon yoki qiziqish uyg'otishga qaratilgan, ko'pincha faktlarni bo'rttirilgan holda taqdim etish orqali.
translation.ru: Предназначенный вызывать большое волнение или интерес, часто путем преувеличенного представления фактов.

example: The newspaper was criticized for its **sensational** reporting.
They published a **sensational** story about a celebrity scandal.
Avoid news that focuses only on **sensational** headlines.

quiz.correct_answer: Intended to cause great excitement or interest, often by presenting facts in an exaggerated way.

en: Reporting that is completely objective and based purely on factual information.
A very calm and balanced description of events without any drama.
News that is boring and lacks any kind of engaging or exciting elements.
uz: Mutlaqo xolis va faqat faktik ma'lumotlarga asoslangan reportaj.
Voqealarning dramasisiz juda xotirjam va muvozanatli tavsifi.
Zerikarli va hech qanday qiziqarli yoki hayajonli elementlarga ega bo'lmagan yangiliklar.
ru: Полностью объективное сообщение, основанное исключительно на фактической информации.
Очень спокойное и сбалансированное описание событий без какой-либо драмы.
Скучные новости, лишенные каких-либо увлекательных или захватывающих элементов.

translation.en: The number of copies of a newspaper or magazine that are distributed.
translation.uz: Gazeta yoki jurnalning tarqatilgan nusxalari soni.
translation.ru: Количество экземпляров газеты или журнала, которые распространяются.

example: The newspaper has a daily **circulation** of over 200,000 copies.
Online news has reduced the **circulation** of print newspapers.
A higher **circulation** means more people are reading the publication.

quiz.correct_answer: The number of copies of a newspaper or magazine that are distributed.

en: The annual profit generated by a publishing company each year.
The total number of journalists employed by a news organization.
The average number of articles published in a single issue.
uz: Nashriyot kompaniyasi har yili ishlab chiqaradigan yillik foyda.
Yangiliklar tashkiloti tomonidan ishlayotgan jurnalistlarning umumiy soni.
Bitta sonda nashr etilgan maqolalarning o'rtacha soni.
ru: Годовая прибыль, получаемая издательской компанией каждый год.
Общее количество журналистов, работающих в новостной организации.
Среднее количество статей, опубликованных в одном выпуске.

translation.en: A meeting at which a person or group makes an official statement to journalists and answers their questions.
translation.uz: Biror shaxs yoki guruh jurnalistlarga rasmiy bayonot beradigan va ularning savollariga javob beradigan yig'ilish.
translation.ru: Встреча, на которой человек или группа делает официальное заявление журналистам и отвечает на их вопросы.

example: The mayor held a **press conference** to address the new city plans.
Journalists gathered for the urgent **press conference**.
He announced his resignation at a televised **press conference**.

quiz.correct_answer: A meeting at which a person or group makes an official statement to journalists and answers their questions.

en: A private interview held between a reporter and one important individual.
A public protest demonstration held by activists against a policy.
A formal debate between two opposing political leaders.
uz: Reportyor va bir muhim shaxs o'rtasida o'tkazilgan shaxsiy intervyu.
Faollar tomonidan siyosatga qarshi o'tkazilgan ommaviy norozilik namoyishi.
Ikki qarama-qarshi siyosiy yetakchi o'rtasidagi rasmiy munozara.
ru: Частное интервью между репортером и одним важным лицом.
Публичная акция протеста, проводимая активистами против какой-либо политики.
Формальные дебаты между двумя противоборствующими политическими лидерами.

translation.en: A journalist who writes a regular article for a newspaper or magazine.
translation.uz: Gazeta yoki jurnal uchun muntazam maqola yozadigan jurnalist.
translation.ru: Журналист, который пишет регулярную статью для газеты или журнала.

example: My favorite **columnist** always writes about social issues.
She started her career as a local newspaper **columnist**.
His witty **columnist** pieces are very popular online.

quiz.correct_answer: A journalist who writes a regular article for a newspaper or magazine.

en: A person who delivers newspapers to homes every morning.
Someone who designs the layout of magazine pages and images.
A photographer who takes pictures for various news stories.
uz: Har kuni ertalab uylarga gazeta tarqatadigan odam.
Jurnal sahifalari va rasmlarining joylashuvini loyihalashtiruvchi shaxs.
Turli xil yangiliklar uchun suratga oladigan fotosuratchi.
ru: Человек, который доставляет газеты домой каждое утро.
Тот, кто разрабатывает макет страниц журнала и изображений.
Фотограф, который делает снимки для различных новостных сюжетов.

translation.en: News that has just happened and is being reported for the first time.
translation.uz: Yangi sodir bo'lgan va birinchi marta xabar qilinayotgan yangilik.
translation.ru: Новости, которые только что произошли и сообщаются впервые.

example: We interrupt this program for some **breaking news**.
The special report provided **breaking news** on the natural disaster.
Alerts popped up on my phone with the **breaking news**.

quiz.correct_answer: News that has just happened and is being reported for the first time.

en: News that has been planned and prepared in advance for publication.
A summary of the day's events presented at the end of a report.
Historical information about events from many years ago.
uz: Nashr qilish uchun oldindan rejalashtirilgan va tayyorlangan yangiliklar.
Hisobot oxirida taqdim etilgan kunlik voqealar xulosasi.
Ko'p yillar oldingi voqealar haqidagi tarixiy ma'lumotlar.
ru: Новости, которые были запланированы и подготовлены заранее к публикации.
Краткое изложение событий дня, представленное в конце отчета.
Историческая информация о событиях многолетней давности.

translation.en: A traditional way of behaving or doing something that is specific to a society or group.
translation.uz: Jamiyat yoki guruhga xos bo'lgan an'anaviy xatti-harakat yoki ish qilish usuli.
translation.ru: Традиционный способ поведения или выполнения чего-либо, характерный для общества или группы.

example: It's a common **custom** in many cultures to remove shoes indoors.
They follow an ancient **custom** of celebrating the harvest.
Learning about local **customs** is important when traveling.

quiz.correct_answer: A traditional way of behaving or doing something that is specific to a society or group.

en: A newly invented method that has no historical background or practice.
A strict legal rule or regulation enforced by government authorities.
A personal preference that varies greatly from person to person individually.
uz: Tarixiy asosga yoki amaliyotga ega bo'lmagan yangi ixtiro qilingan usul.
Hukumat organlari tomonidan qo'llaniladigan qat'iy qonuniy qoida yoki tartib.
Shaxsan har bir odamdan odamga qarab farq qiladigan shaxsiy xohish.
ru: Недавно изобретенный метод, не имеющий исторического происхождения или практики.
Строгое правовое правило или норма, установленная государственными органами.
Личное предпочтение, которое сильно варьируется от человека к человеку.

translation.en: A special day or period, usually with religious or cultural celebrations.
translation.uz: Odatda diniy yoki madaniy bayramlar bilan o'tadigan maxsus kun yoki davr.
translation.ru: Особый день или период, обычно с религиозными или культурными праздниками.

example: The town holds a music **festival** every summer.
Diwali is an important Hindu **festival** of lights.
Many traditional dances are performed during the **festival**.

quiz.correct_answer: A special day or period, usually with religious or cultural celebrations.

en: A regular weekly meeting for general business or social purposes.
A short break from work or school for only a few days off.
A serious academic conference discussing research and scientific topics.
uz: Umumiy biznes yoki ijtimoiy maqsadlar uchun muntazam haftalik yig'ilish.
Ish yoki maktabdan bir necha kunlik qisqa tanaffus.
Tadqiqot va ilmiy mavzularni muhokama qiluvchi jiddiy akademik konferentsiya.
ru: Регулярное еженедельное собрание для общих деловых или социальных целей.
Короткий перерыв от работы или учебы всего на несколько выходных дней.
Серьезная академическая конференция, обсуждающая исследовательские и научные темы.

translation.en: A belief, custom, or way of doing something that has existed for a long time.
translation.uz: Uzoq vaqtdan beri mavjud bo'lgan e'tiqod, odat yoki ish qilish usuli.
translation.ru: Верование, обычай или способ ведения дел, существующий долгое время.

example: It's a family **tradition** to have a big dinner on Sundays.
Many ancient **traditions** are still practiced today.
The wedding ceremony included several unique **traditions**.

quiz.correct_answer: A belief, custom, or way of doing something that has existed for a long time.

en: A new trend or fashion that quickly becomes popular and then fades.
A scientific experiment conducted in a controlled laboratory setting.
A spontaneous decision made without any prior thought or planning.
uz: Tezda ommalashib, so'ng yo'qoladigan yangi tendentsiya yoki moda.
Nazorat qilinadigan laboratoriya sharoitida o'tkaziladigan ilmiy tajriba.
Oldindan o'ylanmagan yoki rejalashtirilmagan holda qabul qilingan spontan qaror.
ru: Новая тенденция или мода, которая быстро становится популярной, а затем исчезает.
Научный эксперимент, проводимый в контролируемых лабораторных условиях.
Спонтанное решение, принятое без предварительного обдумывания или планирования.

translation.en: Features belonging to the culture of a particular society, like traditions, buildings, or art, that have continued from the past.
translation.uz: Ma'lum bir jamiyat madaniyatiga oid xususiyatlar, masalan, an'analar, binolar yoki san'at, o'tmishdan davom etib kelgan.
translation.ru: Особенности, принадлежащие культуре определенного общества, такие как традиции, здания или искусство, сохранившиеся из прошлого.

example: The city's rich **heritage** is reflected in its historic architecture.
We must preserve our cultural **heritage** for future generations.
The museum showcases the country's artistic **heritage**.

quiz.correct_answer: Features belonging to the culture of a particular society, like traditions, buildings, or art, that have continued from the past.

en: Modern advancements in technology and cutting-edge scientific discovery.
Current government policies and strict economic regulations recently enacted.
Contemporary artistic expressions developed very recently by new artists.
uz: Texnologiyadagi zamonaviy yutuqlar va eng so'nggi ilmiy kashfiyotlar.
Hukumatning joriy siyosati va yaqinda qabul qilingan qat'iy iqtisodiy qoidalar.
Yangi san'atkorlar tomonidan juda yaqinda yaratilgan zamonaviy badiiy ifodalar.
ru: Современные достижения в области технологий и передовые научные открытия.
Текущие государственные политики и строгие экономические регулирования, недавно принятые.
Современные художественные выражения, разработанные совсем недавно новыми художниками.

translation.en: The state of having people of different origins, religions, or types.
translation.uz: Turli kelib chiqishga, dinlarga yoki turlarga ega odamlarning mavjudligi holati.
translation.ru: Состояние наличия людей различного происхождения, вероисповедания или типа.

example: Cultural **diversity** enriches a society and promotes understanding.
The city is known for its ethnic **diversity**.
We celebrate the **diversity** of traditions in our community.

quiz.correct_answer: The state of having people of different origins, religions, or types.

en: A strong sense of unity and shared identity within a single group.
The process of making everything exactly the same for all people.
A complete lack of variety or differences among individuals involved.
uz: Bir guruh ichida birlik va umumiy o'ziga xoslikning kuchli hissi.
Hamma narsani hamma uchun bir xil qilish jarayoni.
Jalbj qilingan shaxslar o'rtasida xilma-xillik yoki farqlarning to'liq yo'qligi.
ru: Сильное чувство единства и общей идентичности внутри одной группы.
Процесс приведения всего к одному и тому же для всех людей.
Полное отсутствие разнообразия или различий между вовлеченными индивидуумами.

translation.en: A set of fixed actions and sometimes words performed regularly, especially as part of a ceremony.
translation.uz: Muntazam ravishda, ayniqsa marosimning bir qismi sifatida bajariladigan bir qator qat'iy harakatlar va ba'zan so'zlar.
translation.ru: Набор фиксированных действий, а иногда и слов, регулярно выполняемых, особенно как часть церемонии.

example: The ancient rain dance is a significant cultural **ritual**.
Before every game, the team performs a small good luck **ritual**.
Many cultures have specific **rituals** for weddings and funerals.

quiz.correct_answer: A set of fixed actions and sometimes words performed regularly, especially as part of a ceremony.

en: A spontaneous and completely unplanned event or happening.
A complex scientific experiment performed in a controlled laboratory.
A casual conversation between friends on an everyday topic.
uz: To'liq rejalashtirilmagan va o'z-o'zidan yuzaga keladigan hodisa.
Nazorat qilinadigan laboratoriyada o'tkaziladigan murakkab ilmiy tajriba.
Do'stlar o'rtasida kundalik mavzuda tasodifiy suhbat.
ru: Спонтанное и полностью незапланированное событие или происшествие.
Комплексный научный эксперимент, проводимый в контролируемой лаборатории.
Обычная беседа между друзьями на повседневную тему.

translation.en: The traditional stories, customs, and beliefs of a community.
translation.uz: Jamiyatning an'anaviy hikoyalari, urf-odatlari va e'tiqodlari.
translation.ru: Традиционные истории, обычаи и верования общины.

example: Local **folklore** includes tales of mythical creatures.
The university offers courses on various aspects of world **folklore**.
Children often enjoy reading stories from national **folklore**.

quiz.correct_answer: The traditional stories, customs, and beliefs of a community.

en: Modern academic theories about human behavior and psychology.
Official government reports on historical events and data.
Scientific research findings published in academic journals.
uz: Inson xulq-atvori va psixologiyasi haqidagi zamonaviy akademik nazariyalar.
Tarixiy voqealar va ma'lumotlar bo'yicha rasmiy hukumat hisobotlari.
Ilmiy jurnallarda chop etilgan ilmiy tadqiqot natijalari.
ru: Современные академические теории о человеческом поведении и психологии.
Официальные правительственные отчеты об исторических событиях и данных.
Результаты научных исследований, опубликованные в академических журналах.

translation.en: A style of cooking, usually associated with a particular country or region.
translation.uz: Odatda ma'lum bir mamlakat yoki mintaqa bilan bog'liq bo'lgan pishirish uslubi.
translation.ru: Стиль приготовления пищи, обычно связанный с определенной страной или регионом.

example: Italian **cuisine** is famous for its pasta and pizza dishes.
She loves trying different types of international **cuisine**.
The restaurant specializes in authentic regional **cuisine**.

quiz.correct_answer: A style of cooking, usually associated with a particular country or region.

en: A type of traditional dance performed at cultural festivals.
A popular musical genre originating from a specific country.
A method of building houses in a certain architectural style.
uz: Madaniy festivallarda ijro etiladigan an'anaviy raqs turi.
Ma'lum bir mamlakatdan kelib chiqqan mashhur musiqiy janr.
Ma'lum bir arxitektura uslubida uylar qurish usuli.
ru: Вид традиционного танца, исполняемого на культурных фестивалях.
Популярный музыкальный жанр, происходящий из определенной страны.
Метод строительства домов в определенном архитектурном стиле.

translation.en: An object made by a human being, typically an item of cultural or historical interest.
translation.uz: Inson tomonidan yasalgan buyum, odatda madaniy yoki tarixiy ahamiyatga ega narsa.
translation.ru: Объект, сделанный человеком, обычно предмет культурного или исторического интереса.

example: The museum displays ancient Roman **artifacts**.
Archaeologists discovered a rare **artifact** at the dig site.
Each **artifact** tells a story about the past civilization.

quiz.correct_answer: An object made by a human being, typically an item of cultural or historical interest.

en: A natural rock formation found in a deep cave system.
A type of plant grown only in a specific climate zone.
A newly invented piece of technology for everyday modern use.
uz: Chuqur g'or tizimida topilgan tabiiy tosh shakli.
Faqat ma'lum bir iqlim zonasida o'sadigan o'simlik turi.
Kundalik zamonaviy foydalanish uchun yangi ixtiro qilingan texnologiya parchasi.
ru: Естественное скальное образование, найденное в глубокой пещерной системе.
Тип растения, произрастающий только в определенной климатической зоне.
Недавно изобретенная технология для повседневного современного использования.

translation.en: The beliefs about what is right and wrong and what is important in life.
translation.uz: Hayotda nima to'g'ri va nima noto'g'ri, nima muhimligi haqidagi e'tiqodlar.
translation.ru: Убеждения о том, что правильно и что неправильно, и что важно в жизни.

example: Family **values** are deeply ingrained in their culture.
The community shares common **values** of honesty and hard work.
It's important to live by your own personal **values**.

quiz.correct_answer: The beliefs about what is right and wrong and what is important in life.

en: The current market prices of goods and services at a store.
Strict legal regulations enforced by governmental authorities.
Opinions that are constantly changing and evolving over time.
uz: Do'kondagi tovarlar va xizmatlarning joriy bozor narxlari.
Hukumat organlari tomonidan qo'llaniladigan qat'iy huquqiy qoidalar.
Vaqt o'tishi bilan doimiy ravishda o'zgarib boruvchi fikrlar.
ru: Текущие рыночные цены на товары и услуги в магазине.
Строгие правовые нормы, применяемые государственными органами.
Мнения, которые постоянно меняются и развиваются со временем.

translation.en: All of the people born and living at about the same time.
translation.uz: Taxminan bir vaqtda tug'ilgan va yashayotgan barcha odamlar.
translation.ru: Все люди, родившиеся и живущие примерно в одно и то же время.

example: The younger **generation** is very tech-savvy.
This tradition has been passed down through many **generations**.
Each **generation** faces its own unique challenges.

quiz.correct_answer: All of the people born and living at about the same time.

en: A short period of time, typically lasting only a few days or weeks.
A group of people with completely different social backgrounds.
Individuals who share similar hobbies but not age groups.
uz: Odatda bir necha kun yoki hafta davom etadigan qisqa vaqt oralig'i.
Butunlay boshqa ijtimoiy kelib chiqishga ega bo'lgan odamlar guruhi.
O'xshash qiziqishlarga ega bo'lgan, ammo yosh guruhlariga emas, shaxslar.
ru: Короткий период времени, обычно длительностью всего несколько дней или недель.
Группа людей с совершенно разным социальным происхождением.
Индивидуумы, которые разделяют схожие хобби, но не возрастные группы.

translation.en: The qualities, beliefs, personality, looks, and expressions that make a person or group.
translation.uz: Shaxs yoki guruhni tashkil etuvchi sifatlar, e'tiqodlar, shaxsiyat, tashqi ko'rinish va ifodalar.
translation.ru: Качества, убеждения, личность, внешний вид и выражения, которые формируют человека или группу.

example: National **identity** is often shaped by shared history and culture.
She is exploring her cultural **identity** through art.
Language plays a key role in a community's **identity**.

quiz.correct_answer: The qualities, beliefs, personality, looks, and expressions that make a person or group.

en: A collection of random objects without any specific meaning or connection.
A temporary role or disguise adopted for a short period of time.
The process of changing one's entire appearance for a different look.
uz: Hech qanday o'ziga xos ma'no yoki aloqasi bo'lmagan tasodifiy obyektlar to'plami.
Qisqa vaqtga qabul qilingan vaqtinchalik rol yoki niqob.
Boshqa ko'rinish uchun butun tashqi ko'rinishni o'zgartirish jarayoni.
ru: Набор случайных объектов без какого-либо конкретного смысла или связи.
Временная роль или маскировка, принятая на короткий период времени.
Процесс полного изменения внешности для получения другого вида.

translation.en: A sign, object, or picture that represents something else.
translation.uz: Boshqa narsani ifodalovchi belgi, obyekt yoki rasm.
translation.ru: Знак, объект или изображение, которое что-то представляет.

example: The dove is a **symbol** of peace.
The national flag is a powerful **symbol** of the country.
Wearing certain colors can be a **symbol** of protest.

quiz.correct_answer: A sign, object, or picture that represents something else.

en: A simple tool used for basic manual labor tasks.
A large, detailed map showing geographical features.
A type of mathematical equation used in advanced science.
uz: Oddiy qo'l mehnatini bajarish uchun ishlatiladigan oddiy asbob.
Geografik xususiyatlarni ko'rsatuvchi katta, batafsil xarita.
Ilg'or fanlarda ishlatiladigan matematik tenglama turi.
ru: Простой инструмент, используемый для основных ручных работ.
Большая, подробная карта, показывающая географические особенности.
Тип математического уравнения, используемого в продвинутой науке.

translation.en: To keep something in its original state or in good condition.
translation.uz: Biror narsani asl holatida yoki yaxshi holatda saqlash.
translation.ru: Сохранять что-либо в его первоначальном состоянии или в хорошем состоянии.

example: We must **preserve** historical buildings for future generations.
Efforts are being made to **preserve** endangered languages.
The community is working to **preserve** its unique traditions.

quiz.correct_answer: To keep something in its original state or in good condition.

en: To completely change something into a brand new form.
To intentionally destroy an object or ancient building.
To ignore something until it naturally disappears or fades away.
uz: Biror narsani butunlay yangi shaklga o'zgartirish.
Obyektni yoki qadimiy binoni ataylab yo'q qilish.
Biror narsani o'z-o'zidan g'oyib bo'lmaguncha e'tiborsiz qoldirish.
ru: Полностью изменить что-либо в совершенно новую форму.
Намеренно уничтожить объект или древнее здание.
Игнорировать что-либо, пока оно естественным образом не исчезнет или не потускнеет.

translation.en: A way of expressing ideas or feelings, especially in music, dance, or painting.
translation.uz: G'oyalar yoki his-tuyg'ularni ifodalash usuli, ayniqsa musiqa, raqs yoki rasmda.
translation.ru: Способ выражения идей или чувств, особенно в музыке, танце или живописи.

example: Ballet is a beautiful **art form** that combines music and dance.
Painting is an ancient **art form** with many different styles.
Storytelling is a powerful **art form** that connects people.

quiz.correct_answer: A way of expressing ideas or feelings, especially in music, dance, or painting.

en: A type of scientific experiment used to test hypotheses.
A simple method for organizing information into categories.
A practical skill used for everyday tasks and chores.
uz: Gipotezalarni sinash uchun ishlatiladigan ilmiy tajriba turi.
Ma'lumotlarni kategoriyalarga ajratish uchun oddiy usul.
Kundalik vazifalar va ishlarni bajarish uchun ishlatiladigan amaliy ko'nikma.
ru: Тип научного эксперимента, используемый для проверки гипотез.
Простой метод организации информации по категориям.
Практический навык, используемый для повседневных задач и рутины.

translation.en: The process by which people from different cultures share ideas, traditions, and ways of life.
translation.uz: Turli madaniyatlarga mansub odamlarning g'oyalar, an'analar va turmush tarzini almashish jarayoni.
translation.ru: Процесс, при котором люди из разных культур обмениваются идеями, традициями и образом жизни.

example: Student programs promote **cultural exchange** between countries.
The festival offered a great opportunity for **cultural exchange**.
Through **cultural exchange**, we learn to appreciate differences.

quiz.correct_answer: The process by which people from different cultures share ideas, traditions, and ways of life.

en: A competition between different cultures to see which is best.
A formal agreement to limit the spread of cultural influences.
The act of one culture completely replacing another's practices.
uz: Qaysi biri eng yaxshi ekanligini bilish uchun turli madaniyatlar o'rtasidagi musobaqa.
Madaniy ta'sirlarning tarqalishini cheklash bo'yicha rasmiy kelishuv.
Bir madaniyatning boshqa madaniyat amaliyotlarini butunlay almashtirish harakati.
ru: Соревнование между различными культурами, чтобы определить, какая из них лучше.
Формальное соглашение об ограничении распространения культурных влияний.
Акт полного замещения одной культурой практик другой.

translation.en: A person in your family who lived a long time ago.
translation.uz: Oilangizda uzoq vaqt oldin yashagan shaxs.
translation.ru: Человек из вашей семьи, который жил давно.

example: Many people trace their **ancestors** back several centuries.
Our traditions were passed down from our **ancestors**.
He discovered that his **ancestors** were from a different country.

quiz.correct_answer: A person in your family who lived a long time ago.

en: A close friend who you have known for many years.
A new member of your immediate family, such as a baby.
A famous historical figure who is not related to you.
uz: Ko'p yillar davomida tanish bo'lgan yaqin do'st.
Yaqin oilangizning yangi a'zosi, masalan, chaqaloq.
Siz bilan bog'liq bo'lmagan mashhur tarixiy shaxs.
ru: Близкий друг, которого вы знаете много лет.
Новый член вашей непосредственной семьи, например, ребенок.
Известная историческая личность, не связанная с вами.

translation.en: Originating or occurring naturally in a particular place; native.
translation.uz: Ma'lum bir joyda tabiiy ravishda paydo bo'lgan yoki yuzaga kelgan; mahalliy.
translation.ru: Происходящий или встречающийся естественным образом в определенном месте; местный.

example: The region is home to several **indigenous** tribes.
We learned about the **indigenous** plants and animals of the area.
Preserving **indigenous** languages is very important for cultural survival.

quiz.correct_answer: Originating or occurring naturally in a particular place; native.

en: Recently introduced to a place from another foreign country.
A type of modern technology developed in urban centers.
Found only in laboratories and artificial environments.
uz: Boshqa xorijiy mamlakatdan yaqinda bir joyga olib kelingan.
Shahar markazlarida ishlab chiqilgan zamonaviy texnologiya turi.
Faqat laboratoriyalar va sun'iy muhitlarda topilgan.
ru: Недавно завезенный в какое-либо место из другой зарубежной страны.
Вид современных технологий, разработанных в городских центрах.
Встречается только в лабораториях и искусственных средах.

translation.en: The process by which businesses or other organizations develop international influence or start operating on an international scale.
translation.uz: Korxonalar yoki boshqa tashkilotlarning xalqaro ta'sirga ega bo'lishi yoki xalqaro miqyosda faoliyat yuritishni boshlashi jarayoni.
translation.ru: Процесс, при котором предприятия или другие организации развивают международное влияние или начинают действовать в международном масштабе.

example: **Globalization** has led to increased interconnectedness worldwide.
The internet has played a huge role in **globalization**.
Some argue that **globalization** can threaten local cultures.

quiz.correct_answer: The process by which businesses or other organizations develop international influence or start operating on an international scale.

Побуждать кого-либо продолжать говорить очень долго.
Полностью соглашаться со всем, что говорит другой человек.

translation.en: To show or say what you think or feel.
translation.uz: Ifodalamoq
translation.ru: Выражать

example: It's important to **express** your feelings clearly and openly.
She struggled to **express** her gratitude for their kindness.
He used art to **express** his deep inner thoughts and emotions.

quiz.correct_answer: To show or say what you think or feel.

en: To hide your true emotions from others deliberately.
To keep your opinions entirely to yourself and not share.
To pretend to feel something you don't actually feel.
uz: O'z haqiqiy his-tuyg'ularingizni boshqalardan ataylab yashirish.
O'z fikrlaringizni butunlay o'zingizda saqlash va ulashmaslik.
O'zingiz his qilmaydigan narsani his qilgandek ko'rsatish.
ru: Намеренно скрывать свои истинные эмоции от других.
Хранить свои мнения полностью при себе и не делиться ими.
Притворяться, что чувствуешь то, чего на самом деле не чувствуешь.

translation.en: Not polite; showing a lack of respect for other people.
translation.uz: Qo'pol
translation.ru: Грубый

example: It was **rude** of him to interrupt the speaker repeatedly.
Don't be **rude** to the customer service representative on the phone.
Her **rude** comments upset many people in the discussion group.

quiz.correct_answer: Not polite; showing a lack of respect for other people.

en: Always behaving with kindness and exceptional good manners.
Showing great consideration and deep empathy for others.
Being very quiet and reserved in all social interactions.
uz: Har doim mehribonlik va o'ta yaxshi xulq-atvor bilan harakat qilish.
Boshqalarga katta e'tibor va chuqur hamdardlik ko'rsatish.
Barcha ijtimoiy munosabatlarda juda jim va tortinchoq bo'lish.
ru: Всегда вести себя с добротой и исключительно хорошими манерами.
Проявлять большое внимание и глубокое сочувствие к другим.
Быть очень тихим и сдержанным во всех социальных взаимодействиях.

translation.en: To talk about something with another person or group.
translation.uz: Muhokama qilmoq
translation.ru: Обсуждать

example: Let's **discuss** your ideas for the project during our meeting.
We need to **discuss** the new changes to the schedule.
They spent hours discussing their travel plans for the summer.

quiz.correct_answer: To talk about something with another person or group.

en: To ignore a topic completely and move on without mention.
To immediately make a decision without any input.
To keep information secret from everyone involved.
uz: Mavzuni butunlay e'tiborsiz qoldirish va hech narsa demasdan davom etish.
Hech qanday ma'lumot kiritmasdan darhol qaror qabul qilish.
Ma'lumotni barcha ishtirokchilardan sir saqlash.
ru: Полностью игнорировать тему и переходить к следующему без упоминания.
Немедленно принимать решение без какого-либо участия.
Хранить информацию в секрете от всех участников.

translation.en: To make something clear or easy to understand by describing it.
translation.uz: Tushuntirmoq
translation.ru: Объяснять

example: Could you **explain** this concept to me again, please?
He tried to **explain** why he was late for the appointment.
The teacher had to **explain** the instructions several times.

quiz.correct_answer: To make something clear or easy to understand by describing it.

en: To confuse someone by giving unclear or vague details.
To keep information hidden and not share it with anyone.
To simply state facts without offering any context.
uz: Noaniq yoki mavhum tafsilotlarni berish orqali kimnidir chalkashtirish.
Ma'lumotni yashirin saqlash va uni hech kim bilan baham ko'rmaslik.
Hech qanday kontekst bermasdan shunchaki faktlarni bayon qilish.
ru: Запутать кого-либо, давая неясные или расплывчатые детали.
Хранить информацию в тайне и никому не сообщать.
Просто констатировать факты, не предлагая никакого контекста.

translation.en: Pleasant and easy to get along with; willing to agree.
translation.uz: Kelim-kelishgan
translation.ru: Приятный, покладистый

example: She has a very **agreeable** personality, making friends easily.
The weather was surprisingly **agreeable** for our outdoor event.
He was **agreeable** to the changes in the plan, showing flexibility.

quiz.correct_answer: Pleasant and easy to get along with; willing to agree.

en: Difficult to please or always looking for an argument.
Always challenging every idea presented to them.
Someone who avoids social interactions at all costs.
uz: Xush yoqmaydigan yoki har doim bahs izlaydigan.
Ularga taqdim etilgan har bir g'oyani doimo shubha ostiga oladigan.
Ijtimoiy o'zaro munosabatlardan har qanday holatda ham qochadigan odam.
ru: Трудно угодить или всегда ищущий повода для спора.
Всегда оспаривающий каждую представленную им идею.
Тот, кто избегает социальных взаимодействий любой ценой.

translation.en: The quality of being polite and showing good manners.
translation.uz: Xushmuomalalik
translation.ru: Вежливость

example: Her **politeness** made a very good impression on everyone.
He always treats customers with utmost **politeness**.
In some cultures, certain gestures are considered a sign of **politeness**.

quiz.correct_answer: The quality of being polite and showing good manners.

en: The act of being intentionally disrespectful to others.
The ability to speak loudly and dominate conversations.
The state of being completely quiet and withdrawn.
uz: Boshqalarga ataylab hurmatsizlik qilish harakati.
Baland ovozda gapirish va suhbatlarda hukmronlik qilish qobiliyati.
To'liq jim va o'ziga tortilgan holat.
ru: Акт намеренного неуважения к другим.
Способность громко говорить и доминировать в разговорах.
Состояние полного молчания и замкнутости.

translation.en: To fail to understand something correctly.
translation.uz: Noto'g'ri tushunmoq
translation.ru: Неправильно понять

example: I think you **misunderstand** my point; let me rephrase it.
It's easy to **misunderstand** instructions if they are unclear.
There was a complete **misunderstanding** between them.

quiz.correct_answer: To fail to understand something correctly.

en: To completely agree with everything someone says.
To clearly explain a complex topic to others.
To quickly grasp the meaning of a difficult concept.
uz: Kimnidir aytgan har bir narsasiga butunlay rozi bo'lish.
Murakkab mavzuni boshqalarga aniq tushuntirish.
Qiyin tushunchaning ma'nosini tezda tushunib olish.
ru: Полностью соглашаться со всем, что говорит кто-либо.
Четко объяснять сложную тему другим.
Быстро схватывать смысл сложной концепции.

translation.en: Information about reactions to a product, a person's performance of a task, etc.
translation.uz: Qayta aloqa
translation.ru: Обратная связь

example: We would appreciate your **feedback** on our new website design.
The teacher gave the students constructive **feedback** on their essays.
It's important to listen to customer **feedback** to improve services.

quiz.correct_answer: Information about reactions to a product, a person's performance of a task, etc.

en: A command or instruction given to complete a specific task.
A request for a refund on a purchased item or service.
A detailed financial report about a company's earnings.
uz: Muayyan vazifani bajarish uchun berilgan buyruq yoki ko'rsatma.
Sotib olingan narsa yoki xizmat uchun pulni qaytarishni so'rash.
Kompaniyaning daromadlari haqida batafsil moliyaviy hisobot.
ru: Команда или инструкция, данная для выполнения конкретной задачи.
Запрос на возврат средств за приобретенный товар или услугу.
Подробный финансовый отчет о доходах компании.

translation.en: To express a different opinion from someone else, often angrily.
translation.uz: Bahslashmoq
translation.ru: Спорить

example: They always **argue** about politics during family dinners.
There's no point in trying to **argue** with him, he won't listen.
I don't want to **argue**, let's try to find a compromise.

quiz.correct_answer: To express a different opinion from someone else, often angrily.

en: To wholeheartedly agree with someone without question.
To listen passively and accept all statements quietly.
To make a suggestion for a peaceful resolution.
uz: Kimnidir savolsiz butunlay qo'llab-quvvatlash.
Passiv tinglash va barcha bayonotlarni jim qabul qilish.
Tinch yo'l bilan hal qilish uchun taklif kiritish.
ru: Полностью соглашаться с кем-либо без вопросов.
Пассивно слушать и тихо принимать все утверждения.
Внести предложение по мирному урегулированию.

translation.en: To make someone do or believe something by giving them good reasons.
translation.uz: Ko'ndirmoq
translation.ru: Убеждать

example: He tried to **persuade** her to come to the party with him.
It was difficult to **persuade** them to change their minds.
Can you **persuade** your parents to let you go on the trip?

quiz.correct_answer: To make someone do or believe something by giving them good reasons.

en: To force someone to do something against their will.
To completely ignore someone's opinion or request.
To discourage someone from pursuing a particular action.
uz: Kimnidir o'z xohishiga qarshi biror narsa qilishga majburlash.
Kimningdir fikrini yoki iltimosini butunlay e'tiborsiz qoldirish.
Kimnidir ma'lum bir harakatni davom ettirishdan qaytarish.
ru: Заставить кого-либо сделать или поверить во что-либо, приводя веские причины.
Полностью игнорировать чье-либо мнение или просьбу.
Отговаривать кого-либо от совершения определенного действия.

translation.en: To travel regularly over some distance between one's home and place of work or study.
translation.uz: Uy va ish yoki oʻqish joyi oʻrtasida muntazam ravishda maʼlum masofani bosib oʻtish.
translation.ru: Регулярно ездить на работу или учебу на определенное расстояние между домом и местом работы или учебы.

example: Many people commute to the city center for work every day.
Her daily commute takes almost an hour by train.
He dislikes his long commute, so he's looking for a job closer to home.

quiz.correct_answer: To travel regularly over some distance between one's home and place of work or study.

en: To make a journey for pleasure, often to a distant place for holidays.
To change from one form of transport to another during a single trip.
To take a short trip for a specific purpose or for leisure activities.
uz: Dam olish uchun, ko'pincha uzoq joyga sayohat qilish.
Bir sayohat davomida bir transport turidan boshqasiga o'tish.
Ma'lum bir maqsad yoki dam olish faoliyati uchun qisqa safarga chiqish.
ru: Совершать путешествие ради удовольствия, часто в отдаленное место для отдыха.
Пересаживаться с одного вида транспорта на другой во время одной поездки.
Совершить короткую поездку с определенной целью или для досуга.

translation.en: The money a passenger on public transport has to pay.
translation.uz: Jamoat transportida yo'lovchi to'lashi kerak bo'lgan pul.
translation.ru: Деньги, которые пассажир общественного транспорта должен заплатить за проезд.

example: The bus fare has increased recently, making it more expensive.
You need to pay the exact fare when you get on the bus.
Children under five travel for half fare on this route.

quiz.correct_answer: The money a passenger on public transport has to pay.

en: The schedule of arrival and departure times for trains or buses.
A ticket that allows unlimited travel on public transport systems.
The total distance traveled from one place to another place.
uz: Poezdlar yoki avtobuslar uchun kelish va ketish vaqtlari jadvali.
Jamoat transporti tizimlarida cheksiz sayohat qilish imkonini beruvchi chipta.
Bir joydan ikkinchi joyga bosib o'tilgan umumiy masofa.
ru: Расписание прибытия и отправления поездов или автобусов.
Билет, который позволяет неограниченно пользоваться общественным транспортом.
Общее расстояние, пройденное от одного места до другого.

translation.en: A raised level surface alongside a railway track or in a station, from which passengers get on and off trains.
translation.uz: Temir yo'l yo'li bo'ylab yoki stansiyada ko'tarilgan tekis yuzasi, undan yo'lovchilar poezdlarga chiqishadi va tushishadi.
translation.ru: Поднятая ровная поверхность вдоль железнодорожного пути или на станции, с которой пассажиры садятся и выходят из поездов.

example: The train to London departs from platform 3.
Please stand behind the yellow line on the platform for your safety.
We waited on the crowded platform for the delayed express train.

quiz.correct_answer: A raised level surface alongside a railway track or in a station, from which passengers get on and off trains.

en: A designated area where buses stop to pick up or drop off passengers.
The main building at a train station where tickets are sold to travelers.
A special path used only by pedestrians or cyclists, not by cars.
uz: Avtobuslar yo'lovchilarni olish yoki tushirish uchun to'xtaydigan belgilangan hudud.
Poezd stantsiyasining asosiy binosi, bu yerda sayohatchilarga chiptalar sotiladi.
Faqat piyodalar yoki velosipedchilar tomonidan ishlatiladigan, avtomobillar uchun emas, maxsus yo'l.
ru: Обозначенная зона, где автобусы останавливаются для посадки или высадки пассажиров.
Главное здание на железнодорожной станции, где продаются билеты пассажирам.
Специальная дорожка, используемая только пешеходами или велосипедистами, а не автомобилями.

translation.en: A period of rest or waiting between two stages of a journey.
translation.uz: Sayohatingizning ikki bosqichi orasidagi dam olish yoki kutish davri.
translation.ru: Период отдыха или ожидания между двумя этапами длительного путешествия.

example: We had a three-hour layover in Dubai before our connecting flight.
A long layover can be tiresome if there's nothing to do at the airport.
She booked a flight with a short layover to reach her destination faster.

quiz.correct_answer: A period of rest or waiting between two stages of a journey.

en: A sudden change in travel plans, often due to unexpected circumstances.
A specific type of travel where you visit many different countries.
The duration of a direct flight from the departure city to arrival.
uz: Sayohat rejalarida kutilmagan vaziyatlar tufayli yuzaga keladigan keskin o'zgarish.
Ko'plab turli mamlakatlarga tashrif buyuriladigan maxsus sayohat turi.
Uchish shahridan yetib borishgacha bo'lgan to'g'ridan-to'g'ri reysning davomiyligi.
ru: Внезапное изменение планов путешествия, часто из-за непредвиденных обстоятельств.
Особый тип путешествия, при котором вы посещаете много разных стран.
Продолжительность прямого рейса от города отправления до прибытия.

translation.en: The area in an airport where arriving passengers collect their checked luggage.
translation.uz: Aeroportda kelgan yo'lovchilar ro'yxatdan o'tkazilgan yuklarini olish joyi.
translation.ru: Зона в аэропорту, где прибывающие пассажиры забирают свой зарегистрированный багаж.

example: After landing, we headed straight to baggage claim to get our suitcases.
There was a long queue at baggage claim, so we had to wait patiently.
I couldn't find my bag at baggage claim and had to report it missing.

quiz.correct_answer: The area in an airport where arriving passengers collect their checked luggage.

en: The security checkpoint where passengers and their bags are screened before flights.
A counter in an airport where you can check in your luggage for a flight.
A place where you can buy tickets for various forms of public transport.
uz: Parvozlardan oldin yo'lovchilar va ularning sumkalari tekshiriladigan xavfsizlik nazorati punkti.
Aeroportda parvoz uchun yukingizni ro'yxatdan o'tkazishingiz mumkin bo'lgan peshtaxta.
Jamoat transportining turli turlari uchun chiptalarni sotib olish mumkin bo'lgan joy.
ru: Пункт контроля безопасности, где пассажиров и их багаж проверяют перед полетами.
Стойка в аэропорту, где можно зарегистрировать свой багаж на рейс.
Место, где можно купить билеты на различные виды общественного транспорта.

translation.en: A situation in which something happens later than it should or later than expected.
translation.uz: Biror narsa kerak bo'lganidan yoki kutilganidan kechroq sodir bo'ladigan holat.
translation.ru: Ситуация, когда что-то происходит позже, чем должно или позже, чем ожидалось.

example: Our flight had a two-hour delay due to bad weather conditions.
Traffic delays are common during rush hour in big cities.
The train announced a short delay due to technical issues on the tracks.

quiz.correct_answer: A situation in which something happens later than it should or later than expected.

en: A sudden and unexpected change in the planned route of a journey.
The scheduled time for departure of a public transport vehicle.
An official announcement about a change in travel arrangements.
uz: Sayohatning rejalashtirilgan yo'nalishida kutilmagan va keskin o'zgarish.
Jamoat transporti vositasining jo'nash vaqti.
Sayohat tartiblaridagi o'zgarish haqida rasmiy e'lon.
ru: Внезапное и неожиданное изменение запланированного маршрута путешествия.
Запланированное время отправления транспортного средства общественного транспорта.
Официальное объявление об изменении расписания поездок.

translation.en: The action of calling off or stopping something that was planned or arranged.
translation.uz: Rejalashtirilgan yoki tashkil etilgan narsani bekor qilish yoki to'xtatish harakati.
translation.ru: Действие по отмене или прекращению чего-либо, что было запланировано или устроено.

example: The cancellation of the flight caused a lot of inconvenience for passengers.
Due to low demand, the cancellation of the morning bus service was announced.
We received an email about the cancellation of our hotel reservation.

quiz.correct_answer: The action of calling off or stopping something that was planned or arranged.

en: A temporary stop in a journey, typically for a short duration.
The process of rescheduling an event for a different future time.
An official permit that allows someone to travel to a foreign country.
uz: Sayohatda vaqtinchalik to'xtash, odatda qisqa muddatga.
Voqeani boshqa kelajakdagi vaqtga qayta rejalashtirish jarayoni.
Chet elga sayohat qilishga ruxsat beruvchi rasmiy ruxsatnoma.
ru: Временная остановка в пути, обычно на короткий срок.
Процесс переноса события на другое будущее время.
Официальное разрешение, позволяющее кому-либо путешествовать в чужую страну.

translation.en: A bus, train, or plane that travels regularly between two places.
translation.uz: Ikki joy o'rtasida muntazam ravishda qatnaydigan avtobus, poezd yoki samolyot.
translation.ru: Автобус, поезд или самолет, который регулярно курсирует между двумя пунктами.

example: The hotel offers a free shuttle service to the airport.
We took the shuttle from the parking lot to the concert venue.
The company provides a daily shuttle for employees from the city center.

quiz.correct_answer: A bus, train, or plane that travels regularly between two places.

en: A type of short boat used for crossing small bodies of water.
A system of roads or tracks designed for very fast transportation.
A temporary vehicle used only for emergency transport situations.
uz: Kichik suv havzalarini kesib o'tish uchun ishlatiladigan qisqa qayiq turi.
Juda tez transport uchun mo'ljallangan yo'l yoki yo'l tizimi.
Faqat favqulodda transport vaziyatlari uchun ishlatiladigan vaqtinchalik transport vositasi.
ru: Тип небольшой лодки, используемой для пересечения небольших водоемов.
Система дорог или путей, предназначенная для очень быстрой транспортировки.
Временное транспортное средство, используемое только для экстренных перевозок.

translation.en: Relating to or traveling between different cities.
translation.uz: Har xil shaharlar o'rtasida harakatlanadigan yoki ular bilan bog'liq bo'lgan.
translation.ru: Относящийся к путешествиям между различными городами или их соединяющий.

example: The intercity train connects the capital with several major towns.
We booked an intercity bus ticket for our trip across the country.
Intercity travel can be quite efficient if you plan your route well.

quiz.correct_answer: Relating to or traveling between different cities.

en: Within the boundaries of a single town or city, not extending beyond.
Connecting two or more rural areas, avoiding urban centers completely.
Designed for very short distances, typically within a neighborhood.
uz: Bir shahar yoki shaharning chegaralari ichida, undan tashqariga chiqmaydigan.
Ikki yoki undan ortiq qishloq joylarini bog'laydigan, shahar markazlaridan butunlay qochadigan.
Juda qisqa masofalar uchun mo'ljallangan, odatda mahalla ichida.
ru: В пределах границ одного города, не выходя за его пределы.
Соединяющий две или более сельские местности, полностью избегая городских центров.
Предназначен для очень коротких расстояний, обычно в пределах района.

translation.en: A journey to a place and back again.
translation.uz: Bir joyga borish va qaytib kelish safar.
translation.ru: Путешествие в одно место и обратно, включающее обе части маршрута.

example: I bought a round trip ticket to New York for my vacation.
Is the price quoted for a one-way or a round trip journey?
A round trip flight is usually cheaper than buying two separate one-way tickets.

quiz.correct_answer: A journey to a place and back again.

en: A journey from one place to another without returning to the starting point.
A continuous journey around the world, visiting many countries.
A trip taken for a very short duration, typically lasting less than a day.
uz: Boshlang'ich nuqtaga qaytmasdan bir joydan ikkinchi joyga sayohat.
Dunyo bo'ylab ko'plab mamlakatlarga tashrif buyuradigan uzluksiz sayohat.
Juda qisqa muddatli, odatda bir kundan kamroq davom etadigan sayohat.
ru: Путешествие из одного места в другое без возвращения в начальную точку.
Непрерывное кругосветное путешествие с посещением многих стран.
Поездка очень короткой продолжительности, обычно менее одного дня.

translation.en: A journey to a place but not back again.
translation.uz: Bir joyga boradigan, lekin qaytib kelmaydigan safar.
translation.ru: Поездка в одно место, но без возвращения обратно в начальный пункт.

example: I only need a one-way ticket to Berlin, as I'm moving there.
The bus route is one-way, so you can't come back on the same street.
He booked a one-way flight, not knowing when he'd return home.

quiz.correct_answer: A journey to a place but not back again.

en: A journey that involves multiple stops before reaching the final destination.
A trip that requires changing vehicles several times during the route.
A return journey that concludes at the original departure point.
uz: Yakuniy manzilga yetib borguncha bir nechta to'xtash joylarini o'z ichiga olgan sayohat.
Marshrut davomida bir necha marta transport vositalarini o'zgartirishni talab qiladigan safar.
Asl jo'nash joyida yakunlanadigan qaytish sayohati.
ru: Путешествие, которое включает несколько остановок перед прибытием в конечный пункт назначения.
Поездка, которая требует нескольких пересадок во время маршрута.
Обратное путешествие, которое завершается в исходной точке отправления.

translation.en: The place to which someone or something is going or being sent.
translation.uz: Biror kimsa yoki narsa boradigan yoki yuboriladigan joy.
translation.ru: Место, куда кто-то или что-то направляется или отправляется в пункт назначения.

example: Our final destination is a small village in the mountains.
What's your preferred holiday destination this summer?
After a long journey, we finally arrived at our desired destination.

quiz.correct_answer: The place to which someone or something is going or being sent.

en: The starting point from which a journey begins or commences.
A temporary stop made during a longer journey to rest or explore.
The specific route or path taken to reach a particular location.
uz: Sayohat boshlanadigan yoki boshlanadigan boshlang'ich nuqta.
Uzoq sayohat davomida dam olish yoki o'rganish uchun qilingan vaqtinchalik to'xtash.
Ma'lum bir joyga yetib borish uchun bosib o'tilgan aniq marshrut yoki yo'l.
ru: Начальная точка, с которой начинается или отправляется путешествие.
Временная остановка во время длительного путешествия для отдыха или изучения.
Конкретный маршрут или путь, пройденный для достижения определенного места.

translation.en: A planned route or journey.
translation.uz: Rejalashtirilgan marshrut yoki sayohat.
translation.ru: Планируемый маршрут или путешествие с указанием всех пунктов и дат.

example: Our travel agent helped us plan a detailed itinerary for our trip.
I always create an itinerary before embarking on a long vacation.
The itinerary includes visits to famous landmarks and local markets.

quiz.correct_answer: A planned route or journey.

en: A single, unexpected change in a trip's schedule or a route.
A specific type of travel insurance policy that covers emergencies.
A collection of souvenirs purchased during a long holiday trip.
uz: Sayohat jadvali yoki yo'nalishida yagona, kutilmagan o'zgarish.
Favqulodda vaziyatlarni qoplaydigan maxsus sayohat sug'urtasi turi.
Uzoq ta'til safari davomida sotib olingan suvenirlar to'plami.
ru: Единичное, неожиданное изменение в расписании или маршруте поездки.
Особый вид страхового полиса для путешествий, покрывающий чрезвычайные ситуации.
Коллекция сувениров, купленных во время длительной туристической поездки.

translation.en: An endorsement on a passport indicating that the holder is allowed to enter, leave, or stay for a specified period in a country.
translation.uz: Pasportga berilgan tasdiqlash, uning egasiga ma'lum bir mamlakatga kirish, chiqish yoki u yerda ma'lum muddat qolishga ruxsat berilishini bildiradi.
translation.ru: Разрешение в паспорте, указывающее, что его владельцу разрешено въезжать, выезжать или находиться в стране в течение определенного периода времени.

example: You might need a visa to visit certain countries, depending on your nationality.
Applying for a visa can sometimes take several weeks or even months.
Her visa was approved just in time for her international conference.

quiz.correct_answer: An endorsement on a passport indicating that the holder is allowed to enter, leave, or stay for a specified period in a country.

en: A legal document that grants citizenship to a foreign national living abroad.
A small, portable identification card used for domestic travel.
A special permission required only for emergency medical travel abroad.
uz: Chet elda yashovchi chet el fuqarosiga fuqarolik beruvchi yuridik hujjat.
Ichki sayohatlar uchun ishlatiladigan kichik, ko'chma identifikatsiya kartasi.
Faqat chet elga favqulodda tibbiy sayohat uchun talab qilinadigan maxsus ruxsatnoma.
ru: Юридический документ, предоставляющий гражданство иностранному гражданину, проживающему за границей.
Небольшая переносная идентификационная карта, используемая для внутренних поездок.
Специальное разрешение, требующееся только для экстренных медицинских поездок за границу.

translation.en: The place in an airport or at a border where officials check your passport and other travel documents.
translation.uz: Aeroportda yoki chegarada mansabdor shaxslar pasportingizni va boshqa sayohat hujjatlaringizni tekshiradigan joy.
translation.ru: Место в аэропорту или на границе, где сотрудники проверяют ваш паспорт и другие проездные документы.

example: We had to queue for an hour at passport control.
Make sure you have your passport ready for passport control.
After a long flight, the first stop is usually passport control.

quiz.correct_answer: The place in an airport or at a border where officials check your passport and other travel documents.

en: The area where you collect your luggage after your flight arrives.
The security screening area before you board your flight.
A special lounge for airline passengers awaiting their next connection.
uz: Parvozingiz yetib kelganidan keyin bagajingizni oladigan joy.
Parvozingizga chiqishdan oldingi xavfsizlik nazorati hududi.
Keyingi ulanishni kutayotgan aviakompaniya yo'lovchilari uchun maxsus zal.
ru: Зона, где вы забираете свой багаж после прибытия рейса.
Зона досмотра безопасности перед посадкой на рейс.
Специальный зал ожидания для пассажиров авиакомпаний, ожидающих следующего рейса.

translation.en: Extreme tiredness and other physical effects felt by a person after a long flight across different time zones.
translation.uz: Har xil vaqt zonalarini kesib o'tgan uzoq parvozdan keyin odam tomonidan seziladigan haddan tashqari charchoq va boshqa jismoniy ta'sirlar.
translation.ru: Крайняя усталость и другие физические эффекты, ощущаемые человеком после длительного перелета через разные часовые пояса.

example: I'm really suffering from jet lag after my trip to Asia.
To avoid jet lag, try to adjust your sleep schedule before you travel.
She felt awful with jet lag for the first few days of her vacation.

quiz.correct_answer: Extreme tiredness and other physical effects felt by a person after a long flight across different time zones.

en: A sudden fear of flying that prevents a person from taking airplane trips.
The feeling of excitement and anticipation before a major journey.
A common cold contracted during travel due to changing climates.
uz: Samolyotda sayohat qilishdan to'xtatadigan to'satdan uchish qo'rquvi.
Katta sayohatdan oldingi hayajon va intizorlik hissi.
Sayohat paytida iqlim o'zgarishi tufayli yuqadigan oddiy shamollash.
ru: Внезапный страх перед полетами, который мешает человеку совершать авиаперелеты.
Чувство волнения и предвкушения перед большим путешествием.
Простуда, подхваченная во время путешествия из-за смены климата.

translation.en: A short journey or trip, especially one engaged in as a leisure activity.
translation.uz: Qisqa sayohat yoki safar, ayniqsa dam olish faoliyati sifatida amalga oshiriladigan.
translation.ru: Короткое путешествие или поездка, особенно совершаемая в качестве досуга.

example: We took a day excursion to the nearby national park.
The boat company offers various excursions along the coast.
Our school organized an educational excursion to the science museum.

quiz.correct_answer: A short journey or trip, especially one engaged in as a leisure activity.

en: A long, challenging journey undertaken for adventurous purposes.
A formal business trip that involves meetings and conferences.
The continuous movement of people or goods across a border.
uz: Sarguzasht maqsadlarida qilingan uzoq, qiyin sayohat.
Uchrashuvlar va konferensiyalarni o'z ichiga olgan rasmiy xizmat safari.
Odamlar yoki tovarlarning chegara orqali uzluksiz harakati.
ru: Длительное, сложное путешествие, предпринятое в приключенческих целях.
Официальная деловая поездка, включающая встречи и конференции.
Постоянное перемещение людей или товаров через границу.

translation.en: Transportation systems that operate within a specific city or local area, such as city buses and subways.
translation.uz: Ma'lum bir shahar yoki mahalliy hududda ishlaydigan transport tizimlari, masalan, shahar avtobuslari va metrolar.
translation.ru: Транспортные системы, работающие в пределах конкретного города или местной области, такие как городские автобусы и метро.

example: Using local transport is often the best way to get around in a new city.
