The hotel is conveniently located near various local transport links.
We relied on local transport, mainly trams, to explore the city center.

quiz.correct_answer: Transportation systems that operate within a specific city or local area, suchs as city buses and subways.

en: Means of travel connecting different countries or continents together.
Specialized vehicles used only for delivering goods and products.
Private cars and taxis that are rented for individual journeys.
uz: Turli mamlakatlarni yoki qit'alarni bog'laydigan sayohat vositalari.
Faqat tovarlar va mahsulotlarni yetkazib berish uchun ishlatiladigan ixtisoslashtirilgan transport vositalari.
Shaxsiy sayohatlar uchun ijaraga beriladigan shaxsiy avtomobillar va taksilar.
ru: Средства передвижения, соединяющие разные страны или континенты.
Специализированные транспортные средства, используемые только для доставки товаров и продуктов.
Частные автомобили и такси, которые арендуются для индивидуальных поездок.

translation.en: A machine that dispenses tickets, for example, for public transport or parking.
translation.uz: Chiptalarni, masalan, jamoat transporti yoki avtoturargoh uchun chiptalarni beradigan mashina.
translation.ru: Аппарат, который выдает билеты, например, для общественного транспорта или парковки.

example: You can buy your train ticket from the ticket machine on the platform.
The ticket machine was out of order, so we had to buy tickets at the counter.
Remember to validate your ticket at the machine before boarding the tram.

quiz.correct_answer: A machine that dispenses tickets, for example, for public transport or parking.

en: A device that scans your passport and checks your travel documents.
A booth where you can speak to a person to get travel information.
An electronic display that shows live updates for train departures.
uz: Pasportingizni skanerlaydigan va sayohat hujjatlaringizni tekshiradigan qurilma.
Sayohat ma'lumotlarini olish uchun odam bilan gaplashishingiz mumkin bo'lgan kabina.
Poezd jo'nashlari uchun jonli yangilanishlarni ko'rsatadigan elektron displey.
ru: Устройство, которое сканирует ваш паспорт и проверяет ваши проездные документы.
Будка, где вы можете поговорить с человеком, чтобы получить информацию о путешествии.
Электронный дисплей, который показывает актуальную информацию об отправлении поездов.

translation.en: The times of day when the largest number of people are using public transport, roads, or other services.
translation.uz: Kunning eng ko'p odam jamoat transporti, yo'llar yoki boshqa xizmatlardan foydalanadigan vaqtlari.
translation.ru: Время суток, когда наибольшее количество людей пользуется общественным транспортом, дорогами или другими услугами.

example: Avoid travelling during peak hours if you want to avoid crowds.
Public transport is usually more expensive during peak hours.
The train stations are extremely busy during morning peak hours.

quiz.correct_answer: The times of day when the largest number of people are using public transport, roads, or other services.

en: Periods when public transport operates with fewer services than usual.
Times when travel is cheapest due to very low demand from passengers.
Hours when traffic is light, making travel very quick and efficient.
uz: Jamoat transporti odatdagidan kamroq xizmat ko'rsatadigan davrlar.
Yo'lovchilar talabi juda past bo'lganligi sababli sayohat eng arzon bo'ladigan vaqtlar.
Tirbandlik kam bo'lgan soatlar, bu sayohatni juda tez va samarali qiladi.
ru: Периоды, когда общественный транспорт работает с меньшим количеством рейсов, чем обычно.
Время, когда поездки самые дешевые из-за очень низкого спроса со стороны пассажиров.
Часы, когда движение слабое, что делает поездку очень быстрой и эффективной.

translation.en: Not during the most popular or busiest times.
translation.uz: Eng mashhur yoki eng gavjum vaqtlarda emas.
translation.ru: Не в самое популярное или загруженное время, когда спрос на услуги ниже.

example: Off-peak train tickets are significantly cheaper.
If you travel off-peak, you'll find fewer people and more space.
The gym offers discounted rates for off-peak membership.

quiz.correct_answer: Not during the most popular or busiest times.

en: During the busiest periods of the day, when services are crowded.
Specifically at midnight, when many public services are closed.
Immediately after the peak rush, when crowds are just starting to thin.
uz: Kunning eng gavjum davrlarida, xizmatlar gavjum bo'lganida.
Xususan, yarim tunda, ko'plab jamoat xizmatlari yopiq bo'lganida.
Eng yuqori cho'qqidan so'ng darhol, olomon endi siyraklashishni boshlaganida.
ru: В самые загруженные периоды дня, когда услуги переполнены.
Конкретно в полночь, когда многие общественные службы закрыты.
Сразу после часа пик, когда толпы только начинают рассасываться.

translation.en: A bus, train, or flight that allows a traveller to continue their journey after getting off another.
translation.uz: Sayohatchiga boshqasidan tushgandan keyin sayohatini davom ettirishga imkon beradigan avtobus, poezd yoki parvoz.
translation.ru: Автобус, поезд или рейс, который позволяет путешественнику продолжить свое путешествие после выхода из другого.

example: We only have a 30-minute connection between flights, which is tight.
Missing the connection meant we had to stay overnight at the airport.
Always allow enough time for your connection, especially with international flights.

quiz.correct_answer: A bus, train, or flight that allows a traveller to continue their journey after getting off another.

en: A direct and uninterrupted journey from one point to another location.
A specific type of travel insurance that covers lost luggage.
The process of checking into a hotel or similar accommodation.
uz: Bir nuqtadan boshqa joyga to'g'ridan-to'g'ri va uzluksiz sayohat.
Yo'qolgan bagajni qoplaydigan maxsus sayohat sug'urtasi turi.
Mehmonxona yoki shunga o'xshash turar joyga ro'yxatdan o'tish jarayoni.
ru: Прямое и беспрерывное путешествие из одной точки в другое место.
Конкретный вид страхования путешествий, покрывающий потерянный багаж.
Процесс регистрации в отеле или аналогичном месте проживания.

translation.en: A building or area at an airport or station where passengers arrive, depart, or transfer.
translation.uz: Aeroport yoki stansiyadagi yo'lovchilar keladigan, jo'nab ketadigan yoki o'tish joyi.
translation.ru: Здание или зона в аэропорту или на станции, куда прибывают, откуда отправляются или где пересаживаются пассажиры.

example: Our flight departs from Terminal 2, gate B15.
You'll need to take a shuttle bus to get to the international terminal.
The new train terminal has modern facilities and shops for travellers.

quiz.correct_answer: A building or area at an airport or station where passengers arrive, depart, or transfer.

en: A specific type of vehicle used for transporting goods over long distances.
The main administrative office located within a large transportation hub.
A small, private room in a hotel where guests can relax before their flight.
uz: Uzoq masofalarga tovarlarni tashish uchun ishlatiladigan maxsus transport vositasi.
Katta transport markazi ichida joylashgan asosiy ma'muriy ofis.
Mehmonxonadagi kichik, shaxsiy xona, bu yerda mehmonlar parvozi oldidan dam olishlari mumkin.
ru: Особый тип транспортного средства, используемого для перевозки грузов на большие расстояния.
Главный административный офис, расположенный в крупном транспортном узле.
Небольшая частная комната в отеле, где гости могут отдохнуть перед вылетом.

translation.en: The specific door or entrance at an airport from which passengers board their aircraft.
translation.uz: Aeroportdagi yo'lovchilar samolyotga chiqadigan ma'lum eshik yoki kirish joyi.
translation.ru: Конкретная дверь или вход в аэропорту, через который пассажиры садятся на свой самолет.

example: Please proceed to boarding gate 22 for your flight to Dublin.
The announcement for boarding at our gate was made five minutes ago.
Always check the screens for any last-minute changes to your boarding gate.

quiz.correct_answer: The specific door or entrance at an airport from which passengers board their aircraft.

en: The main security checkpoint where all passengers and their belongings are screened.
The area where passengers collect their checked baggage upon arrival at the airport.
A counter in the airport lobby where you present your ticket for check-in purposes.
uz: Barcha yo'lovchilar va ularning narsalari tekshiriladigan asosiy xavfsizlik nazorati punkti.
Aeroportga kelganida yo'lovchilar ro'yxatdan o'tkazilgan bagajlarini oladigan joy.
Aeroport lobbisidagi chiptangizni ro'yxatdan o'tkazish uchun taqdim etadigan peshtaxta.
ru: Главный пункт контроля безопасности, где досматриваются все пассажиры и их вещи.
Зона, где пассажиры забирают свой зарегистрированный багаж по прибытии в аэропорт.
Стойка регистрации в холле аэропорта, где вы предъявляете свой билет для регистрации.

translation.en: A form on which travellers list goods they are importing, often required when entering a country.
translation.uz: Sayohatchilar import qilayotgan tovarlarni ko'rsatadigan forma, ko'pincha mamlakatga kirishda talab qilinadi.
translation.ru: Форма, в которой путешественники перечисляют ввозимые ими товары, часто требуется при въезде в страну.

example: You must fill out a customs declaration form before landing.
Do you have anything to declare on your customs declaration?
He accidentally forgot to sign his customs declaration, causing a small delay.

quiz.correct_answer: A form on which travellers list goods they are importing, often required when entering a country.

en: A document proving you have valid travel insurance for your trip abroad.
A special permission slip required for transporting pets on an airplane.
A health certificate needed to enter some countries, especially for vaccinations.
uz: Chet elga sayohatingiz uchun haqiqiy sayohat sug'urtasi borligini tasdiqlovchi hujjat.
Samolyotda uy hayvonlarini tashish uchun talab qilinadigan maxsus ruxsatnoma.
Ba'zi mamlakatlarga kirish uchun zarur bo'lgan sog'liqni saqlash sertifikati, ayniqsa emlashlar uchun.
ru: Документ, подтверждающий наличие у вас действующей туристической страховки для поездки за границу.
Специальное разрешение, необходимое для перевозки домашних животных на самолете.
Справка о состоянии здоровья, необходимая для въезда в некоторые страны, особенно для вакцинации.

translation.en: To cook food in liquid just below the boiling point.
translation.uz: Ovqatni qaynoq nuqtasidan biroz pastroq haroratda suyuqlikda pishirish.
translation.ru: Готовить еду в жидкости чуть ниже точки кипения, медленно и равномерно.

example: Let the sauce simmer for 20 minutes to thicken.
The soup needs to simmer gently for an hour to develop its flavors.
You should simmer the vegetables until they are tender, but not mushy.

quiz.correct_answer: To cook food in liquid just below the boiling point.

en: To cook food quickly in hot oil over a high flame.
To heat liquid until it reaches a full, rapid boil.
To bake food in an oven using dry heat until it is done.
uz: Ovqatni yuqori olovda qizigan yog'da tez pishirish.
Suyuqlikni to'liq, tez qaynash nuqtasiga qadar qizdirish.
Ovqatni pechda quruq issiqlikda pishirguncha pishirish.
ru: Быстро готовить еду в горячем масле на сильном огне.
Нагревать жидкость до полного, быстрого кипения.
Выпекать еду в духовке, используя сухой жар до готовности.

translation.en: To cook food quickly in a small amount of fat over high heat.
translation.uz: Ovqatni ozgina yog'da yuqori olovda tez pishirish.
translation.ru: Быстро готовить еду на небольшом количестве жира на сильном огне.

example: Sauté the onions until they are translucent and soft.
First, sauté the garlic and ginger to release their aroma.
She decided to sauté the mushrooms with a little butter for a quick side dish.

quiz.correct_answer: To cook food quickly in a small amount of fat over high heat.

en: To cook food by surrounding it with hot air, especially in an oven.
To submerge food in boiling water until it is fully cooked.
To cook food slowly in liquid over a long period of time.
uz: Ovqatni issiq havo bilan o'rab pishirish, ayniqsa pechda.
Ovqatni to'liq pishguncha qaynoq suvga botirish.
Ovqatni suyuqlikda uzoq vaqt davomida sekin pishirish.
ru: Готовить еду, окружая ее горячим воздухом, особенно в духовке.
Погружать еду в кипящую воду до полной готовности.
Медленно готовить еду в жидкости в течение длительного времени.

translation.en: A sauce, typically made of oil, vinegar, spices, and herbs, in which food is soaked before cooking to flavor or tenderize it.
translation.uz: Odatda yog', sirka, ziravorlar va o'tlardan tayyorlangan sous, unda ovqat pishirishdan oldin ta'm berish yoki yumshatish uchun namlanadi.
translation.ru: Соус, обычно состоящий из масла, уксуса, специй и трав, в котором пища вымачивается перед приготовлением, чтобы придать ей вкус или сделать более нежной.

example: Let the chicken sit in the marinade for at least an hour.
The marinade gave the meat a rich, savory flavor.
You can prepare a simple marinade with lemon juice and olive oil.

quiz.correct_answer: A sauce, typically made of oil, vinegar, spices, and herbs, in which food is soaked before cooking to flavor or tenderize it.

en: A thick mixture used to coat food before frying or baking it.
A type of fresh herb commonly used to garnish cooked dishes.
A dish cooked slowly in a covered pot with liquid and various vegetables.
uz: Ovqatni qovurish yoki pishirishdan oldin qoplash uchun ishlatiladigan qalin aralashma.
Pishirilgan taomlarni bezash uchun ishlatiladigan yangi o't turi.
Yopiq qozonda suyuqlik va turli sabzavotlar bilan sekin pishirilgan taom.
ru: Густая смесь, используемая для обмазывания пищи перед жаркой или запеканием.
Вид свежей зелени, обычно используемой для украшения приготовленных блюд.
Блюдо, медленно приготовленное в закрытой кастрюле с жидкостью и различными овощами.

translation.en: To decorate or embellish something, especially food, with small items.
translation.uz: Biror narsani, ayniqsa ovqatni, kichik narsalar bilan bezash yoki pardozlash.
translation.ru: Украшать или приправлять что-либо, особенно еду, небольшими съедобными элементами.

example: Garnish the soup with fresh parsley before serving.
A slice of lemon makes a perfect garnish for seafood dishes.
She used a sprig of mint to garnish the dessert beautifully.

quiz.correct_answer: To decorate or embellish something, especially food, with small items.

en: To prepare food by cutting it into small, even pieces.
To add a strong, pungent flavor to a dish by mixing ingredients.
To cook food using very high heat until the surface turns brown.
uz: Ovqatni kichik, bir xil bo'laklarga kesib tayyorlash.
Ingredientlarni aralashtirib taomga kuchli, achchiq ta'm berish.
Ovqatni sirtining jigarrang bo'lishi uchun juda yuqori haroratda pishirish.
ru: Готовить пищу, нарезая ее на мелкие, ровные кусочки.
Добавлять сильный, острый вкус в блюдо, смешивая ингредиенты.
Готовить пищу на очень сильном огне, пока поверхность не станет коричневой.

translation.en: To work dough or clay with the hands by pressing, folding, and stretching.
translation.uz: Xamir yoki loyni qo'llar bilan bosish, buklash va cho'zish orqali ishlov berish.
translation.ru: Месить тесто или глину руками, нажимая, складывая и растягивая.

example: You need to knead the dough for at least ten minutes to make it smooth.
She taught me how to knead bread dough properly.
Knead the mixture until it forms a soft and elastic ball.

quiz.correct_answer: To work dough or clay with the hands by pressing, folding, and stretching.

en: To quickly combine ingredients using a spoon or whisk until just mixed.
To cut food into very small, fine pieces with a sharp knife.
To spread a thin layer of butter or oil evenly on a baking dish.
uz: Ingredientlarni qoshiq yoki ko'pirtirgich yordamida tez aralashtirish.
Ovqatni o'tkir pichoq bilan juda kichik, nozik bo'laklarga kesish.
Pishirish idishiga sariyog 'yoki yog'ning yupqa qatlamini bir tekis surtish.
ru: Быстро смешивать ингредиенты ложкой или венчиком до однородности.
Нарезать еду на очень мелкие, тонкие кусочки острым ножом.
Равномерно распределять тонкий слой масла или жира на противне.

translation.en: To cook food by exposing it to direct radiant heat, typically under a grill.
translation.uz: Ovqatni to'g'ridan-to'g'ri nurlanish issiqligiga ta'sir qilib, odatda gril ostida pishirish.
translation.ru: Готовить пищу, подвергая ее прямому лучистому теплу, обычно под грилем.

example: Broil the fish for five minutes on each side until it's flaky.
You can broil vegetables to give them a slightly charred flavor.
Set the oven to broil to brown the top of the casserole dish.

quiz.correct_answer: To cook food by exposing it to direct radiant heat, typically under a grill.

en: To cook food slowly in an oven in a covered dish with liquid.
To cook food in hot oil or fat until it becomes crispy and brown.
To cook food using steam, often in a steamer basket over boiling water.
uz: Ovqatni pechda yopiq idishda suyuqlik bilan sekin pishirish.
Ovqatni qizigan yog'da yoki yog'da qarsak va jigarrang bo'lguncha pishirish.
Ovqatni bug' yordamida pishirish, ko'pincha qaynoq suv ustidagi bug'latish savatida.
ru: Медленно готовить еду в духовке в закрытой посуде с жидкостью.
Готовить еду в горячем масле или жире до хрустящей корочки и золотистого цвета.
Готовить еду на пару, часто в пароварке над кипящей водой.

translation.en: A small dish of food served before the main course of a meal.
translation.uz: Ovqatning asosiy taomidan oldin beriladigan kichik ovqat.
translation.ru: Небольшое блюдо, подаваемое перед основным блюдом трапезы, чтобы возбудить аппетит.

example: We ordered some spring rolls as an appetizer to share.
The restaurant offers a variety of delicious appetizers.
She prepared a cheese platter as an appetizer for the party guests.

quiz.correct_answer: A small dish of food served before the main course of a meal.

en: The largest and most important dish in a multi-course meal.
A sweet dish served at the end of a meal, such as cake or fruit.
A type of beverage typically consumed before a meal to aid digestion.
uz: Ko'p kursli ovqatdagi eng katta va muhim taom.
Ovqat oxirida beriladigan shirin taom, masalan, tort yoki meva.
Odatda ovqatdan oldin hazm qilishga yordam beradigan ichimlik turi.
ru: Самое большое и важное блюдо в многокомпонентном приеме пищи.
Сладкое блюдо, подаваемое в конце трапезы, например, торт или фрукты.
Вид напитка, обычно употребляемый перед едой для улучшения пищеварения.

translation.en: A person who does not eat meat or fish.
translation.uz: Go'sht yoki baliq iste'mol qilmaydigan odam.
translation.ru: Человек, который не ест мясо или рыбу, по своим убеждениям или диете.

example: My sister is vegetarian, so we need to find a restaurant with good veggie options.
Many restaurants now offer a wide range of vegetarian dishes.
Being vegetarian has many health benefits and is good for the environment.

quiz.correct_answer: A person who does not eat meat or fish.

en: Someone who avoids all animal products, including dairy and eggs.
A person who only eats raw fruits, vegetables, and nuts for health reasons.
Someone who follows a strict diet to lose weight quickly and efficiently.
uz: Sut va tuxum kabi barcha hayvonot mahsulotlaridan qochadigan kishi.
Sog'liq sabablarga ko'ra faqat xom meva, sabzavot va yong'oq iste'mol qiladigan odam.
Tez va samarali vazn yo'qotish uchun qat'iy parhezga rioya qiladigan kishi.
ru: Тот, кто избегает всех продуктов животного происхождения, включая молочные продукты и яйца.
Человек, который ест только сырые фрукты, овощи и орехи по состоянию здоровья.
Тот, кто придерживается строгой диеты для быстрого и эффективного похудения.

translation.en: To cook food by dry heat without direct exposure to a flame, typically in an oven.
translation.uz: Ovqatni to'g'ridan-to'g'ri olovga ta'sir qilmasdan quruq issiqlikda, odatda pechda pishirish.
translation.ru: Готовить еду сухим жаром без прямого воздействия пламени, обычно в духовке.

example: She decided to bake a cake for her friend's birthday party.
We can bake potatoes in the oven while the chicken is roasting.
It takes about 45 minutes to bake a loaf of bread properly.

quiz.correct_answer: To cook food by dry heat without direct exposure to a flame, typically in an oven.

en: To cook food by immersing it in boiling water until it is tender.
To prepare food by frying it in a pan with a small amount of oil.
To cook food very slowly in a closed pot with some liquid.
uz: Ovqatni yumshoq bo'lguncha qaynoq suvga botirib pishirish.
Ovqatni ozgina yog' bilan tovada qovurish orqali tayyorlash.
Ovqatni yopiq qozonda biroz suyuqlik bilan juda sekin pishirish.
ru: Готовить еду, погружая ее в кипящую воду до мягкости.
Готовить еду, жаря ее на сковороде с небольшим количеством масла.
Очень медленно готовить еду в закрытой кастрюле с некоторой жидкостью.

translation.en: To cook food, especially meat or vegetables, by prolonged exposure to heat in an oven or over a fire.
translation.uz: Ovqatni, ayniqsa go'sht yoki sabzavotlarni, pechda yoki olovda uzoq vaqt issiqlikka ta'sir qilib pishirish.
translation.ru: Готовить еду, особенно мясо или овощи, длительным воздействием тепла в духовке или на огне.

example: We're going to roast a chicken for Sunday dinner.
Roast vegetables are a delicious and healthy side dish.
The aroma of the roast lamb filled the entire kitchen.

quiz.correct_answer: To cook food, especially meat or vegetables, by prolonged exposure to heat in an oven or over a fire.

en: To quickly cook food in a small amount of hot oil, stirring constantly.
To heat liquid until it reaches its maximum boiling temperature.
To prepare food by chopping it into very small, uniform pieces.
uz: Ovqatni ozgina qizigan yog'da tez pishirish, doimiy aralashtirib turish.
Suyuqlikni maksimal qaynash haroratiga qadar qizdirish.
Ovqatni juda kichik, bir xil bo'laklarga bo'lib tayyorlash.
ru: Быстро готовить еду в небольшом количестве горячего масла, постоянно помешивая.
Нагревать жидкость до максимальной температуры кипения.
Готовить еду, нарезая ее на очень мелкие, однородные кусочки.

translation.en: To cook food using strong, direct heat, usually from above, as in an oven.
translation.uz: Ovqatni kuchli, to'g'ridan-to'g'ri issiqlikdan foydalanib, odatda tepadan, pechda pishirish.
translation.ru: Готовить пищу, используя сильный, прямой жар, обычно сверху, как в духовке.

example: Let's grill some sausages and corn on the barbecue.
I prefer to grill my vegetables rather than boiling them.
The restaurant is famous for its perfectly grilled steaks.

quiz.correct_answer: To cook food using strong, direct heat, usually from above, as in an oven.

en: To cook food in a large amount of hot oil until it is deeply colored.
To slowly cook food in liquid over a low flame for many hours.
To steam food by placing it over boiling water in a covered pot.
uz: Ovqatni ko'p miqdordagi qizigan yog'da chuqur rangga kirguncha pishirish.
Ovqatni past olovda suyuqlikda ko'p soat davomida sekin pishirish.
Ovqatni qaynoq suv ustidagi yopiq qozonda bug'da pishirish.
ru: Готовить еду в большом количестве горячего масла до глубокого цвета.
Медленно готовить еду в жидкости на медленном огне в течение многих часов.
Готовить еду на пару, помещая ее над кипящей водой в закрытой кастрюле.

translation.en: To cut food into small pieces, typically with a knife.
translation.uz: Ovqatni mayda bo'laklarga kesish, odatda pichoq bilan.
translation.ru: Нарезать еду на мелкие кусочки, обычно ножом.

example: Chop the onions and garlic finely before adding them to the pan.
She quickly chopped all the vegetables for the salad.
Remember to chop the herbs just before you serve the dish.

quiz.correct_answer: To cut food into small pieces, typically with a knife.

en: To mix ingredients together vigorously with a whisk or spoon.
To spread a thin layer of butter or oil over a cooking surface.
To heat food until it reaches a very high temperature and boils.
uz: Ingredientlarni ko'pirtirgich yoki qoshiq bilan qizg'in aralashtirish.
Pishirish yuzasiga sariyog 'yoki yog'ning yupqa qatlamini surtish.
Ovqatni juda yuqori haroratga yetguncha va qaynaguncha qizdirish.
ru: Энергично смешивать ингредиенты венчиком или ложкой.
Распределять тонкий слой масла или жира по поверхности для приготовления.
Нагревать еду до очень высокой температуры и кипения.

translation.en: To cut food into very small, uniform cubes.
translation.uz: Ovqatni juda kichik, bir xil kubiklarga kesish.
translation.ru: Нарезать еду на очень маленькие, одинаковые кубики.

example: Dice the carrots and potatoes for the stew.
The recipe requires you to dice the tomatoes perfectly.
She diced the chicken breast into bite-sized pieces for the stir-fry.

quiz.correct_answer: To cut food into very small, uniform cubes.

en: To smash food into a soft, smooth paste using a fork or masher.
To cut food into long, thin strips, like for french fries.
To slice food very thinly, often for sandwiches or salads.
uz: Ovqatni vilkalar yoki ezgich yordamida yumshoq, silliq pastaga maydalash.
Ovqatni fri kartoshkasi kabi uzun, yupqa bo'laklarga kesish.
Ovqatni juda yupqa qilib kesish, ko'pincha sendvich yoki salatlar uchun.
ru: Разминать еду в мягкую, однородную пасту с помощью вилки или толкушки.
Нарезать еду на длинные, тонкие полоски, как для картофеля фри.
Очень тонко нарезать еду, часто для бутербродов или салатов.

translation.en: To cut or grind food, especially meat, into very small pieces.
translation.uz: Ovqatni, ayniqsa go'shtni, juda kichik bo'laklarga kesish yoki maydalash.
translation.ru: Нарезать или измельчать еду, особенно мясо, на очень мелкие кусочки.

example: Mince the garlic finely for the pasta sauce.
You can buy minced meat ready from the butcher.
The recipe calls for a tablespoon of minced ginger.

quiz.correct_answer: To cut or grind food, especially meat, into very small pieces.

en: To cut food into large, irregular chunks for a rustic dish.
To prepare food by boiling it in liquid until it is soft.
To remove the outer skin or peel from fruits or vegetables.
uz: Ovqatni qishloqcha taom uchun katta, tartibsiz bo'laklarga kesish.
Ovqatni suyuqlikda yumshoq bo'lguncha qaynatish orqali tayyorlash.
Meva yoki sabzavotlarning tashqi terisini yoki po'stini olib tashlash.
ru: Нарезать еду на крупные, неправильные куски для деревенского блюда.
Готовить еду, отваривая ее в жидкости до мягкости.
Удалять внешнюю кожицу или кожуру с фруктов или овощей.

translation.en: To beat or stir a substance, especially eggs, cream, or sauce, with a light, rapid movement.
translation.uz: Moddani, ayniqsa tuxum, qaymoq yoki sousni yengil, tez harakat bilan urish yoki aralashtirish.
translation.ru: Взбивать или перемешивать субстанцию, особенно яйца, сливки или соус, легким и быстрым движением.

example: Whisk the eggs until they are light and fluffy.
She used a whisk to combine all the ingredients smoothly.
Remember to whisk the dressing vigorously before adding it to the salad.

quiz.correct_answer: To beat or stir a substance, especially eggs, cream, or sauce, with a light, rapid movement.

en: To slowly and gently fold ingredients together with a spatula.
To press food through a fine sieve to create a smooth puree.
To chop ingredients into very small, uniform pieces using a knife.
uz: Ingredientlarni spatula bilan sekin va muloyimlik bilan aralashtirish.
Ovqatni nozik elakdan o'tkazib, silliq pyure hosil qilish.
Ingredientlarni pichoq yordamida juda kichik, bir xil bo'laklarga kesish.
ru: Медленно и аккуратно смешивать ингредиенты лопаткой.
Протирать еду через мелкое сито для получения однородного пюре.
Нарезать ингредиенты на очень мелкие, однородные кусочки ножом.

translation.en: To cook food quickly by frying it in a wok or large pan over high heat while stirring constantly.
translation.uz: Ovqatni vokda yoki katta tovada yuqori olovda doimiy aralashtirib tez pishirish.
translation.ru: Быстро готовить еду, обжаривая ее в воке или большой сковороде на сильном огне, постоянно помешивая.

example: We often make a vegetable stir-fry for a quick and healthy dinner.
To stir-fry effectively, make sure your pan is very hot.
Add the chicken to the stir-fry last, once the vegetables are nearly done.

quiz.correct_answer: To cook food quickly by frying it in a wok or large pan over high heat while stirring constantly.

en: To bake food slowly in an oven until it becomes tender and moist.
To boil food in a large pot of water until it is fully cooked.
To grill food over an open flame until it develops a smoky flavor.
uz: Ovqatni pechda sekin pishirguncha yumshoq va nam bo'lguncha pishirish.
Ovqatni katta qozonda to'liq pishguncha suvda qaynatish.
Ovqatni ochiq olovda tutunli ta'm paydo bo'lguncha gril qilish.
ru: Медленно запекать еду в духовке до мягкости и влажности.
Варить еду в большой кастрюле с водой до полной готовности.
Жарить еду на открытом огне до появления дымного аромата.

translation.en: To add salt, pepper, herbs, or spices to food to improve its flavor.
translation.uz: Ovqatga ta'mini yaxshilash uchun tuz, qalampir, o'tlar yoki ziravorlar qo'shish.
translation.ru: Добавлять соль, перец, травы или специи в пищу, чтобы улучшить ее вкус.

example: Don't forget to season the chicken well before cooking.
Always taste the dish and season it to your preference.
She likes to season her salads with a pinch of black pepper.

quiz.correct_answer: To add salt, pepper, herbs, or spices to food to improve its flavor.

en: To cool food down quickly after cooking, often in an ice bath.
To cut food into very small, uniform pieces for even cooking.
To heat food until it is completely cooked through and safe to eat.
uz: Ovqatni pishirgandan keyin tezda sovutish, ko'pincha muz hammomida.
Bir tekis pishirish uchun ovqatni juda kichik, bir xil bo'laklarga kesish.
Ovqatni to'liq pishguncha va iste'mol qilish xavfsiz bo'lguncha isitish.
ru: Быстро охлаждать еду после приготовления, часто в ледяной бане.
Нарезать еду на очень мелкие, однородные кусочки для равномерного приготовления.
Нагревать еду до полной готовности и безопасности употребления.

translation.en: To pour juices or melted fat over meat during cooking in order to keep it moist.
translation.uz: Go'shtni pishirish paytida namligini saqlash uchun ustiga sharbatlar yoki eritilgan yog' quyish.
translation.ru: Поливать мясо соками или растопленным жиром во время приготовления, чтобы оно оставалось сочным.

example: Baste the turkey every 30 minutes to keep it from drying out.
A good chef knows how important it is to baste roasted meats.
She used a special brush to baste the chicken with its own juices.

quiz.correct_answer: To pour juices or melted fat over meat during cooking in order to keep it moist.

en: To cut meat into thin, even slices before serving it to guests.
To cover meat completely in a thick sauce or a dry rub.
To remove the bones from meat before cooking it thoroughly.
uz: Go'shtni mehmonlarga xizmat qilishdan oldin yupqa, bir tekis bo'laklarga kesish.
Go'shtni qalin sous yoki quruq ziravorlar bilan to'liq qoplash.
Go'shtni to'liq pishirishdan oldin suyaklarini olib tashlash.
ru: Нарезать мясо на тонкие, ровные ломтики перед подачей гостям.
Полностью покрывать мясо густым соусом или сухой приправой.
Удалять кости из мяса перед тщательным приготовлением.

translation.en: To scald (vegetables or fruit) in boiling water or steam for a short time.
translation.uz: Sabzavot yoki mevalarni qisqa vaqt davomida qaynoq suvda yoki bug'da kuydirish.
translation.ru: Ошпаривать (овощи или фрукты) в кипящей воде или на пару в течение короткого времени.

example: Blanch the almonds before peeling their skins easily.
You should blanch the green beans for a few minutes before freezing them.
To remove the bitterness, blanch the cabbage leaves quickly.

quiz.correct_answer: To scald (vegetables or fruit) in boiling water or steam for a short time.

en: To cook vegetables thoroughly until they are very soft and mushy.
To fry vegetables until they are crispy and slightly browned.
To soak fruits or vegetables in cold water to make them firm.
uz: Sabzavotlarni juda yumshoq va eziluvchan bo'lguncha yaxshilab pishirish.
Sabzavotlarni qarsak va biroz jigarrang bo'lguncha qovurish.
Meva yoki sabzavotlarni qattiq qilish uchun sovuq suvda ivitish.
ru: Тщательно готовить овощи, пока они не станут очень мягкими и кашеобразными.
Жарить овощи до хрустящей корочки и легкого подрумянивания.
Замачивать фрукты или овощи в холодной воде, чтобы сделать их твердыми.

translation.en: To shred food into small pieces by rubbing it against a rough surface or grater.
translation.uz: Ovqatni qo'pol yuzaga yoki qirg'ichga ishqalash orqali mayda bo'laklarga ajratish.
translation.ru: Измельчать пищу на мелкие кусочки, натирая ее на терке или грубой поверхности.

example: Grate some cheese over the pasta before serving.
You'll need to grate a lemon for its zest in this recipe.
She grated the potatoes to make a delicious batch of hash browns.

quiz.correct_answer: To shred food into small pieces by rubbing it against a rough surface or grater.

en: To mash food until it becomes a smooth, lump-free consistency.
To carefully slice food into very thin, delicate pieces with a knife.
To gently mix ingredients together with a spoon until just combined.
uz: Ovqatni silliq, bo'laklarsiz holatga kelguncha ezish.
Ovqatni pichoq bilan juda yupqa, nozik bo'laklarga ehtiyotkorlik bilan kesish.
Ingredientlarni qoshiq bilan shunchaki aralashguncha muloyimlik bilan aralashtirish.
ru: Разминать еду до получения гладкой, без комков консистенции.
Аккуратно нарезать еду на очень тонкие, нежные кусочки ножом.
Аккуратно смешивать ингредиенты ложкой до однородности.

translation.en: To remove the outer skin or rind from a fruit or vegetable.
translation.uz: Meva yoki sabzavotdan tashqi terini yoki po'stini olib tashlash.
translation.ru: Снимать внешнюю кожуру или корку с фруктов или овощей.

example: Remember to peel the potatoes before boiling them for mash.
It's easier to peel tomatoes if you blanch them first.
He quickly peeled an orange for a healthy snack.

quiz.correct_answer: To remove the outer skin or rind from a fruit or vegetable.

en: To cut a fruit or vegetable into small, even cubes for cooking.
To cook a fruit or vegetable until it becomes very soft and mushy.
To decorate a dish with small edible items, such as herbs or citrus.
uz: Meva yoki sabzavotni pishirish uchun kichik, bir xil kubiklarga kesish.
Meva yoki sabzavotni juda yumshoq va eziluvchan bo'lguncha pishirish.
Taomni mayda iste'mol qilinadigan narsalar, masalan, o'tlar yoki sitrus bilan bezash.
ru: Нарезать фрукт или овощ на маленькие, ровные кубики для приготовления.
Готовить фрукт или овощ, пока он не станет очень мягким и кашеобразным.
Украшать блюдо мелкими съедобными элементами, такими как зелень или цитрусовые.

translation.en: To fry food lightly and then stew it slowly in a closed container.
translation.uz: Ovqatni yengil qovurish va keyin yopiq idishda sekin qaynatish.
translation.ru: Слегка обжарить еду, а затем медленно тушить ее в закрытой посуде.

example: We're going to braise the beef short ribs until they are fork-tender.
Braising is a great method for tough cuts of meat.
The recipe suggests you braise the lamb shoulder for a few hours.

quiz.correct_answer: To fry food lightly and then stew it slowly in a closed container.

en: To cook food by rapidly boiling it in a large amount of water.
To bake food in an oven until it is completely dry and crispy.
To quickly cook food on a very hot surface with minimal oil.
uz: Ovqatni ko'p miqdordagi suvda tez qaynatish orqali pishirish.
Ovqatni pechda to'liq quruq va qarsak bo'lguncha pishirish.
Ovqatni juda issiq yuzada minimal yog' bilan tez pishirish.
ru: Быстро варить еду в большом количестве воды.
Запекать еду в духовке до полного высыхания и хрустящей корочки.
Быстро готовить еду на очень горячей поверхности с минимальным количеством масла.

translation.en: To cook food using steam, typically by placing it in a container over boiling water.
translation.uz: Ovqatni bug' yordamida pishirish, odatda uni qaynoq suv ustidagi idishga joylashtirish orqali.
translation.ru: Готовить еду на пару, обычно помещая ее в контейнер над кипящей водой.

example: Steaming vegetables helps them retain their nutrients.
You can steam fish for a very light and healthy meal.
She prefers to steam her dumplings rather than frying them.

quiz.correct_answer: To cook food using steam, typically by placing it in a container over boiling water.

en: To cook food by immersing it fully in hot oil or fat.
To bake food in a very hot oven until it is well browned.
To quickly stir food in a pan with a small amount of oil.
uz: Ovqatni qizigan yog'ga yoki yog'ga to'liq botirib pishirish.
Ovqatni juda qizigan pechda yaxshilab qizarguncha pishirish.
Ovqatni ozgina yog' bilan tovada tez aralashtirish.
ru: Готовить еду, полностью погружая ее в горячее масло или жир.
Запекать еду в очень горячей духовке до хорошего подрумянивания.
Быстро перемешивать еду в сковороде с небольшим количеством масла.

translation.en: To cook food gently in a small amount of simmering liquid.
translation.uz: Ovqatni ozgina qaynayotgan suyuqlikda muloyimlik bilan pishirish.
translation.ru: Готовить еду мягко в небольшом количестве кипящей жидкости, без сильного бурления.

example: She prefers to poach her eggs for breakfast.
Poached salmon is a light and healthy meal option.
You can poach pears in red wine for an elegant dessert.

quiz.correct_answer: To cook food gently in a small amount of simmering liquid.

en: To cook food quickly in very hot oil until it is crispy and brown.
To bake food in a hot oven until it is completely dried out.
To chop food into tiny pieces before combining it with other ingredients.
uz: Ovqatni juda qizigan yog'da qarsak va jigarrang bo'lguncha tez pishirish.
Ovqatni qizigan pechda to'liq quriguncha pishirish.
Ovqatni boshqa ingredientlar bilan birlashtirishdan oldin mayda bo'laklarga bo'lish.
ru: Быстро готовить еду в очень горячем масле до хрустящей корочки и золотистого цвета.
Запекать еду в горячей духовке до полного высыхания.
Нарезать еду на мельчайшие кусочки перед смешиванием с другими ингредиентами.

translation.en: A pair of small, thin sticks used as eating utensils, especially in East Asian cuisine.
translation.uz: Kichik, ingichka tayoqchalar juftligi, ayniqsa Sharqiy Osiyo oshxonasida ovqatlanish uchun ishlatiladi.
translation.ru: Пара небольших тонких палочек, используемых в качестве столовых приборов, особенно в восточноазиатской кухне.

example: Learning to eat with chopsticks can be challenging at first.
Many Asian dishes are traditionally eaten with chopsticks.
Do you prefer to use a fork or chopsticks for your noodles?

quiz.correct_answer: A pair of small, thin sticks used as eating utensils, especially in East Asian cuisine.

en: A type of very long spoon used for stirring large pots of soup.
A special cutting board designed specifically for slicing vegetables.
A small, pointed knife used for peeling fruits and delicate tasks.
uz: Katta sho'rva qozonlarini aralashtirish uchun ishlatiladigan juda uzun qoshiq turi.
Sabzavotlarni kesish uchun maxsus mo'ljallangan kesish taxtasi.
Mevalarni tozalash va nozik vazifalar uchun ishlatiladigan kichik, o'tkir pichoq.
ru: Вид очень длинной ложки, используемой для перемешивания больших кастрюль супа.
Специальная разделочная доска, разработанная специально для нарезки овощей.
Маленький заостренный нож, используемый для чистки фруктов и деликатных работ.

translation.en: A tool, instrument, or container, especially for practical use in a kitchen or household.
translation.uz: Asbob, uskuna yoki idish, ayniqsa oshxona yoki uy xo'jaligida amaliy foydalanish uchun.
translation.ru: Инструмент, прибор или емкость, особенно для практического использования на кухне или в домашнем хозяйстве.

example: The kitchen drawer is full of various cooking utensils.
Always wash your cooking utensils thoroughly after use.
Forks, knives, and spoons are common eating utensils.

quiz.correct_answer: A tool, instrument, or container, especially for practical use in a kitchen or household.

en: A type of food ingredient that adds flavor and color to dishes.
A complex recipe requiring many steps and specialized techniques.
A specific cooking method involving slow heating in an oven.
uz: Taomlarga ta'm va rang beruvchi oziq-ovqat ingredientining turi.
Ko'p bosqichli va ixtisoslashtirilgan texnikalarni talab qiluvchi murakkab retsept.
Pechda sekin isitishni o'z ichiga olgan o'ziga xos pishirish usuli.
ru: Тип пищевого ингредиента, который добавляет вкус и цвет блюдам.
Сложный рецепт, требующий многих шагов и специализированных техник.
Особый метод приготовления, включающий медленное нагревание в духовке.

translation.en: Any of the foods or substances that are combined to make a particular dish.
translation.uz: Ma'lum bir taomni tayyorlash uchun birlashtiriladigan har qanday oziq-ovqat yoki modda.
translation.ru: Любой из продуктов или веществ, которые объединяются для приготовления определенного блюда.

example: This recipe calls for fresh, high-quality ingredients.
I checked to make sure I had all the ingredients before starting to cook.
The secret ingredient in her soup is a special blend of spices.

quiz.correct_answer: Any of the foods or substances that are combined to make a particular dish.

en: A special cooking technique that involves slow-roasting meat for hours.
A finished meal that is ready to be served and eaten by diners.
A type of kitchen tool specifically designed for chopping vegetables.
uz: Go'shtni bir necha soat davomida sekin qovurishni o'z ichiga olgan maxsus pishirish usuli.
Mehmonlarga xizmat qilish va iste'mol qilishga tayyor bo'lgan tayyor taom.
Sabzavotlarni kesish uchun maxsus mo'ljallangan oshxona asbobining turi.
ru: Особая техника приготовления, включающая медленное запекание мяса в течение нескольких часов.
Готовое блюдо, которое можно подавать и есть посетителям.
Тип кухонного инструмента, специально разработанного для нарезки овощей.

translation.en: An amount of food suitable for one person.
translation.uz: Bir kishi uchun mos keladigan miqdordagi ovqat.
translation.ru: Количество еды, подходящее для одного человека, как одна порция.

example: The restaurant serves very generous portions.
Be careful with your portion sizes if you're trying to lose weight.
He accidentally took a double portion of dessert, feeling quite full.

quiz.correct_answer: An amount of food suitable for one person.

en: A complex mixture of spices used to flavor international dishes.
A method of preserving food by keeping it very cold for long periods.
A large cooking pot used for preparing meals for many people.
uz: Xalqaro taomlarga ta'm berish uchun ishlatiladigan murakkab ziravorlar aralashmasi.
Oziq-ovqatni uzoq vaqt juda sovuq holda saqlash orqali uni saqlash usuli.
Ko'p odamlar uchun ovqat tayyorlash uchun ishlatiladigan katta pishirish qozoni.
ru: Сложная смесь специй, используемая для ароматизации интернациональных блюд.
Метод консервации пищи путем длительного хранения ее в очень холодном состоянии.
Большая кастрюля, используемая для приготовления еды для многих людей.

translation.en: To eat dinner, typically a main meal of the day.
translation.uz: Kechki ovqatni, odatda kunning asosiy ovqatini yeyish.
translation.ru: Есть ужин, обычно основной прием пищи за день.

example: We decided to dine out at a new Italian restaurant tonight.
They like to dine at home, enjoying quiet evenings.
The hotel guests can dine at any of its three different restaurants.

quiz.correct_answer: To eat dinner, typically a main meal of the day.

en: To prepare a meal by following a detailed recipe.
To host a large gathering of people for a formal dinner.
To serve a meal to guests in a restaurant or at home.
uz: Batafsil retsept bo'yicha ovqat tayyorlash.
Rasmiy kechki ovqat uchun ko'p odamni mehmon qilish.
Restoranda yoki uyda mehmonlarga ovqat berish.
ru: Готовить еду по подробному рецепту.
Устраивать большое собрание людей для официального ужина.
Подавать еду гостям в ресторане или дома.

translation.en: Someone who is slow to show feelings or express opinions.
translation.uz: Hissiyotlarini ko'rsatishga yoki fikrlarini bildirishga shoshilmaydigan odam.
translation.ru: Замкнутый, не спешащий проявлять чувства или выражать мнения.

example: He's a bit **reserved** at first, but once you get to know him, he's very kind.
She usually kept to herself, acting quite **reserved** in large groups.
Being **reserved** doesn't mean you're unfriendly; it just means you think before speaking.

quiz.correct_answer: Someone who is slow to show feelings or express opinions.

en: A person who is always expressing strong emotions and thoughts openly.
Someone who is constantly seeking attention and enjoys being in the spotlight.
A person who is quick to judge others and always shares their negative views.
uz: Doim kuchli his-tuyg'ularini va fikrlarini ochiq ifodalaydigan shaxs.
Doimiy e'tibor qidiradigan va diqqat markazida bo'lishni yaxshi ko'radigan odam.
Boshqalarni tezda hukm qiladigan va doim salbiy fikrlarini baham ko'radigan shaxs.
ru: Человек, который всегда открыто выражает сильные эмоции и мысли.
Тот, кто постоянно ищет внимания и любит быть в центре внимания.
Человек, который быстро судит других и всегда делится своими негативными мнениями.

translation.en: Taking great care to do things well and thoroughly.
translation.uz: Ishlarni puxta va vijdonan bajarishga katta e'tibor beradigan.
translation.ru: Добросовестный, прилагающий большие усилия, чтобы делать все хорошо и тщательно.

example: She is a very **conscientious** student who always submits her assignments on time.
A **conscientious** worker pays attention to every detail of the task.
Being **conscientious** in your studies will lead to better results in the long run.

quiz.correct_answer: Taking great care to do things well and thoroughly.

en: Someone who often rushes through tasks without paying attention to details.
A person who tries to avoid work and leaves tasks unfinished.
Someone who is more interested in talking about work than actually doing it.
uz: Ko'pincha tafsilotlarga e'tibor bermay, ishlarni shoshilinch bajaradigan odam.
Ishdan qochishga urinadigan va vazifalarni tugallanmagan holda qoldiradigan shaxs.
Ishni qilishdan ko'ra, u haqida gapirishga ko'proq qiziqadigan odam.
ru: Тот, кто часто спешит с выполнением задач, не обращая внимания на детали.
Человек, который старается избегать работы и оставляет задачи незавершенными.
Тот, кто больше заинтересован в разговорах о работе, чем в ее выполнении.

translation.en: Someone who can be trusted or depended on.
translation.uz: Ishonish mumkin bo'lgan yoki tayanish mumkin bo'lgan odam.
translation.ru: Надежный, тот, кому можно доверять или на кого можно положиться.

example: You can always count on him; he's incredibly **reliable**.
We need a **reliable** person for this job, someone who won't let us down.
Her **reliable** nature makes her an excellent team member in any project.

quiz.correct_answer: Someone who can be trusted or depended on.

en: A person who frequently changes their plans and often lets others down.
Someone who is unpredictable and difficult to count on for tasks.
A person who is often late and doesn't always fulfill their promises to others.
uz: Rejalarini tez-tez o'zgartiradigan va ko'pincha boshqalarni ranjitadigan shaxs.
Oldindan aytib bo'lmaydigan va vazifalarni bajarishda ishonish qiyin bo'lgan odam.
Ko'pincha kechikadigan va boshqalarga bergan va'dalarini doim ham bajarmaydigan shaxs.
ru: Человек, который часто меняет свои планы и часто подводит других.
Тот, кто непредсказуем и на кого трудно положиться в выполнении задач.
Человек, который часто опаздывает и не всегда выполняет свои обещания перед другими.

translation.en: Having or showing determination not to change one's attitude or position on something.
translation.uz: Nimadirga nisbatan o'z munosabati yoki pozitsiyasini o'zgartirmaslikka qat'iyat ko'rsatadigan.
translation.ru: Упрямый, имеющий или проявляющий решимость не менять свое отношение или позицию по чему-либо.

example: He's too **stubborn** to admit he was wrong, even when it's obvious.
Her **stubborn** refusal to compromise made negotiations very difficult.
You can try to persuade her, but she can be quite **stubborn** once she's made up her mind.

quiz.correct_answer: Having or showing a determination not to change one's attitude or position on something.

en: Someone who easily changes their mind and is open to new ideas quickly.
A person who is always willing to compromise and adapt to others' views.
Someone who is unsure of their own opinions and often seeks advice from everyone.
uz: Fikrini osongina o'zgartiradigan va yangi g'oyalarga tezda ochiq bo'lgan odam.
Doim murosaga kelishga va boshqalarning fikrlariga moslashishga tayyor bo'lgan shaxs.
O'z fikrlariga ishonchi komil bo'lmagan va ko'pincha hammadan maslahat so'raydigan odam.
ru: Тот, кто легко меняет свое мнение и быстро открыт для новых идей.
Человек, который всегда готов идти на компромиссы и приспосабливаться к мнениям других.
Тот, кто не уверен в своих собственных мнениях и часто ищет совета у всех.

translation.en: Willing to listen to and respect the views of others, even if they are different.
translation.uz: Boshqalarning fikrlarini tinglashga va hurmat qilishga tayyor, hatto ular boshqacha bo'lsa ham.
translation.ru: Широко мыслящий, готовый выслушать и уважать мнения других, даже если они отличаются.

example: It's important to be **broad-minded** when discussing sensitive topics.
A truly **broad-minded** person considers all perspectives before forming an opinion.
Her **broad-minded** approach made her an excellent mediator in disputes.

quiz.correct_answer: Willing to listen to and respect the views of others, even if they are different.

en: Someone who is only interested in their own opinions and dismisses others' views.
A person who refuses to consider new ideas and sticks to traditional ways.
Someone who quickly forms strong opinions without considering all the facts first.
uz: Faqat o'z fikrlariga qiziqadigan va boshqalarning fikrlarini inkor etadigan odam.
Yangi g'oyalarni ko'rib chiqishdan bosh tortadigan va an'anaviy usullarga amal qiladigan shaxs.
Barcha faktlarni hisobga olmasdan tezda kuchli fikrlar shakllantiradigan odam.
ru: Тот, кто заинтересован только в своих собственных мнениях и отклоняет мнения других.
Человек, который отказывается рассматривать новые идеи и придерживается традиционных способов.
Тот, кто быстро формирует твердые мнения, не учитывая всех фактов сначала.

translation.en: Not willing to listen to or tolerate other people's views, especially if they are different.
translation.uz: Boshqa odamlarning fikrlarini tinglashga yoki toqat qilishga tayyor emas, ayniqsa ular boshqacha bo'lsa.
translation.ru: Узколобый, не желающий слушать или терпеть мнения других людей, особенно если они отличаются.

example: His **narrow-minded** views on culture surprised many of his colleagues.
It's difficult to have a productive discussion with someone so **narrow-minded**.
Overcoming **narrow-minded** thinking is crucial for progress and understanding.

quiz.correct_answer: Not willing to listen to or tolerate other people's views, especially if they are different.

en: Someone who is always open to new ideas and enjoys diverse perspectives.
A person who actively seeks out different opinions to broaden their own understanding.
Someone who encourages discussion and debate on a variety of challenging topics.
uz: Har doim yangi g'oyalarga ochiq va turli xil qarashlardan zavqlanadigan odam.
O'z tushunchasini kengaytirish uchun faol ravishda turli fikrlarni qidiradigan shaxs.
Turli murakkab mavzularda munozara va bahslarni rag'batlantiradigan odam.
ru: Тот, кто всегда открыт новым идеям и наслаждается разнообразными точками зрения.
Человек, который активно ищет разные мнения, чтобы расширить свое собственное понимание.
Тот, кто поощряет дискуссии и дебаты по различным сложным темам.

translation.en: Not talking too much about your own abilities or achievements.
translation.uz: O'z qobiliyatlari yoki yutuqlari haqida ko'p gapirmaydigan.
translation.ru: Скромный, не говорящий слишком много о своих способностях или достижениях.

example: Despite her success, she remained incredibly **modest** about her accomplishments.
He's a brilliant scientist, but also very **modest** and humble.
A truly **modest** person lets their actions speak louder than their words.

quiz.correct_answer: Not talking too much about your own abilities or achievements.

en: Someone who constantly boasts about their skills and successes to everyone.
A person who always tries to be the center of attention and seeks praise.
Someone who exaggerates their achievements and never admits to any mistakes.
uz: Doim o'z mahorati va muvaffaqiyatlari haqida hammaga maqtanaveradigan odam.
Doim diqqat markazida bo'lishga intiladigan va maqtov izlaydigan shaxs.
O'z yutuqlarini bo'rttirib ko'rsatadigan va hech qachon xatolarini tan olmaydigan odam.
ru: Тот, кто постоянно хвастается своими навыками и успехами перед всеми.
Человек, который всегда старается быть в центре внимания и ищет похвалы.
Тот, кто преувеличивает свои достижения и никогда не признает своих ошибок.

translation.en: Behaving confidently and not afraid to express your opinions or demands.
translation.uz: O'ziga ishonch bilan harakat qiladigan va fikrlari yoki talablarini ifodalashdan qo'rqmaydigan.
translation.ru: Напористый, ведущий себя уверенно и не боящийся выражать свои мнения или требования.

example: You need to be more **assertive** if you want to be heard in meetings.
Being **assertive** means standing up for yourself without being aggressive.
She delivered an **assertive** presentation that convinced the entire board.

quiz.correct_answer: Behaving confidently and not afraid to express your opinions or demands.

en: Someone who is shy and struggles to voice their opinions in group settings.
A person who is aggressive and often tries to dominate conversations forcefully.
Someone who is passive and always lets others make decisions for them.
uz: Uyatchan va guruh sharoitida o'z fikrlarini bildirishda qiynaladigan odam.
Tajovuzkor va ko'pincha suhbatlarda kuch bilan hukmronlik qilishga urinadigan shaxs.
Passiv va doim boshqalarga o'zi uchun qaror qabul qilishga ruxsat beradigan odam.
ru: Тот, кто застенчив и испытывает трудности с выражением своих мнений в групповых условиях.
Человек, который агрессивен и часто пытается силой доминировать в разговорах.
Тот, кто пассивен и всегда позволяет другим принимать решения за него.

translation.en: Caring only about yourself and not about other people.
translation.uz: Faqat o'zingiz haqingizda va boshqa odamlar haqida qayg'urmaydigan.
translation.ru: Эгоистичный, заботящийся только о себе, а не о других людях.

example: It was **selfish** of him to take the last piece of cake without asking.
Her **selfish** actions often hurt those around her, despite her good intentions sometimes.
Don't be so **selfish**; try to think about how your choices affect others.

quiz.correct_answer: Caring only about yourself and not about other people.

en: Always putting others' needs before your own, showing great empathy.
Considering everyone's feelings and trying to make fair decisions for all.
Someone who is very helpful and always offers support to friends.
uz: Doim o'z ehtiyojlaringizdan oldin boshqalarning ehtiyojlarini qo'yadigan, katta empatiya ko'rsatadigan.
Har kimning his-tuyg'ularini hisobga oladigan va hamma uchun adolatli qarorlar qabul qilishga intiladigan.
Juda yordamchi va doim do'stlarga yordam taklif qiladigan odam.
ru: Всегда ставящий нужды других выше своих собственных, проявляющий большое сочувствие.
Учитывающий чувства каждого и старающийся принимать справедливые решения для всех.
Тот, кто очень отзывчив и всегда предлагает поддержку друзьям.

translation.en: Having or showing a tendency to be quickly irritated or provoked.
translation.uz: Tezda g'azablanish yoki qo'zg'alishga moyillikka ega bo'lgan.
translation.ru: Нетерпеливый, имеющий или проявляющий склонность быстро раздражаться или провоцироваться.

example: He grew **impatient** waiting for the train, constantly checking his watch.
Don't be so **impatient**; good things come to those who wait for them.
Her **impatient** tone indicated she was tired of delays and wanted to move on.

quiz.correct_answer: Having or showing a tendency to be quickly irritated or provoked.

en: Remaining calm and composed, even in very stressful and difficult situations.
Someone who always thinks things through carefully before making any decisions.
A person who is always relaxed and takes a laid-back approach to everything.
uz: Juda stressli va qiyin vaziyatlarda ham xotirjam va o'zini tuta oladigan.
Har qanday qaror qabul qilishdan oldin har doim hammasini yaxshilab o'ylaydigan odam.
Doim xotirjam va hamma narsaga beparvo munosabatda bo'ladigan shaxs.
ru: Сохраняющий спокойствие и самообладание даже в очень стрессовых и сложных ситуациях.
Тот, кто всегда тщательно обдумывает все, прежде чем принимать какие-либо решения.
Человек, который всегда расслаблен и ко всему относится спокойно.

translation.en: Having or showing a strong desire and determination to succeed.
translation.uz: Muvaffaqiyatga erishish uchun kuchli istak va qat'iyatga ega bo'lgan.
translation.ru: Амбициозный, имеющий или проявляющий сильное желание и решимость преуспеть.

example: She's an **ambitious** young woman, determined to reach the top of her profession.
His **ambitious** goals pushed him to work harder than anyone else.
Being **ambitious** is great, but remember to enjoy the journey as well.

quiz.correct_answer: Having or showing a strong desire and determination to succeed.

en: Lacking motivation and having no particular goals for the future.
Someone who is content with their current situation and avoids challenges.
A person who easily gives up when faced with obstacles or difficulties.
uz: Motivatsiyasi yo'q va kelajak uchun hech qanday aniq maqsadlarga ega bo'lmagan.
Joriy holatidan mamnun bo'lgan va qiyinchiliklardan qochadigan odam.
To'siqlar yoki qiyinchiliklarga duch kelganida osongina taslim bo'ladigan shaxs.
ru: Лишенный мотивации и не имеющий конкретных целей на будущее.
Тот, кто доволен своей текущей ситуацией и избегает трудностей.
Человек, который легко сдается, сталкиваясь с препятствиями или трудностями.

translation.en: Careful to avoid potential problems or dangers.
translation.uz: Potensial muammolar yoki xavflardan qochish uchun ehtiyotkor.
translation.ru: Осторожный, внимательный, чтобы избежать потенциальных проблем или опасностей.

example: He was **cautious** about investing in the new company, waiting for more data.
Always be **cautious** when crossing the street, especially in busy areas.
A **cautious** approach is often best when dealing with sensitive issues.

quiz.correct_answer: Careful to avoid potential problems or dangers.

en: Reckless and taking unnecessary risks without thinking.
Impulsive and acting quickly without considering consequences.
Careless and not paying attention to details or potential issues.
uz: Beparvo va o'ylamasdan keraksiz xavflarni oladigan.
Impulsiv va oqibatlarini o'ylamasdan tez harakat qiladigan.
Beparvo va tafsilotlarga yoki potensial muammolarga e'tibor bermaydigan.
ru: Безрассудный и принимающий ненужные риски без раздумий.
Импульсивный и действующий быстро, не обдумывая последствий.
Неосторожный и не обращающий внимания на детали или потенциальные проблемы.

translation.en: Enjoying spending time with other people; friendly.
translation.uz: Boshqa odamlar bilan vaqt o'tkazishni yaxshi ko'radigan; do'stona.
translation.ru: Общительный, любящий проводить время с другими людьми; дружелюбный.

example: He's a very **sociable** person and loves going to parties.
Joining a club can help you become more **sociable** and meet new friends.
Her **sociable** nature made her popular among her classmates and colleagues.

quiz.correct_answer: Enjoying spending time with other people; friendly.

en: Preferring to be alone and avoiding large social gatherings.
Someone who struggles to communicate and avoids talking to others.
A person who is often critical of others and prefers solitude.
uz: Yolg'iz bo'lishni afzal ko'radigan va katta ijtimoiy yig'inlardan qochadigan.
Muloqot qilishda qiynaladigan va boshqalar bilan gaplashishdan qochadigan odam.
Ko'pincha boshqalarni tanqid qiladigan va yolg'izlikni afzal ko'radigan shaxs.
ru: Предпочитающий быть в одиночестве и избегающий больших общественных собраний.
Тот, кто испытывает трудности с общением и избегает разговоров с другими.
Человек, который часто критикует других и предпочитает уединение.

translation.en: Based on or acting on good judgment and practical ideas.
translation.uz: Yaxshi mulohaza va amaliy g'oyalarga asoslangan yoki ularga muvofiq harakat qiladigan.
translation.ru: Разумный, основанный на здравом суждении или действующий в соответствии с ним.

example: It's a **sensible** idea to save money for your future.
She always makes **sensible** decisions, thinking through all the options.
Wearing warm clothes in winter is a very **sensible** thing to do for your health.

quiz.correct_answer: Based on or acting on good judgment and practical ideas.

en: Acting impulsively and without much thought or planning.
Making decisions based on emotions rather than logic.
Ignoring practical considerations and making impractical choices.
uz: Impulsiv va ko'p o'ylamasdan yoki rejalashtirmasdan harakat qiladigan.
Mantiqdan ko'ra hissiyotlarga asoslangan qarorlar qabul qiladigan.
Amaliy masalalarni e'tiborsiz qoldiradigan va amaliy bo'lmagan tanlovlar qiladigan.
ru: Действующий импульсивно и без особых раздумий или планирования.
Принимающий решения на основе эмоций, а не логики.
Игнорирующий практические соображения и делающий непрактичный выбор.

translation.en: Quick to detect or respond to slight changes, signals, or influences.
translation.uz: Kichik o'zgarishlarni, signallarni yoki ta'sirlarni tez aniqlash yoki ularga javob berish.
translation.ru: Чувствительный, быстро обнаруживающий или реагирующий на малейшие изменения, сигналы или влияния.

example: He's very **sensitive** to criticism and often takes it personally.
The new device is highly **sensitive**, detecting even the smallest vibrations.
When discussing personal issues, try to be **sensitive** to people's feelings.

quiz.correct_answer: Quick to detect or respond to slight changes, signals, or influences.

en: Unaware of or unaffected by subtle changes or emotions.
Slow to react or notice details in their surroundings.
Indifferent to others' feelings and lacking empathy in interactions.
uz: Nozik o'zgarishlar yoki hissiyotlardan bexabar yoki ulardan ta'sirlanmaydigan.
Atrofdagi tafsilotlarni payqash yoki ularga javob berishda sekin bo'lgan.
Boshqalarning his-tuyg'ulariga befarq bo'lgan va muloqotda empatiyasi bo'lmagan.
ru: Не замечающий или невосприимчивый к тонким изменениям или эмоциям.
Медленно реагирующий или замечающий детали в своем окружении.
Равнодушный к чувствам других и лишенный сочувствия во взаимодействиях.

translation.en: Truthful and sincere; not deceptive or cheating.
translation.uz: Rostgo'y va samimiy; aldovchi yoki firibgar emas.
translation.ru: Честный, правдивый и искренний; не обманчивый и не жульничающий.

example: Always be **honest** with your friends, even when it's difficult.
An **honest** person earns trust and respect from everyone they meet.
It was an **honest** mistake; I didn't mean to cause any trouble at all.

quiz.correct_answer: Truthful and sincere; not deceptive or cheating.

en: Intentionally misleading others or trying to trick them.
Keeping secrets and hiding information from people.
Saying whatever is convenient, even if it is not true at all.
uz: Boshqalarni qasddan chalg'itadigan yoki ularni aldashga urinadigan.
Sirlarni saqlaydigan va odamlardan ma'lumotlarni yashiradigan.
Haqiqat bo'lmasa ham, qulay bo'lgan narsani aytadigan.
ru: Намеренно вводящий других в заблуждение или пытающийся их обмануть.
Хранящий секреты и скрывающий информацию от людей.
Говорящий то, что удобно, даже если это совсем неправда.

translation.en: Behaving in an untrustworthy or fraudulent way.
translation.uz: Ishonchsiz yoki firibgarona tarzda harakat qiladigan.
translation.ru: Нечестный, ведущий себя ненадежным или мошенническим образом.

example: It was a **dishonest** act to copy answers from another student.
His **dishonest** practices eventually led to his dismissal from the company.
You should never deal with **dishonest** people if you want to avoid problems.

quiz.correct_answer: Behaving in an untrustworthy or fraudulent way.

en: Always telling the truth and acting with integrity in all situations.
Keeping promises and fulfilling commitments reliably every time.
Being fair and just in all dealings, showing great impartiality.
uz: Har doim haqiqatni aytadigan va barcha vaziyatlarda halollik bilan harakat qiladigan.
Va'dalarni bajaradigan va majburiyatlarni har safar ishonchli tarzda ado etadigan.
Barcha bitimlarda adolatli va haqqoniy bo'ladigan, katta xolislik ko'rsatadigan.
ru: Всегда говорящий правду и действующий честно во всех ситуациях.
Выполняющий обещания и надежно выполняющий обязательства каждый раз.
Быть справедливым и честным во всех делах, проявляя большую беспристрастность.

translation.en: Unkind, unpleasant, or bad-tempered.
translation.uz: Qo'pol, yoqimsiz yoki yomon kayfiyatli.
translation.ru: Злой, недобрый, неприятный или дурной.

example: Don't be so **mean** to your little brother; share your toys.
It was a **mean** trick to play on someone who trusted you completely.
His **mean** comments made everyone in the room feel uncomfortable and sad.

quiz.correct_answer: Unkind, unpleasant, or bad-tempered.

en: Always cheerful and spreading joy wherever they go.
Generous and always willing to help others in need.
Respectful and polite in all interactions with people.
uz: Doim quvnoq va qayerga borsa ham quvonch taratadigan.
Saxiy va doim muhtojlarga yordam berishga tayyor bo'lgan.
Odamlar bilan barcha muloqotlarda hurmatli va xushmuomala bo'lgan.
ru: Всегда веселый и распространяющий радость, куда бы он ни пошел.
Щедрый и всегда готовый помочь нуждающимся.
Уважительный и вежливый во всех взаимодействиях с людьми.

translation.en: Lacking courage; easily frightened.
translation.uz: Jasoratsiz; oson qo'rqadigan.
translation.ru: Трусливый, лишенный мужества; легко пугающийся.

example: He was too **cowardly** to admit his mistake and face the consequences.
Running away from the problem was a **cowardly** act, not brave at all.
Being **cowardly** prevents you from experiencing new things and growing.

quiz.correct_answer: Lacking courage; easily frightened.

en: Facing danger directly and showing no fear in difficult situations.
Taking risks and always seeking new challenges with enthusiasm.
Standing up for beliefs and defending others, even when it's hard.
uz: Xavfga to'g'ridan-to'g'ri qarshi turadigan va qiyin vaziyatlarda qo'rquv ko'rsatmaydigan.
Tavakkal qiladigan va doim ishtiyoq bilan yangi qiyinchiliklarni izlaydigan.
Qiyin bo'lsa ham e'tiqodlari uchun turadigan va boshqalarni himoya qiladigan.
ru: Прямо сталкивающийся с опасностью и не проявляющий страха в сложных ситуациях.
Идущий на риск и всегда ищущий новые вызовы с энтузиазмом.
Отстаивающий свои убеждения и защищающий других, даже когда это трудно.

translation.en: Graceful and stylish in appearance or manner.
translation.uz: Tashqi ko'rinishi yoki xulq-atvorida nafis va oqlangan.
translation.ru: Элегантный, изящный и стильный во внешности или манерах.

example: She looked absolutely **elegant** in her long black dress.
The restaurant had an **elegant** atmosphere with soft lighting and classical music.
An **elegant** solution to a complex problem is often the simplest one.

quiz.correct_answer: Graceful and stylish in appearance or manner.

en: Rough and unrefined in design or behavior.
Flashy and overly decorated, attracting too much attention.
Plain and simple, lacking any distinctive features or style.
uz: Dizayn yoki xulq-atvorda qo'pol va nozik bo'lmagan.
Yaltiroq va haddan tashqari bezatilgan, juda ko'p e'tiborni tortadigan.
Oddiy va sodda, hech qanday o'ziga xos xususiyatlari yoki uslubi yo'q.
ru: Грубый и неотесанный по дизайну или поведению.
Яркий и чрезмерно украшенный, привлекающий слишком много внимания.
Простой и обычный, без каких-либо отличительных черт или стиля.

translation.en: Following the current trends or styles.
translation.uz: Joriy tendentsiyalarga yoki uslublarga mos keladigan.
translation.ru: Модный, следующий современным тенденциям или стилям.

example: She always wears the most **fashionable** clothes, straight from the runway.
Being **fashionable** doesn't always mean spending a lot of money.
This new hairstyle is very **fashionable** right now among young people.

quiz.correct_answer: Following the current trends or styles.

en: Old-fashioned and out of date in terms of style or design.
Unusual and unique, not conforming to popular trends at all.
Practical and comfortable, without much regard for appearance.
uz: Uslub yoki dizayn jihatidan eskirgan va modadan qolgan.
G'ayrioddiy va noyob, umuman mashhur tendentsiyalarga mos kelmaydigan.
Tashqi ko'rinishga unchalik e'tibor bermaydigan, amaliy va qulay.
ru: Старомодный и устаревший с точки зрения стиля или дизайна.
Необычный и уникальный, совершенно не соответствующий популярным тенденциям.
Практичный и удобный, без особого внимания к внешнему виду.

translation.en: A set of clothes worn together, especially for a particular occasion or purpose.
translation.uz: Birgalikda kiyiladigan kiyim-kechak to'plami, ayniqsa ma'lum bir tadbir yoki maqsad uchun.
translation.ru: Наряд, комплект одежды, носимый вместе, особенно для определенного случая или цели.

example: She chose a lovely **outfit** for the wedding party.
My favorite **outfit** for relaxing at home is sweatpants and a hoodie.
He planned his whole **outfit** carefully for the job interview to make a good impression.

quiz.correct_answer: A set of clothes worn together, especially for a particular occasion or purpose.

en: A single piece of clothing, such as a shirt or a pair of trousers.
Accessories like jewelry, hats, or bags, worn to complement clothing.
A collection of fabrics used for making various types of garments.
uz: Bitta kiyim, masalan, ko'ylak yoki shim.
Kiyimni to'ldirish uchun taqiladigan yoki olib yuriladigan zargarlik buyumlari, shlyapalar yoki sumkalar kabi aksessuarlar.
Har xil turdagi kiyimlar tayyorlash uchun ishlatiladigan matolar to'plami.
ru: Один предмет одежды, такой как рубашка или брюки.
Аксессуары, такие как украшения, головные уборы или сумки, носимые в дополнение к одежде.
Коллекция тканей, используемых для изготовления различных видов одежды.

translation.en: Items that you wear or carry to complement your clothes, such as jewelry, bags, or scarves.
translation.uz: Kiyimlaringizni to'ldirish uchun taqadigan yoki olib yuradigan buyumlar, masalan, zargarlik buyumlari, sumkalar yoki sharflar.
translation.ru: Аксессуары, предметы, которые вы носите или берете с собой, чтобы дополнить вашу одежду, такие как украшения, сумки или шарфы.

example: She loves to complete her look with matching **accessories**.
The right **accessories** can totally change the look of an simple outfit.
His watch and sunglasses were expensive **accessories** that added to his style.

quiz.correct_answer: Items that you wear or carry to complement your clothes, such as jewelry, bags, or scarves.

en: Basic pieces of clothing like shirts, pants, and dresses.
Footwear such as shoes, boots, and sandals designed for daily wear.
Outerwear like coats and jackets, worn for warmth or protection from elements.
uz: Ko'ylak, shim va ko'ylak kabi asosiy kiyimlar.
Kundalik kiyish uchun mo'ljallangan poyabzallar, masalan, tuflilar, etiklar va sandallar.
Issiqlik yoki elementlardan himoya qilish uchun kiyiladigan paltolar va kurtkalar kabi ustki kiyimlar.
ru: Основные предметы одежды, такие как рубашки, брюки и платья.
Обувь, такая как туфли, ботинки и сандалии, предназначенные для повседневной носки.
Верхняя одежда, такая как пальто и куртки, носимые для тепла или защиты от непогоды.

translation.en: Currently popular and fashionable.
translation.uz: Hozirda mashhur va urfda bo'lgan.
translation.ru: Трендовый, в настоящее время популярный и модный.

example: That cafe is very **trendy** with its modern decor and unique menu.
She always knows about the latest **trendy** gadgets and apps.
These sneakers are incredibly **trendy** among teenagers this season.

quiz.correct_answer: Currently popular and fashionable.

en: Outdated and no longer in style, considered old-fashioned.
Classic and timeless, never going out of style over time.
Unusual or quirky, appealing only to a small, specific group.
uz: Eskirgan va modadan qolgan, eski uslubdagi deb hisoblangan.
Klassik va abadiy, vaqt o'tishi bilan hech qachon modadan chiqmaydigan.
G'ayrioddiy yoki injiq, faqat kichik, o'ziga xos guruhga yoqadigan.
ru: Устаревший и вышедший из моды, считающийся старомодным.
Классический и вневременной, никогда не выходящий из моды со временем.
Необычный или эксцентричный, привлекательный только для небольшой, специфической группы.

translation.en: Untidy and dirty, especially of a person's appearance.
translation.uz: Tartibsiz va iflos, ayniqsa odamning tashqi ko'rinishiga nisbatan.
translation.ru: Неряшливый, неопрятный и грязный, особенно о внешности человека.

example: He looked a bit **scruffy** after working in the garden all day.
Despite his **scruffy** appearance, he was a very intelligent man.
The old dog looked rather **scruffy** with its matted fur and dirty paws.

quiz.correct_answer: Untidy and dirty, especially of a person's appearance.

en: Neat and well-groomed, showing great attention to cleanliness.
Stylish and elegant, indicating a refined sense of fashion.
Bright and colorful, attracting attention with vibrant hues.
uz: Toza va tartibli, tozalikka katta e'tibor beradigan.
Zamonaviy va oqlangan, nafis moda tuyg'usini ko'rsatuvchi.
Yorqin va rangli, jonli ranglar bilan e'tiborni tortadigan.
ru: Аккуратный и ухоженный, уделяющий большое внимание чистоте.
Стильный и элегантный, указывающий на утонченный вкус в моде.
Яркий и красочный, привлекающий внимание яркими оттенками.

translation.en: Wearing attractive and fashionable clothes.
translation.uz: Jozibali va zamonaviy kiyimlarni kiygan.
translation.ru: Хорошо одетый, носящий привлекательную и модную одежду.

example: He always looks very **well-dressed**, even when he's just going to the shop.
To make a good impression, it's important to be **well-dressed** for the interview.
The guests at the gala were all incredibly **well-dressed**, making for a grand sight.

quiz.correct_answer: Wearing attractive and fashionable clothes.

en: Wearing old and worn-out clothes that are not stylish at all.
Dressed in comfortable but informal clothing, suitable for relaxing.
Wearing clothes that are too big or too small, not fitting properly.
uz: Eski va yirtiq kiyimlar kiygan, umuman zamonaviy bo'lmagan.
Qulay, ammo norasmiy kiyimlarda kiyingan, dam olish uchun mos.
Juda katta yoki juda kichik kiyimlar kiygan, to'g'ri o'lchamda bo'lmagan.
ru: Носящий старую и поношенную одежду, которая совсем не стильная.
Одетый в удобную, но неформальную одежду, подходящую для отдыха.
Носящий одежду, которая слишком велика или слишком мала, не подходящую по размеру.

translation.en: In good physical condition; healthy and strong.
translation.uz: Yaxshi jismoniy holatda; sog'lom va kuchli.
translation.ru: Подтянутый, в хорошем физическом состоянии; здоровый и сильный.

example: She works out daily to stay **fit** and maintain her healthy lifestyle.
Being **fit** helps you have more energy for everyday activities.
He was a very **fit** athlete, capable of running long distances without effort.

quiz.correct_answer: In good physical condition; healthy and strong.

en: Feeling tired and lacking energy, unable to perform physical tasks.
Having a common illness or disease that affects overall health.
Weak and fragile, easily susceptible to injury or sickness.
uz: Charchagan va energiyadan mahrum bo'lgan, jismoniy ishlarni bajara olmaydigan.
Umumiy salomatlikka ta'sir qiluvchi keng tarqalgan kasallik yoki xastalikka ega bo'lgan.
Zaif va mo'rt, osongina jarohatlanish yoki kasallikka moyil.
ru: Чувствующий усталость и недостаток энергии, неспособный выполнять физические задачи.
Имеющий распространенное заболевание или болезнь, влияющую на общее состояние здоровья.
Слабый и хрупкий, легко подверженный травмам или болезням.

translation.en: The way that someone or something looks.
translation.uz: Kimdir yoki nimadir qanday ko'rinishi.
translation.ru: Внешний вид, то, как кто-то или что-то выглядит.

example: Her professional **appearance** made a strong first impression.
He paid close attention to his **appearance** before the important meeting.
The building's new **appearance** was a vast improvement after the renovation.

quiz.correct_answer: The way that someone or something looks.

en: The inner thoughts and feelings of a person.
The sound that something makes when it moves.
The taste or smell of food when it is prepared.
uz: Odamning ichki o'ylari va his-tuyg'ulari.
Nimadir harakat qilganda chiqaradigan ovoz.
Tayyorlangan ovqatning ta'mi yoki hidi.
ru: Внутренние мысли и чувства человека.
Звук, который что-то издает при движении.
Вкус или запах еды, когда она приготовлена.

translation.en: The natural colour, texture, and appearance of a person's skin, especially of the face.
translation.uz: Odam terisining, ayniqsa yuzning, tabiiy rangi, tuzilishi va tashqi ko'rinishi.
translation.ru: Цвет лица, естественный цвет, текстура и внешний вид кожи человека, особенно лица.

example: She has a fair **complexion** that easily burns in the sun.
His healthy **complexion** was a result of a good diet and plenty of sleep.
The foundation helps to even out her **complexion** and reduce redness.

quiz.correct_answer: The natural colour, texture, and appearance of a person's skin, especially of the face.

en: The shape and structure of a person's body.
The style of a person's hair and how it is cut.
The type of clothes a person typically wears.
uz: Odam tanasining shakli va tuzilishi.
Odamning soch turmagi va uning qanday kesilganligi.
Odam odatda kiyadigan kiyim turi.
ru: Форма и структура тела человека.
Стиль прически человека и то, как она подстрижена.
Тип одежды, которую обычно носит человек.

translation.en: Having a full, rounded shape; slightly fat in an attractive way.
translation.uz: To'liq, yumaloq shaklga ega; biroz semiz, ammo jozibali tarzda.
translation.ru: Полный, имеющий полную, округлую форму; слегка полный привлекательным образом.

example: The baby had a cute, **plump** face and chubby cheeks.
She looked lovely in the dress, which suited her **plump** figure.
The cushion was soft and **plump**, perfect for resting your head on.

quiz.correct_answer: Having a full, rounded shape; slightly fat in an attractive way.

en: Very thin and bony, lacking any curves or softness.
Tall and athletic, with a very lean and muscular build.
Having a very angular or sharp body shape, not rounded.
uz: Juda ozg'in va suyakli, egri chiziqlar yoki yumshoqlik yo'q.
Baland va sportchi, juda ozg'in va mushakli tanaga ega.
Juda burchakli yoki o'tkir tana shakliga ega, yumaloq emas.
ru: Очень худой и костлявый, без изгибов и мягкости.
Высокий и спортивный, с очень сухим и мускулистым телосложением.
