Имеющий очень угловатую или резкую форму тела, не округлую.

translation.en: Having a strong, attractive body.
translation.uz: Kuchli, jozibali tanaga ega.
translation.ru: Хорошо сложенный, имеющий сильное, привлекательное тело.

example: He's a **well-built** man, clearly spending a lot of time at the gym.
The security guard was a **well-built** individual, looking very strong.
Her **well-built** physique allowed her to excel in various sports activities.

quiz.correct_answer: Having a strong, attractive body.

en: Very thin and weak, lacking any muscle mass or strength.
Overweight and out of shape, with little physical strength.
Small in stature and delicate in appearance, not very strong.
uz: Juda ozg'in va zaif, mushak massasi yoki kuchi yo'q.
Ortiqcha vaznli va shakldan tashqari, jismoniy kuchi kam.
Bo'yi kichik va tashqi ko'rinishi nozik, juda kuchli emas.
ru: Очень худой и слабый, без мышечной массы или силы.
Избыточный вес и не в форме, с небольшой физической силой.
Невысокого роста и хрупкий на вид, не очень сильный.

translation.en: Small, pale brown spots on the skin, often made more visible by the sun.
translation.uz: Teridagi kichik, och jigarrang dog'lar, ko'pincha quyosh ta'sirida ko'proq ko'rinadigan bo'ladi.
translation.ru: Веснушки, маленькие, бледно-коричневые пятна на коже, часто становящиеся более заметными под воздействием солнца.

example: She has lovely red hair and a face full of **freckles**.
In the summer, his **freckles** became much darker from sun exposure.
Many people find **freckles** to be quite charming and unique to their appearance.

quiz.correct_answer: Small, pale brown spots on the skin, often made more visible by the sun.

en: Dark marks on the skin that appear at birth or later in life.
Small raised bumps on the skin, often a sign of a rash or allergy.
Lines or creases on the skin that form due to aging or expressions.
uz: Teri ustida tug'ilishda yoki keyinchalik paydo bo'ladigan quyuq dog'lar.
Teri ustida kichik, ko'tarilgan bo'rtiqlar, ko'pincha toshma yoki allergiya belgisi.
Qarish yoki mimika tufayli paydo bo'ladigan teridagi chiziqlar yoki ajinlar.
ru: Темные пятна на коже, которые появляются при рождении или позже в жизни.
Небольшие приподнятые бугорки на коже, часто признак сыпи или аллергии.
Линии или складки на коже, которые образуются из-за старения или мимики.

translation.en: Lines or folds in skin, especially on the face, caused by age or sun exposure.
translation.uz: Teridagi, ayniqsa yuzdagi yosh yoki quyosh ta'siri tufayli paydo bo'ladigan chiziqlar yoki burmalar.
translation.ru: Морщины, линии или складки на коже, особенно на лице, вызванные возрастом или воздействием солнца.

example: His face was covered in deep **wrinkles** from years of working outdoors.
She proudly displayed her **wrinkles**, seeing them as a sign of a life well lived.
Anti-aging creams often claim to reduce the appearance of fine **wrinkles**.

quiz.correct_answer: Lines or folds in skin, especially on the face, caused by age or sun exposure.

en: Small, dark spots on the skin, usually harmless, that are present from birth.
Blemishes or pimples on the skin, often associated with acne.
Areas of discolored skin caused by injury or certain skin conditions.
uz: Teri ustida kichik, qora dog'lar, odatda zararsiz, tug'ilishdan mavjud bo'lgan.
Teridagi dog'lar yoki husnbuzarlar, ko'pincha aknaga bog'liq.
Jarohat yoki ba'zi teri kasalliklari tufayli rangsizlangan teri joylari.
ru: Маленькие темные пятна на коже, обычно безвредные, присутствующие с рождения.
Пятна или прыщи на коже, часто связанные с акне.
Участки обесцвеченной кожи, вызванные травмой или определенными кожными заболеваниями.

translation.en: Having little or no hair on the head.
translation.uz: Boshida oz yoki umuman soch bo'lmagan.
translation.ru: Лысый, имеющий мало или совсем не имеющий волос на голове.

example: He started going **bald** in his early twenties, just like his father.
The old man was completely **bald** and wore a hat to keep his head warm.
Some people choose to shave their heads completely **bald** for a clean look.

quiz.correct_answer: Having little or no hair on the head.

en: Having long and thick hair that needs regular trimming.
Having hair that is curly and difficult to manage or style.
Having hair that is dyed a bright and unusual color.
uz: Muntazam kesishni talab qiladigan uzun va qalin sochlarga ega bo'lgan.
Jingalak va boshqarish yoki uslub berish qiyin bo'lgan sochlarga ega bo'lgan.
Yorqin va g'ayrioddiy rangga bo'yalgan sochlarga ega bo'lgan.
ru: Имеющий длинные и густые волосы, которые нуждаются в регулярной стрижке.
Имеющий кудрявые волосы, которые трудно укладывать или причесывать.
Имеющий волосы, окрашенные в яркий и необычный цвет.

translation.en: Hair that grows on a man's chin and cheeks.
translation.uz: Erkakning iyagi va yonoqlarida o'sadigan sochlar.
translation.ru: Борода, волосы, растущие на подбородке и щеках мужчины.

example: He decided to grow a **beard** for the winter to keep his face warm.
His long, grey **beard** made him look like a wise old wizard.
Many men choose to trim their **beard** regularly to maintain a neat look.

quiz.correct_answer: Hair that grows on a man's chin and cheeks.

en: Hair that grows on a person's head, covering the scalp.
Hair that grows on a man's upper lip, above the mouth.
Short hair on a man's face, often maintained by daily shaving.
uz: Odam boshida o'sadigan, bosh terisini qoplagan sochlar.
Erkakning yuqori labida, og'izdan yuqorida o'sadigan sochlar.
Erkakning yuzidagi qisqa sochlar, ko'pincha kundalik soqol olish orqali saqlanadigan.
ru: Волосы, растущие на голове человека, покрывающие кожу головы.
Волосы, растущие на верхней губе мужчины, над ртом.
Короткие волосы на лице мужчины, часто поддерживаемые ежедневным бритьем.

translation.en: A strip of hair grown by men on their upper lip.
translation.uz: Erkaklar tomonidan yuqori labida o'stiriladigan soch chizig'i.
translation.ru: Усы, полоска волос, отращиваемая мужчинами на верхней губе.

example: He had a neatly trimmed **moustache** that suited his face.
The detective was easily recognizable by his thick, bushy **moustache**.
Some historical figures are famous for their distinctive **moustaches**.

quiz.correct_answer: A strip of hair grown by men on their upper lip.

en: Hair growing on a man's chin and cheeks, covering the lower face.
Hair on a person's head, styled in various ways for fashion.
Short hair growing on the face after a few days without shaving.
uz: Erkakning iyagi va yonoqlarida o'sadigan, yuzning pastki qismini qoplagan sochlar.
Odam boshidagi, moda uchun turli yo'llar bilan uslub berilgan sochlar.
Bir necha kun soqol olmasdan keyin yuzda o'sadigan qisqa sochlar.
ru: Волосы, растущие на подбородке и щеках мужчины, покрывающие нижнюю часть лица.
Волосы на голове человека, уложенные различными способами для моды.
Короткие волосы, растущие на лице после нескольких дней без бритья.

translation.en: A hole made in the body for wearing jewelry.
translation.uz: Zargarlik buyumlarini taqish uchun tanada qilingan teshik.
translation.ru: Пирсинг, отверстие, сделанное в теле для ношения украшений.

example: She has several ear **piercings** and a small nose ring.
Getting a new **piercing** can be a way to express your individuality.
Some cultures use traditional **piercings** as a sign of status or identity.

quiz.correct_answer: A hole made in the body for wearing jewelry.

en: A small, decorative tattoo on the skin.
A type of permanent body paint used for artistic expression.
A temporary sticker applied to the skin, resembling a real design.
uz: Teridagi kichik, bezakli tatuirovka.
Badiiy ifoda uchun ishlatiladigan doimiy tana bo'yog'i turi.
Teriga yopishtirilgan va haqiqiy dizaynga o'xshagan vaqtinchalik stiker.
ru: Маленькая декоративная татуировка на коже.
Тип перманентной боди-арта, используемый для художественного самовыражения.
Временная наклейка, наносимая на кожу, напоминающая настоящий рисунок.

translation.en: A permanent picture or design on the skin, made by pricking the skin and inserting colored ink.
translation.uz: Terini teshib va rangli siyoh kiritish orqali terida qilingan doimiy rasm yoki dizayn.
translation.ru: Татуировка, постоянный рисунок или узор на коже, сделанный путем прокалывания кожи и введения цветных чернил.

example: He has a large dragon **tattoo** on his arm that took hours to complete.
Getting a **tattoo** is a significant decision as it is generally permanent.
Many people get a **tattoo** to commemorate important events or loved ones.

quiz.correct_answer: A permanent picture or design on the skin, made by pricking the skin and inserting colored ink.

en: A temporary drawing on the skin that washes off after a few days.
A type of body art where the skin is painted with natural dyes.
A small metal ornament attached to clothing or hair for decoration.
uz: Bir necha kundan keyin yuvilib ketadigan teridagi vaqtinchalik rasm.
Teri tabiiy bo'yoqlar bilan bo'yaladigan tana san'ati turi.
Kiyim yoki sochga bezak uchun yopishtirilgan kichik metall bezak.
ru: Временный рисунок на коже, который смывается через несколько дней.
Вид боди-арта, при котором кожа окрашивается натуральными красителями.
Небольшое металлическое украшение, прикрепленное к одежде или волосам для декорации.

translation.en: Fashionable and elegant in appearance or manner.
translation.uz: Tashqi ko'rinishi yoki xulq-atvorida zamonaviy va oqlangan.
translation.ru: Стильный, модный и элегантный во внешности или манерах.

example: She has a very **stylish** apartment with modern furniture.
His new haircut makes him look incredibly **stylish** and sophisticated.
The boutique offers a wide range of **stylish** clothing for every occasion.

quiz.correct_answer: Fashionable and elegant in appearance or manner.

en: Old-fashioned and out of date in its design or aesthetic.
Plain and simple, lacking any distinctive features or flair.
Rough and unpolished, without any refined qualities.
uz: Dizayni yoki estetikasida eskirgan va modadan qolgan.
Oddiy va sodda, hech qanday o'ziga xos xususiyatlari yoki jozibasi yo'q.
Qo'pol va sayqallanmagan, hech qanday nozik xususiyatlarga ega bo'lmagan.
ru: Старомодный и устаревший по своему дизайну или эстетике.
Простой и обычный, без каких-либо отличительных черт или изюминки.
Грубый и неотшлифованный, без каких-либо изысканных качеств.

translation.en: Untidy; disordered, especially of a person's hair, clothes, or appearance.
translation.uz: Tartibsiz; pala-partish, ayniqsa odamning sochlari, kiyimlari yoki tashqi ko'rinishi.
translation.ru: Растрепанный, неопрятный; в беспорядке, особенно о волосах, одежде или внешности человека.

example: He looked a bit **dishevelled** after a long night of studying.
Her hair was **dishevelled** from running in the wind, but she still smiled.
Despite his **dishevelled** suit, he managed to deliver a confident speech.

quiz.correct_answer: Untidy; disordered, especially of a person's hair, clothes, or appearance.

en: Neat and well-organized in all aspects of personal presentation.
Impeccably clean and tidy, showing great attention to detail.
Fashionable and trendy, always up-to-date with the latest styles.
uz: Shaxsiy taqdimotning barcha jihatlarida toza va yaxshi tashkil etilgan.
Mukammal toza va tartibli, tafsilotlarga katta e'tibor beradigan.
Zamonaviy va moda, har doim so'nggi uslublar bilan yangilanib turadigan.
ru: Аккуратный и хорошо организованный во всех аспектах личной презентации.
Безупречно чистый и опрятный, проявляющий большое внимание к деталям.
Модный и трендовый, всегда в курсе последних стилей.

translation.en: To change the color of something, especially hair or fabric, by soaking it in a special liquid.
translation.uz: Nimaningdir, ayniqsa soch yoki matoning rangini maxsus suyuqlikda namlab o'zgartirish.
translation.ru: Красить, изменять цвет чего-либо, особенно волос или ткани, путем замачивания в специальной жидкости.

example: She decided to **dye** her hair bright pink for a bold new look.
Many people **dye** their clothes to refresh old items or create new designs.
The factory uses natural ingredients to **dye** its textiles in various shades.

quiz.correct_answer: To change the color of something, especially hair or fabric, by soaking it in a special liquid.

en: To cut or trim something to make it shorter or neater in appearance.
To wash something thoroughly with soap and water to remove dirt.
To dry something completely after it has been wet, using heat or air.
uz: Nimadirni tashqi ko'rinishini qisqartirish yoki tartibga solish uchun kesish yoki qirqish.
Nimadirni ifloslikni ketkazish uchun sovun va suv bilan yaxshilab yuvish.
Nimadirni ho'l bo'lganidan keyin issiqlik yoki havo yordamida butunlay quritish.
ru: Обрезать или подстригать что-либо, чтобы сделать его короче или опрятнее.
Тщательно мыть что-либо с мылом и водой, чтобы удалить грязь.
Полностью высушивать что-либо после того, как оно было мокрым, используя тепло или воздух.

translation.en: A person with reddish-brown hair.
translation.uz: Qizil-jigarrang sochli odam.
translation.ru: Рыжий, человек с рыжевато-каштановыми волосами.

example: He has a distinctive **ginger** beard that perfectly matches his hair.
The little girl had bright **ginger** hair and a sprinkle of freckles on her nose.
In some cultures, **ginger** hair is considered unique and beautiful.

quiz.correct_answer: A person with reddish-brown hair.

en: A person with very dark brown or black hair.
A person with light blonde hair, often very pale.
A person with completely grey or white hair.
uz: Juda to'q jigarrang yoki qora sochli odam.
Ochiq sarg'ish sochli, ko'pincha juda oqish odam.
Butunlay kulrang yoki oq sochli odam.
ru: Человек с очень темно-каштановыми или черными волосами.
Человек со светлыми светлыми волосами, часто очень бледными.
Человек с полностью седыми или белыми волосами.

translation.en: A hairstyle in which the hair is tied into two plaits or braids at either side of the head.
translation.uz: Soch ikki o'rim yoki kokilga o'rilgan soch turmagi.
translation.ru: Косички, прическа, при которой волосы завязаны в две косы или косички по обеим сторонам головы.

example: The young girl wore her hair in cute **pigtails** with pink ribbons.
She always put her hair in **pigtails** when she went for a run.
Many cartoon characters are recognizable by their distinctive **pigtails**.

quiz.correct_answer: A hairstyle in which the hair is tied into two plaits or braids at either side of the head.

en: A single braid or plait worn down the back.
Hair that is cut very short all around the head.
A bun or knot of hair twisted and fastened at the back of the head.
uz: Orqa tomonga tushirilgan bitta o'rim yoki kokil.
Bosh atrofida juda qisqa kesilgan sochlar.
Boshning orqa qismida burama va mahkamlangan soch to'plami yoki tuguni.
ru: Одна коса или косичка, носимая сзади.
Волосы, подстриженные очень коротко по всей голове.
Пучок или узел из волос, скрученный и закрепленный на затылке.

translation.en: A hairstyle in which the hair is tied back high on the head so that it hangs down like a horse's tail.
translation.uz: Soch boshning yuqorisida orqaga bog'langan, ot dumiga o'xshab osilib turadigan soch turmagi.
translation.ru: Хвост, прическа, при которой волосы завязываются высоко на голове так, что свисают вниз, как хвост лошади.

example: She often wears her long hair in a high **ponytail** for convenience.
A neat **ponytail** is perfect for sports or working out at the gym.
He pulled his hair back into a small **ponytail** to keep it out of his eyes.

quiz.correct_answer: A hairstyle in which the hair is tied back high on the head so that it hangs down like a horse's tail.

en: Hair that is left loose and falls freely around the shoulders.
A hairstyle where hair is intricately braided close to the scalp.
A short, spiky haircut that stands up on top of the head.
uz: Yelkalar atrofida erkin tushib turadigan bo'sh qoldirilgan sochlar.
Soch bosh terisiga yaqin murakkab o'rilgan soch turmagi.
Boshning tepasida tik turadigan qisqa, tikanli soch turmagi.
ru: Волосы, которые остаются распущенными и свободно спадают на плечи.
Прическа, при которой волосы замысловато заплетены близко к коже головы.
Короткая, колючая стрижка, которая стоит дыбом на макушке.

translation.en: A hairstyle in which hair is drawn back and twisted into a round mass at the back of the head.
translation.uz: Soch orqaga tortilib, boshning orqa qismida yumaloq massaga o'ralgan soch turmagi.
translation.ru: Пучок, прическа, при которой волосы забираются назад и скручиваются в круглую массу на затылке.

example: She wore her hair in a classic, elegant **bun** for the formal event.
A messy **bun** is a popular and comfortable style for everyday wear.
The ballerina's tight **bun** kept her hair perfectly in place during her performance.

quiz.correct_answer: A hairstyle in which hair is drawn back and twisted into a round mass at the back of the head.

en: Hair that is cut very short and stands upright on the head.
Hair that is allowed to hang loose and long, without being tied.
A style where hair is divided into many small braids all over the head.
uz: Juda qisqa kesilgan va boshda tik turadigan sochlar.
Bog'lanmagan holda bo'sh va uzun tushishiga ruxsat berilgan sochlar.
Soch boshning hamma joyida ko'plab kichik o'rimlarga bo'lingan uslub.
ru: Волосы, которые очень коротко подстрижены и стоят вертикально на голове.
Волосы, которым позволено свободно свисать и быть длинными, не будучи завязанными.
Стиль, при котором волосы разделены на множество маленьких косичек по всей голове.

translation.en: A section of hair cut short and worn over the forehead; bangs.
translation.uz: Peshona ustiga kesilgan va tushirilgan soch bo'lagi; chekka sochlar.
translation.ru: Челка, часть волос, коротко подстриженная и носимая надо лбом.

example: She decided to cut a **fringe** to frame her face differently.
His new hairstyle includes a long, swept-aside **fringe**.
A short **fringe** can sometimes make a face look more youthful and fresh.

quiz.correct_answer: A section of hair cut short and worn over the forehead; bangs.

en: Long hair that falls over the shoulders and back.
Hair that is gathered and tied at the back of the head.
Short hair on the sides of the head, above the ears.
uz: Yelkalar va orqa tomonga tushadigan uzun sochlar.
Boshning orqa qismida to'plangan va bog'langan sochlar.
Boshning yon tomonlaridagi, quloqlardan yuqoridagi qisqa sochlar.
ru: Длинные волосы, ниспадающие на плечи и спину.
Волосы, собранные и завязанные на затылке.
Короткие волосы по бокам головы, над ушами.

translation.en: Having a lot of curls or a wavy shape.
translation.uz: Ko'p jingalak yoki to'lqinli shaklga ega bo'lgan.
translation.ru: Кудрявый, имеющий много завитков или волнистую форму.

example: She has beautiful, naturally **curly** hair that she rarely straightens.
His dog has a thick, **curly** coat that needs regular grooming.
The leaves of the plant were large and slightly **curly** at the edges.

quiz.correct_answer: Having a lot of curls or a wavy shape.

en: Straight and smooth, without any bends or waves.
Very short and spiky, standing upright on the head.
Thin and sparse, lacking volume or density.
uz: Hech qanday burilish yoki to'lqinlarsiz tekis va silliq.
Juda qisqa va tikanli, boshda tik turadigan.
Ingichka va siyrak, hajm yoki zichlikdan mahrum.
ru: Прямой и гладкий, без изгибов и волн.
Очень короткий и колючий, стоящий вертикально на голове.
Тонкий и редкий, лишенный объема или плотности.

translation.en: Having a series of curves; not straight or curly.
translation.uz: Bir qator egri chiziqlarga ega; tekis yoki jingalak emas.
translation.ru: Волнистый, имеющий ряд изгибов; не прямой и не кудрявый.

example: She has beautiful **wavy** hair that looks natural and soft.
His hair is neither straight nor curly, but nicely **wavy**.
The artist painted the ocean with **wavy** lines to show the movement of the water.

quiz.correct_answer: Having a series of curves; not straight or curly.

en: Completely straight and smooth, without any bends.
Having very tight curls, forming small spirals.
Very short and standing up, not falling down at all.
uz: Hech qanday burilishlarsiz butunlay tekis va silliq.
Juda tor jingalaklarga ega bo'lgan, kichik spirallar hosil qiladigan.
Juda qisqa va tik turadigan, umuman tushmaydigan.
ru: Полностью прямой и гладкий, без изгибов.
Имеющий очень тугие завитки, образующие маленькие спирали.
Очень короткий и стоящий дыбом, совсем не ниспадающий.

translation.en: A length of hair made up of three or more interlaced strands.
translation.uz: Uch yoki undan ortiq o'zaro o'ralgan iplardan tashkil topgan soch uzunligi.
translation.ru: Коса, длина волос, состоящая из трех или более переплетенных прядей.

example: She wore her hair in a long **braid** that reached her waist.
He learned how to create a complex French **braid** from a tutorial.
Many traditional hairstyles feature intricate **braids** and twists.

quiz.correct_answer: A length of hair made up of three or more interlaced strands.

en: A single strand of hair that hangs loosely.
Hair that is cut very short all around the head.
A collection of hair tied back in a single ponytail.
uz: Bo'sh tushgan bitta soch tolasi.
Bosh atrofida juda qisqa kesilgan sochlar.
Bitta ot dumiga bog'langan sochlar to'plami.
ru: Одна прядь волос, которая свободно свисает.
Волосы, подстриженные очень коротко по всей голове.
Пучок волос, собранный в один хвост.

translation.en: A state of mental or emotional strain or tension resulting from adverse or demanding circumstances.
translation.uz: Noqulay yoki talabchan sharoitlar natijasida yuzaga keladigan ruhiy yoki hissiy zo'riqish holati.
translation.ru: Состояние психического или эмоционального напряжения, вызванное неблагоприятными или требовательными обстоятельствами.

example: Managing stress is crucial for overall well-being and a calmer mind.
Too much work and lack of sleep can lead to increased stress levels.
She felt a lot of stress before her final exams and important presentation.

quiz.correct_answer: A state of mental or emotional strain or tension resulting from adverse or demanding circumstances.

en: A feeling of great happiness and excitement about a positive event or outcome.
A medical condition where one has too much physical energy and cannot relax properly.
A state of complete physical relaxation and calm after a long period of activity.
uz: Ijobiy hodisa yoki natijadan katta baxt va hayajon hissi.
Jismoniy energiyasi juda ko'p bo'lgan va to'g'ri dam ololmaydigan tibbiy holat.
Uzoq muddatli faoliyatdan keyin to'liq jismoniy bo'shashish va tinchlik holati.
ru: Чувство большого счастья и волнения по поводу позитивного события или исхода.
Медицинское состояние, при котором у человека слишком много физической энергии, и он не может должным образом расслабиться.
Состояние полного физического расслабления и спокойствия после длительного периода активности.

translation.en: A diet that contains the proper quantities and proportions of foods needed to maintain health.
translation.uz: Salomatlikni saqlash uchun zarur bo'lgan oziq-ovqatlarning to'g'ri miqdori va nisbatini o'z ichiga olgan parhez.
translation.ru: Диета, содержащая правильное количество и пропорции продуктов, необходимых для поддержания здоровья.

example: Eating a balanced diet with various nutrients is essential for good health.
She tries to maintain a balanced diet by including lots of fruits and vegetables daily.
A balanced diet provides all the necessary nutrients and energy for the body to function.

quiz.correct_answer: A diet that contains the proper quantities and proportions of foods needed to maintain health.

en: A diet consisting only of fruits and vegetables for rapid detoxification.
A meal plan specifically designed to help you lose weight very quickly and dramatically.
A diet focused on eating a lot of processed foods and sugary drinks regularly.
uz: Tez detoksifikatsiya uchun faqat meva va sabzavotlardan iborat parhez.
Juda tez va keskin vazn yo'qotishga yordam berish uchun maxsus ishlab chiqilgan ovqatlanish rejasi.
Muntazam ravishda ko'p miqdorda qayta ishlangan ovqatlar va shakarli ichimliklarni iste'mol qilishga qaratilgan parhez.
ru: Диета, состоящая только из фруктов и овощей для быстрой детоксикации.
План питания, специально разработанный для очень быстрого и резкого похудения.
Диета, сосредоточенная на регулярном употреблении большого количества обработанных продуктов и сладких напитков.

translation.en: The state of being comfortable, healthy, or happy, both physically and mentally.
translation.uz: Jismoniy va ruhiy jihatdan qulay, sog'lom yoki baxtli bo'lish holati.
translation.ru: Состояние комфорта, здоровья или счастья, как физически, так и психически.

example: Focusing on mental well-being is as important as maintaining good physical health.
Her well-being improved significantly after she started meditating and exercising regularly.
The company cares about the overall well-being of its employees and offers support programs.

quiz.correct_answer: The state of being comfortable, healthy, or happy, both physically and mentally.

en: A feeling of sadness or dissatisfaction with life and personal circumstances.
The process of becoming physically stronger through intense training programs.
A temporary state of excitement or nervousness before an important event.
uz: Hayot va shaxsiy sharoitlardan norozilik yoki qayg'u hissi.
Intensiv mashg'ulot dasturlari orqali jismoniy jihatdan kuchliroq bo'lish jarayoni.
Muhim voqea oldidan vaqtinchalik hayajon yoki asabiylik holati.
ru: Чувство грусти или неудовлетворенности жизнью и личными обстоятельствами.
Процесс становления физически сильнее через интенсивные тренировочные программы.
Временное состояние возбуждения или нервозности перед важным событием.

translation.en: The practice of focusing one's mind for a period of time, for relaxation or spiritual purposes.
translation.uz: Dam olish yoki ma'naviy maqsadlar uchun ma'lum vaqt davomida ongni jamlash amaliyoti.
translation.ru: Практика сосредоточения ума на определенное время для расслабления или духовных целей.

example: Meditation can help reduce stress and improve focus and emotional clarity.
She practices meditation every morning to start her day calmly and mindfully.
Many people find inner peace and a sense of calm through regular meditation sessions.

quiz.correct_answer: The practice of focusing one's mind for a period of time, for relaxation or spiritual purposes.

en: A type of fast-paced physical activity, often involving competitive sports.
The act of engaging in loud conversation or heated debate with others.
A method for solving complex mathematical problems or logical puzzles.
uz: Ko'pincha raqobatbardosh sport turlarini o'z ichiga olgan tezkor jismoniy faoliyat turi.
Boshqalar bilan baland ovozda suhbatlashish yoki qizg'in munozara qilish harakati.
Murakkab matematik masalalar yoki mantiqiy jumboqlarni yechish usuli.
ru: Вид быстрой физической активности, часто связанный с соревновательными видами спорта.
Акт ведения громкого разговора или жарких дебатов с другими людьми.
Метод решения сложных математических задач или логических головоломок.

translation.en: How well and deep one's sleep is, referring to its restorative effect rather than just the duration.
translation.uz: Uxlash muddati emas, balki qanchalik yaxshi va chuqur uxlash, uning tiklovchi ta'siriga ishora qiladi.
translation.ru: Насколько хорошо и глубоко спит человек, имея в виду восстанавливающий эффект, а не только продолжительность.

example: Improving sleep quality is vital for energy, concentration, and overall cognitive function.
Factors like a dark, quiet room can significantly enhance sleep quality and restfulness.
Lack of good sleep quality can negatively affect your mood, health, and daily performance.

quiz.correct_answer: How well and deep one's sleep is, referring to its restorative effect rather than just the duration.

en: The total number of hours one spends asleep during a 24-hour period.
The amount of physical activity performed right before bed to induce tiredness.
The type of bed and mattress used for sleeping, impacting comfort levels.
uz: 24 soatlik davrda uxlagan umumiy soatlar soni.
Uyqudan oldin charchoqni keltirib chiqarish uchun bajarilgan jismoniy faoliyat miqdori.
Uxlagan to'shak va matras turi, qulaylik darajasiga ta'sir qiladi.
ru: Общее количество часов, проведенных во сне за 24-часовой период.
Объем физической активности, выполняемой непосредственно перед сном для вызова усталости.
Тип кровати и матраса, используемых для сна, влияющий на уровень комфорта.

translation.en: A person's emotional, psychological, and social well-being, affecting how we think and feel.
translation.uz: Shaxsning hissiy, psixologik va ijtimoiy farovonligi, bizning fikrlash va his qilishimizga ta'sir qiladi.
translation.ru: Эмоциональное, психологическое и социальное благополучие человека, влияющее на то, как мы думаем и чувствуем.

example: It's important to talk openly about mental health to reduce stigma and encourage support.
Strong support systems are crucial for maintaining good mental health and resilience.
Mental health issues can affect anyone, regardless of age, background, or social status.

quiz.correct_answer: A person's emotional, psychological, and social well-being, affecting how we think and feel.

en: The physical condition of one's body and internal organs, unrelated to emotions.
The ability to remember things clearly and solve complex problems accurately.
A state of feeling constantly energetic and active without any need for rest.
uz: Odamning tanasi va ichki organlarining jismoniy holati, hissiyotlarga aloqador emas.
Narsalarni aniq eslab qolish va murakkab muammolarni to'g'ri hal qilish qobiliyati.
Doimiy ravishda tetik va faol bo'lish holati, dam olishga ehtiyoj sezmasdan.
ru: Физическое состояние тела и внутренних органов человека, не связанное с эмоциями.
Способность ясно запоминать вещи и точно решать сложные проблемы.
Состояние постоянного ощущения энергии и активности без необходимости отдыха.

translation.en: The process of providing or obtaining the food necessary for health and growth.
translation.uz: Salomatlik va o'sish uchun zarur bo'lgan ovqatni ta'minlash yoki olish jarayoni.
translation.ru: Процесс обеспечения или получения пищи, необходимой для здоровья и роста.

example: Good nutrition is the foundation of a healthy lifestyle and strong body.
Learning about proper nutrition can help you make better food choices.
Athletes pay close attention to their nutrition for optimal performance.

quiz.correct_answer: The process of providing or obtaining the food necessary for health and growth.

en: The act of physical exercise to build muscle and improve endurance.
The study of how the human brain processes information and memories.
The practice of meditation for achieving inner peace and mindfulness.
uz: Mushaklarni qurish va chidamlilikni oshirish uchun jismoniy mashqlar qilish.
Inson miyasi ma'lumot va xotiralarni qanday qayta ishlashini o'rganish.
Ichki tinchlik va onglilikka erishish uchun meditatsiya amaliyoti.
ru: Акт физических упражнений для наращивания мышц и улучшения выносливости.
Изучение того, как человеческий мозг обрабатывает информацию и воспоминания.
Практика медитации для достижения внутреннего покоя и осознанности.

translation.en: Decisions and habits related to how a person lives, affecting their health.
translation.uz: Insonning yashash tarzi bilan bog'liq qarorlar va odatlar, uning sog'lig'iga ta'sir qiladi.
translation.ru: Решения и привычки, связанные с образом жизни человека, влияющие на его здоровье.

example: Positive lifestyle choices, like not smoking, contribute to longevity.
Many health problems are linked to unhealthy lifestyle choices.
Making small changes to your lifestyle choices can have a big impact.

quiz.correct_answer: Decisions and habits related to how a person lives, affecting their health.

en: Financial decisions about spending and saving money wisely.
Choices made regarding career paths and professional development.
The types of books and movies a person prefers to consume.
uz: Pulni oqilona sarflash va tejash bo'yicha moliyaviy qarorlar.
Kasbiy yo'nalishlar va kasbiy rivojlanish bo'yicha qabul qilingan qarorlar.
Odamning afzal ko'rgan kitob va filmlar turlari.
ru: Финансовые решения о разумном расходовании и сбережении денег.
Выбор, сделанный в отношении карьерного пути и профессионального развития.
Типы книг и фильмов, которые человек предпочитает употреблять.

translation.en: The body's defense system against infections and diseases.
translation.uz: Tananing infektsiyalar va kasalliklarga qarshi himoya tizimi.
translation.ru: Защитная система организма от инфекций и болезней.

example: A strong immune system helps fight off colds and flu.
Eating vitamin-rich foods can boost your immune system.
Stress can weaken the immune system, making you more vulnerable.

quiz.correct_answer: The body's defense system against infections and diseases.

en: The system that circulates blood throughout the body.
The part of the brain responsible for memory and learning.
The network of nerves that carry messages to and from the brain.
uz: Qonni butun tanada aylantiradigan tizim.
Miya ichida xotira va o'rganish uchun mas'ul bo'lgan qism.
Miya va undan xabarlarni olib boruvchi nervlar tarmog'i.
ru: Система, которая циркулирует кровь по всему телу.
Часть мозга, отвечающая за память и обучение.
Сеть нервов, которые передают сообщения в мозг и из него.

translation.en: Healthcare focused on preventing illness rather than treating it.
translation.uz: Kasallikni davolashdan ko'ra oldini olishga qaratilgan sog'liqni saqlash.
translation.ru: Здравоохранение, направленное на предотвращение болезней, а не на их лечение.

example: Vaccinations are a key part of preventive medicine.
Preventive medicine emphasizes healthy habits and regular check-ups.
Many doctors advocate for more investment in preventive medicine.

quiz.correct_answer: Healthcare focused on preventing illness rather Nations treating it.

en: Treatment methods that focus solely on surgical procedures.
Medical approaches that only treat symptoms after an illness occurs.
Healthcare services provided only in emergency situations.
uz: Faqat jarrohlik amaliyotlariga qaratilgan davolash usullari.
Kasallik yuzaga kelganidan keyin faqat simptomlarni davolaydigan tibbiy yondashuvlar.
Faqat favqulodda vaziyatlarda ko'rsatiladigan sog'liqni saqlash xizmatlari.
ru: Методы лечения, сосредоточенные исключительно на хирургических процедурах.
Медицинские подходы, которые лечат симптомы только после возникновения болезни.
Медицинские услуги, предоставляемые только в экстренных ситуациях.

translation.en: A structured plan or initiative designed to improve overall health and happiness.
translation.uz: Umumiy sog'liq va baxtni yaxshilashga qaratilgan tuzilgan reja yoki tashabbus.
translation.ru: Структурированный план или инициатива, разработанная для улучшения общего здоровья и счастья.

example: Our company launched a new well-being program for employees.
Participating in a well-being program can boost your mood and energy.
The community center offers a variety of well-being programs for all ages.

quiz.correct_answer: A structured plan or initiative designed to improve overall health and happiness.

en: A marketing strategy for selling health products.
A special diet plan for losing weight rapidly.
A scientific research project on human psychology.
uz: Sog'liqni saqlash mahsulotlarini sotish uchun marketing strategiyasi.
Tez vazn yo'qotish uchun maxsus parhez rejasi.
Inson psixologiyasi bo'yicha ilmiy tadqiqot loyihasi.
ru: Маркетинговая стратегия для продажи товаров для здоровья.
Специальный план диеты для быстрого похудения.
Научно-исследовательский проект по психологии человека.

translation.en: Regular routines or practices that contribute positively to one's health.
translation.uz: Insonning sog'lig'iga ijobiy ta'sir ko'rsatadigan muntazam odatlar yoki amaliyotlar.
translation.ru: Регулярные привычки или практики, которые положительно влияют на здоровье.

example: Developing healthy habits early in life is very beneficial.
Eating breakfast and drinking water are examples of healthy habits.
She made a conscious effort to establish more healthy habits.

quiz.correct_answer: Regular routines or practices that contribute positively to one's health.

en: Unhealthy routines that negatively affect physical condition.
Unexpected events that cause discomfort or illness.
One-time actions taken in an emergency situation.
uz: Jismoniy holatga salbiy ta'sir ko'rsatadigan zararli odatlar.
Noqulaylik yoki kasallikni keltirib chiqaradigan kutilmagan hodisalar.
Favqulodda vaziyatda qilingan bir martalik harakatlar.
ru: Нездоровые привычки, которые негативно влияют на физическое состояние.
Неожиданные события, вызывающие дискомфорт или болезнь.
Одноразовые действия, предпринятые в экстренной ситуации.

translation.en: The quality or state of being conscious or aware of something; a mental state achieved by focusing on the present.
translation.uz: Nimadandir xabardor bo'lish sifati yoki holati; hozirgi vaqtga e'tibor qaratish orqali erishilgan aqliy holat.
translation.ru: Качество или состояние осознанности чего-либо; психическое состояние, достигаемое сосредоточением на настоящем.

example: Practicing mindfulness can help reduce anxiety and improve concentration.
Mindfulness encourages you to pay attention to your thoughts and feelings without judgment.
She started a mindfulness course to enhance her overall well-being.

quiz.correct_answer: The quality or state of being conscious or aware of something; a mental state achieved by focusing on the present.

en: The ability to remember a large amount of information quickly.
A state of deep sleep where dreams are very vivid and clear.
The act of planning future events and making detailed schedules.
uz: Ko'p miqdordagi ma'lumotni tezda eslab qolish qobiliyati.
Tushlar juda yorqin va aniq bo'ladigan chuqur uyqu holati.
Kelajakdagi voqealarni rejalashtirish va batafsil jadvallar tuzish harakati.
ru: Способность быстро запоминать большой объем информации.
Состояние глубокого сна, при котором сны очень яркие и четкие.
Действие по планированию будущих событий и составлению подробных расписаний.

translation.en: An action or omission that constitutes an offense punishable by law, often harmful to society.
translation.uz: Qonun bilan jazolanadigan huquqbuzarlikni tashkil etuvchi harakat yoki harakatsizlik, ko'pincha jamiyatga zararli.
translation.ru: Действие или бездействие, являющееся правонарушением, наказуемым по закону, часто вредное для общества.

example: The police are investigating a serious crime that occurred last night in the city.
Shoplifting, though seemingly minor, is still considered a type of petty crime.
He was charged with committing a crime after evidence linked him to the incident.

quiz.correct_answer: An action or omission that constitutes an offense punishable by law, often harmful to society.

en: A sudden loud noise in the street that causes public disturbance.
A helpful act that significantly benefits the community and its members.
A pleasant social gathering with friends for entertainment and relaxation.
uz: Ko'chada jamoat tartibini buzadigan to'satdan baland shovqin.
Jamiyatga va uning a'zolariga sezilarli foyda keltiradigan yordamchi harakat.
Do'stlar bilan ko'ngil ochish va dam olish uchun yoqimli ijtimoiy yig'ilish.
ru: Внезапный громкий шум на улице, вызывающий общественное беспокойство.
Полезное действие, которое значительно приносит пользу обществу и его членам.
Приятное общественное собрание с друзьями для развлечения и отдыха.

translation.en: The civil force of a state responsible for maintaining public order and preventing crime.
translation.uz: Jamoat tartibini saqlash va jinoyatchilikning oldini olish uchun mas'ul davlat fuqarolik kuchlari.
translation.ru: Гражданская сила государства, ответственная за поддержание общественного порядка и предотвращение преступности.

example: The police arrived quickly at the scene of the accident to manage traffic.
You should call the police immediately if you witness a crime or emergency.
The police officer helped the lost child find his parents at the crowded park.

quiz.correct_answer: The civil force of a state responsible for maintaining public order and preventing crime.

en: A group of people who enjoy playing sports professionally as a team.
A building used for large public meetings and important civic events.
A team of doctors and nurses working together in a hospital or clinic.
uz: Professional sport bilan jamoa bo'lib shug'ullanadigan odamlar guruhi.
Katta jamoat yig'ilishlari va muhim fuqarolik tadbirlari uchun ishlatiladigan bino.
Kasallxona yoki klinikada birga ishlaydigan shifokorlar va hamshiralar jamoasi.
ru: Группа людей, которые любят профессионально заниматься спортом в команде.
Здание, используемое для крупных публичных собраний и важных гражданских мероприятий.
Команда врачей и медсестер, работающих вместе в больнице или клинике.

translation.en: The system of courts, legal institutions, and procedures that administer justice in a country.
translation.uz: Mamlakatda adliya boshqaruvi bilan shug'ullanadigan sudlar, huquqiy muassasalar va tartiblar tizimi.
translation.ru: Система судов, правовых институтов и процедур, которые отправляют правосудие в стране.

example: The justice system aims to ensure fairness and equality for everyone in society.
Many people believe in reforming the justice system to make it more equitable.
Understanding the justice system can be complex for newcomers to a country.

quiz.correct_answer: The system of courts, legal institutions, and procedures that administer justice in a country.

en: A system for managing public transportation and road networks efficiently.
The network of social services and welfare programs provided by the government.
A set of rules and regulations for competitive sports leagues and tournaments.
uz: Jamoat transporti va yo'l tarmoqlarini samarali boshqarish tizimi.
Hukumat tomonidan taqdim etiladigan ijtimoiy xizmatlar va farovonlik dasturlari tarmog'i.
Raqobatbardosh sport ligalari va turnirlari uchun qoidalar va nizomlar to'plami.
ru: Система управления общественным транспортом и дорожными сетями эффективно.
Сеть социальных услуг и программ социального обеспечения, предоставляемых правительством.
Набор правил и положений для соревновательных спортивных лиг и турниров.

translation.en: To seize (someone) by legal authority and take them into custody, often for a crime.
translation.uz: Qonuniy vakolat bilan (kimnidir) qo'lga olish va hibsga olish, ko'pincha jinoyat uchun.
translation.ru: Задержать (кого-либо) по законному праву и взять под стражу, часто за преступление.

example: The police made an arrest in connection with the recent bank robbery.
He was arrested for speeding excessively on the highway after a long chase.
An arrest warrant was issued for the suspect after new evidence emerged.

quiz.correct_answer: To seize (someone) by legal authority and take them into custody, often for a crime.

en: To give someone a formal warning about their inappropriate behavior or actions.
To offer someone a job position or a new employment opportunity.
To release someone from prison or custody after serving their sentence.
uz: Kimnidir noto'g'ri xatti-harakatlari yoki harakatlari haqida rasmiy ogohlantirish berish.
Kimnidir ishga taklif qilish yoki yangi ish imkoniyatini taklif qilish.
Kimnidir jazosini o'taganidan keyin qamoqdan yoki hibsxonalardan ozod qilish.
ru: Вынести кому-либо официальное предупреждение о неподобающем поведении или действиях.
Предложить кому-либо должность или новую возможность трудоустройства.
Освободить кого-либо из тюрьмы или под стражи после отбытия срока.

translation.en: The system of rules that a particular country or community recognizes as regulating the actions of its members.
translation.uz: Ma'lum bir mamlakat yoki jamiyat o'z a'zolarining harakatlarini tartibga soluvchi qoidalar tizimi.
translation.ru: Система правил, которую определенная страна или сообщество признает регулирующей действия своих членов.

example: Ignorance of the law is no excuse for breaking it, according to legal principles.
New laws were recently passed to protect the environment and wildlife habitats.
It is strictly against the law to drive without a valid license in this country.

quiz.correct_answer: The system of rules that a particular country or community recognizes as regulating the actions of its members.

en: A traditional story passed down through generations, often with a moral lesson.
A mathematical equation used in science to explain natural phenomena.
A set of general guidelines for healthy eating and physical fitness.
uz: Avloddan-avlodga o'tgan an'anaviy hikoya, ko'pincha axloqiy saboq bilan.
Tabiiy hodisalarni tushuntirish uchun fanda ishlatiladigan matematik tenglama.
Sog'lom ovqatlanish va jismoniy tayyorgarlik uchun umumiy ko'rsatmalar to'plami.
ru: Традиционная история, передаваемая из поколения в поколение, часто с моральным уроком.
Математическое уравнение, используемое в науке для объяснения природных явлений.
Набор общих рекомендаций по здоровому питанию и физической подготовке.

translation.en: A person harmed, injured, or killed as a result of a crime, accident, or other event.
translation.uz: Jinoyat, baxtsiz hodisa yoki boshqa voqea natijasida zarar ko'rgan, jarohat olgan yoki o'ldirilgan shaxs.
translation.ru: Человек, пострадавший, раненый или убитый в результате преступления, несчастного случая или другого события.

example: The victim of the robbery reported the incident to the police immediately.
Support is offered to victims of domestic violence through various organizations.
He was a victim of a terrible car accident, but fortunately, he recovered fully.

quiz.correct_answer: A person harmed, injured, or killed as a result of a crime, accident, or other event.

en: A person who actively helps others in need or provides assistance.
Someone who commits a serious offense or violates legal regulations.
A person who merely witnessed an event but was not directly involved in it.
uz: Muhtojlarga faol yordam beradigan yoki yordam ko'rsatadigan shaxs.
Jiddiy huquqbuzarlik qilgan yoki qonuniy qoidalarni buzgan shaxs.
Voqeani faqatgina guvohi bo'lgan, ammo bevosita ishtirok etmagan shaxs.
ru: Человек, который активно помогает нуждающимся или оказывает помощь.
Тот, кто совершает серьезное правонарушение или нарушает правовые нормы.
Человек, который лишь был свидетелем события, но не участвовал в нем напрямую.

translation.en: The infliction or imposition of a penalty as retribution for an offense, aiming to deter future wrongs.
translation.uz: Huquqbuzarlik uchun jazoni qo'llash yoki belgilash, kelajakdagi xatoliklarni oldini olishga qaratilgan.
translation.ru: Наложение или назначение наказания в качестве возмездия за правонарушение, призванное предотвратить будущие нарушения.

example: The punishment for the crime was a heavy fine and community service.
They debated the appropriate punishment for the young offender in court.
He received a severe punishment for repeatedly breaking the school rules.

quiz.correct_answer: The infliction or imposition of a penalty as retribution for an offense, aiming to deter future wrongs.

en: An act of forgiving someone for their mistakes or misdeeds entirely.
A reward given for good behavior or achieving a significant accomplishment.
A process of learning new skills and acquiring knowledge through education.
uz: Kimnidir xatolari yoki noto'g'ri ishlari uchun to'liq kechirish harakati.
Yaxshi xulq-atvor yoki muhim yutuq uchun beriladigan mukofot.
Ta'lim orqali yangi ko'nikmalarni o'rganish va bilim olish jarayoni.
ru: Акт полного прощения кого-либо за его ошибки или проступки.
Награда за хорошее поведение или достижение значительного успеха.
Процесс изучения новых навыков и приобретения знаний через образование.

translation.en: A judicial assembly for the administration of justice, or the building where legal cases are heard.
translation.uz: Adliya boshqaruvi uchun sud majlisi yoki huquqiy ishlar ko'rib chiqiladigan bino.
translation.ru: Судебное собрание для отправления правосудия, или здание, где рассматриваются судебные дела.

example: The case will be heard in court next month before a judge and jury.
She was summoned to appear in court as a witness for the prosecution.
The court ruled in favor of the defendant after reviewing all the evidence.

quiz.correct_answer: A judicial assembly for the administration of justice, or the building where legal cases are heard.

en: A place where sports games like tennis or basketball are played regularly.
A large open area or courtyard found in a public building or school.
A building where historical artifacts and art are displayed for public viewing.
uz: Tennis yoki basketbol kabi sport o'yinlari muntazam ravishda o'ynaladigan joy.
Jamoat binosi yoki maktabda joylashgan katta ochiq maydon yoki hovli.
Tarixiy artefaktlar va san'at asarlari jamoat e'tiboriga havola etiladigan bino.
ru: Место, где регулярно играют в спортивные игры, такие как теннис или баскетбол.
Большая открытая площадка или двор, расположенный в общественном здании или школе.
Здание, где исторические артефакты и произведения искусства выставлены для публичного просмотра.

translation.en: A public official appointed to decide cases in a court of law.
translation.uz: Sudda ishlarni hal qilish uchun tayinlangan davlat amaldori.
translation.ru: Государственное должностное лицо, назначенное для рассмотрения дел в суде.

example: The judge listened carefully to both sides before making a decision.
It is the judge's role to ensure a fair trial for everyone involved.
The judge gave the defendant a lighter sentence because of his good conduct.

quiz.correct_answer: A public official appointed to decide cases in a court of law.

en: A person who provides legal advice to clients outside of court.
Someone who reports news events for a television station.
An expert who studies ancient languages and texts.
uz: Suddan tashqarida mijozlarga huquqiy maslahatlar beruvchi shaxs.
Televidenie stansiyasi uchun yangiliklarni xabar qiluvchi shaxs.
Qadimgi tillar va matnlarni o'rganuvchi mutaxassis.
ru: Лицо, оказывающее юридические консультации клиентам вне суда.
Кто-то, кто сообщает новости для телевизионной станции.
Эксперт, изучающий древние языки и тексты.

translation.en: Responsible for a specified wrongdoing, especially a criminal offense.
translation.uz: Belgilangan noto'g'ri ish uchun javobgar, ayniqsa jinoiy huquqbuzarlik.
translation.ru: Ответственный за указанное правонарушение, особенно за уголовное преступление.

example: The jury found the defendant guilty after reviewing all the evidence.
He felt guilty about breaking his promise to his friend.
She pleaded not guilty to the charges brought against her in court.

quiz.correct_answer: Responsible for a specified wrongdoing, especially a criminal offense.

en: Feeling very happy and satisfied with one's accomplishments.
Being completely innocent of any wrongdoing or fault.
Having a strong desire for something or someone.
uz: O'z yutuqlaridan juda xursand va mamnun bo'lish.
Har qanday noto'g'ri ish yoki aybsizlikdan butunlay xoli bo'lish.
Nimadir yoki kimnidir kuchli istakka ega bo'lish.
ru: Чувство очень счастливым и удовлетворенным своими достижениями.
Быть полностью невиновным в каком-либо правонарушении или ошибке.
Иметь сильное желание чего-то или кого-то.

translation.en: Not guilty of a crime or offense; free from moral wrong.
translation.uz: Jinoyat yoki huquqbuzarlikda aybdor emas; axloqiy nuqsonlardan xoli.
translation.ru: Невиновный в преступлении или правонарушении; свободный от морального зла.

example: The jury declared him innocent after hearing all the arguments.
She maintains her innocence despite the accusations against her.
It is important that an innocent person is not wrongly convicted.

quiz.correct_answer: Not guilty of a crime or offense; free from moral wrong.

en: Completely responsible for a wrongdoing or illegal act.
Having a great deal of experience in legal matters.
Showing strong emotions like anger or frustration.
uz: Noto'g'ri ish yoki noqonuniy harakat uchun to'liq javobgar bo'lish.
Huquqiy masalalarda katta tajribaga ega bo'lish.
G'azab yoki umidsizlik kabi kuchli his-tuyg'ularni namoyon etish.
ru: Полностью ответственный за правонарушение или незаконное действие.
Обладающий большим опытом в юридических вопросах.
Проявляющий сильные эмоции, такие как гнев или разочарование.

translation.en: A person who sees an event, typically a crime or accident, take place.
translation.uz: Odatda jinoyat yoki baxtsiz hodisa kabi voqeani sodir bo'lganini ko'rgan shaxs.
translation.ru: Человек, который видит происходящее событие, обычно преступление или несчастный случай.

example: The police asked for any witnesses to the car accident.
She was called to testify as a witness in the trial.
A key witness provided crucial information to the investigators.

quiz.correct_answer: A person who sees an event, typically a crime or accident, take place.

en: A person who plans and organizes large public events.
Someone who designs and builds structures or machines.
An individual who analyzes financial data for companies.
uz: Katta jamoat tadbirlarini rejalashtiradigan va tashkil etadigan shaxs.
Tuzilmalar yoki mashinalarni loyihalashtiradigan va quradigan shaxs.
Kompaniyalar uchun moliyaviy ma'lumotlarni tahlil qiluvchi shaxs.
ru: Человек, который планирует и организует крупные публичные мероприятия.
Тот, кто проектирует и строит сооружения или машины.
Человек, который анализирует финансовые данные для компаний.

translation.en: The available body of facts or information indicating whether a belief or proposition is true or valid.
translation.uz: E'tiqod yoki taklifning haqiqiy yoki asosli ekanligini ko'rsatadigan mavjud faktlar yoki ma'lumotlar to'plami.
translation.ru: Имеющаяся совокупность фактов или информации, указывающая на то, является ли убеждение или утверждение истинным или обоснованным.

example: The police collected all the evidence from the crime scene.
There wasn't enough evidence to prove his guilt in court.
Scientific evidence supports the claim that the Earth is warming.

quiz.correct_answer: The available body of facts or information indicating whether a belief or proposition is true or valid.

en: A strong emotional feeling or personal opinion about something.
A spoken agreement or promise made between two or more people.
A hypothetical scenario used to illustrate a complex concept.
uz: Biror narsa haqida kuchli hissiy tuyg'u yoki shaxsiy fikr.
Ikki yoki undan ortiq odam o'rtasida og'zaki kelishuv yoki va'da.
Murakkab tushunchani tasvirlash uchun ishlatiladigan gipotetik stsenariy.
ru: Сильное эмоциональное чувство или личное мнение о чем-либо.
Устное соглашение или обещание, данное двумя или более людьми.
Гипотетический сценарий, используемый для иллюстрации сложной концепции.

translation.en: A punishment assigned to a defendant found guilty by a court, typically imprisonment.
translation.uz: Sud tomonidan aybdor deb topilgan javobgarga tayinlangan jazo, odatda qamoq jazosi.
translation.ru: Наказание, назначенное ответчику, признанному виновным судом, обычно тюремное заключение.

example: The judge will hand down the sentence next week after careful consideration.
He received a harsh sentence for the serious nature of his crime.
The convicted person appealed against the length of their prison sentence.

quiz.correct_answer: A punishment assigned to a defendant found guilty by a court, typically imprisonment.

en: A formal request made to a higher authority for a review of a decision.
A grammatical structure consisting of words that form a complete thought.
A legal document that outlines the charges against a defendant clearly.
uz: Yuqori organga qarorni ko'rib chiqish uchun qilingan rasmiy so'rov.
To'liq fikrni tashkil etuvchi so'zlardan iborat grammatik tuzilma.
Ayblanuvchiga qo'yilgan ayblovlarni aniq bayon etuvchi yuridik hujjat.
ru: Официальный запрос, направленный в вышестоящий орган для пересмотра решения.
Грамматическая структура, состоящая из слов, образующих законченную мысль.
Юридический документ, четко излагающий обвинения против ответчика.

translation.en: A person thought to be guilty of a crime or offense.
translation.uz: Jinoyat yoki huquqbuzarlikda aybdor deb hisoblangan shaxs.
translation.ru: Человек, которого считают виновным в преступлении или правонарушении.

example: The police identified a suspect based on eyewitness accounts.
They questioned the suspect for several hours at the police station.
The main suspect in the case has a strong alibi for the time of the crime.

quiz.correct_answer: A person thought to be guilty of a crime or offense.

en: A person who provides useful information to the authorities.
Someone who is completely innocent of any wrongdoing.
An experienced detective working on a complex case.
uz: Hukumatlarga foydali ma'lumot beruvchi shaxs.
Hech qanday noto'g'ri ish qilmagan butunlay aybsiz shaxs.
Murakkab ish ustida ishlaydigan tajribali detektiv.
ru: Человек, который предоставляет полезную информацию властям.
Тот, кто полностью невиновен в каком-либо правонарушении.
Опытный детектив, работающий над сложным делом.

translation.en: A sum of money exacted as a penalty for an offense or misdemeanor.
translation.uz: Huquqbuzarlik yoki noto'g'ri xatti-harakat uchun jazo sifatida undiriladigan pul miqdori.
translation.ru: Сумма денег, взимаемая в качестве штрафа за правонарушение или проступок.

example: He had to pay a large fine for parking illegally downtown.
The court imposed a heavy fine on the company for pollution.
Driving without a seatbelt can result in a significant fine.

quiz.correct_answer: A sum of money exacted as a penalty for an offense or misdemeanor.

en: A small amount of money given as a reward for good service.
A type of bank loan with a low interest rate.
A financial investment that offers high returns over time.
uz: Yaxshi xizmat uchun mukofot sifatida beriladigan oz miqdorda pul.
Past foiz stavkasi bo'lgan bank krediti turi.
Vaqt o'tishi bilan yuqori daromad keltiradigan moliyaviy investitsiya.
ru: Небольшая сумма денег, выдаваемая в качестве вознаграждения за хорошую службу.
Вид банковского кредита с низкой процентной ставкой.
Финансовая инвестиция, которая приносит высокую прибыль со временем.

translation.en: A formal discussion on a particular topic, often with opposing views.
translation.uz: Munozara
translation.ru: Дебаты

example: The candidates will participate in a televised debate tonight.
There's a lot of public debate about climate change.
The committee held a lengthy debate on the proposed changes.

quiz.correct_answer: A formal discussion on a particular topic, often with opposing views.

en: A casual conversation among friends about daily life.
A lecture given by an expert to inform an audience.
A presentation of facts without any opposing viewpoints.
uz: Do'stlar orasida kundalik hayot haqida oddiy suhbat.
Mutaxassis tomonidan auditoriyani xabardor qilish uchun o'tkazilgan ma'ruza.
Hech qanday qarama-qarshi fikrlarsiz faktlarning taqdimoti.
ru: Непринужденная беседа друзей о повседневной жизни.
Лекция, прочитанная экспертом для информирования аудитории.
Представление фактов без каких-либо противоположных точек зрения.

translation.en: A reason or set of reasons given to persuade others.
translation.uz: Dalil
translation.ru: Аргумент

example: He presented a strong argument for his position.
The lawyer's argument was very convincing.
We had a heated argument about who should pay.

quiz.correct_answer: A reason or set of reasons given to persuade others.

en: A simple statement of personal preference or taste.
A sudden emotional outburst without logical reasoning.
A factual report detailing historical events accurately.
uz: Shaxsiy imtiyoz yoki did haqida oddiy bayonot.
Mantiqiy asoslanmasdan to'satdan hissiy portlash.
Tarixiy voqealarni aniq bayon etuvchi faktik hisobot.
ru: Простое утверждение личных предпочтений или вкуса.
Внезапный эмоциональный всплеск без логического обоснования.
Фактический отчет с точным описанием исторических событий.

translation.en: To give help or approval to someone or something.
translation.uz: Qo'llab-quvvatlamoq
translation.ru: Поддерживать

example: I fully support your decision to pursue further education.
Many people support the idea of stricter environmental laws.
He offered to support her in her new business venture.

quiz.correct_answer: To give help or approval to someone or something.

en: To actively oppose or work against a particular cause.
To ignore or remain neutral regarding a situation.
To criticize or find fault with an idea or person.
uz: Muayyan sababga faol qarshilik ko'rsatish yoki unga qarshi ishlash.
Vaziyatga e'tibor bermaslik yoki betaraf qolish.
G'oyani yoki shaxsni tanqid qilish yoki kamchiliklarini topish.
ru: Активно выступать против или работать против определенной цели.
Игнорировать или оставаться нейтральным в отношении ситуации.
Критиковать или находить недостатки в идее или человеке.

translation.en: A particular attitude or way of considering a matter.
translation.uz: Nuqtai nazar
translation.ru: Точка зрения

example: From my viewpoint, the project is progressing well.
It's important to consider different viewpoints.
She explained her viewpoint clearly and concisely.

quiz.correct_answer: A particular attitude or way of considering a matter.

en: A specific historical event or significant moment in time.
A scientific experiment conducted in a controlled environment.
A universally accepted truth that cannot be disputed.
uz: Muayyan tarixiy voqea yoki vaqtdagi muhim lahza.
Nazorat ostidagi muhitda o'tkazilgan ilmiy tajriba.
Munozara qilib bo'lmaydigan, umume'tirof etilgan haqiqat.
ru: Конкретное историческое событие или значимый момент времени.
Научный эксперимент, проведенный в контролируемой среде.
Универсально признанная истина, которая не может быть оспорена.

translation.en: A particular way of seeing something, influenced by experience.
translation.uz: Istiqbol
translation.ru: Перспектива

example: Try to see the situation from her perspective.
His travels gave him a new perspective on life.
We need to get a broader perspective on the issue.

quiz.correct_answer: A particular way of seeing something, influenced by experience.

en: A rigid and unchanging set of rules or regulations.
A sudden change in direction or a new unexpected path.
A scientific theory that has been proven incorrect.
uz: Qattiq va o'zgarmas qoidalar yoki qonunlar to'plami.
Yo'nalishning to'satdan o'zgarishi yoki yangi kutilmagan yo'l.
Noto'g'ri ekanligi isbotlangan ilmiy nazariya.
ru: Жесткий и неизменный набор правил или положений.
Внезапное изменение направления или новый неожиданный путь.
Научная теория, которая оказалась неверной.

translation.en: To make someone believe or feel sure about something.
translation.uz: Ishontirmoq
translation.ru: Убеждать

example: I couldn't convince him that I was right.
Her sincerity convinced me of her good intentions.
How can we convince them to change their minds?

quiz.correct_answer: To make someone believe or feel sure about something.

en: To openly challenge a person's authority or position.
To express doubt about the truth of a statement.
To force someone to do something against their will.
uz: Shaxsning hokimiyatini yoki mavqeini ochiqchasiga shubha ostiga qo'yish.
Bayonotning haqiqatiga shubha bildirish.
Kimnidir o'z xohishiga qarshi biror narsa qilishga majburlash.
ru: Открыто оспаривать чьи-либо авторитет или положение.
Выражать сомнение в истинности утверждения.
Заставлять кого-либо делать что-либо против его воли.

translation.en: Relating to people in general, rather than to private matters.
translation.uz: Jamoat
translation.ru: Общественный

example: The public wants to know the truth.
It's a matter of public interest.
Public opinion can greatly influence political decisions.

quiz.correct_answer: Relating to people in general, rather than to private matters.

en: Pertaining exclusively to one's own personal affairs.
Concerning only a small, exclusive group of individuals.
Hidden from view and known only to a select few.
uz: Faqat shaxsiy ishlarga tegishli.
Faqat kichik, eksklyuziv guruhga tegishli.
Yashirin va faqat tanlanganlarga ma'lum.
ru: Относящийся исключительно к личным делам.
Касающийся только небольшой, исключительной группы лиц.
Скрытый от посторонних глаз и известный лишь избранным.

translation.en: The common or widespread belief or feeling of people.
translation.uz: Umumiy fikr
translation.ru: Общее мнение

example: The general opinion is that the new law will be effective.
Despite some opposition, the general opinion favored the project.
We need to understand the general opinion of the community.

quiz.correct_answer: The common or widespread belief or feeling of people.

en: A highly specialized viewpoint held by a few experts.
A secret agreement made between two influential parties.
A baseless rumor spread quickly through a small town.
uz: Bir nechta mutaxassislar tomonidan bildirilgan yuqori ixtisoslashgan nuqtai nazar.
Ikki nufuzli tomon o'rtasida tuzilgan yashirin kelishuv.
Kichik shaharchada tez tarqalgan asossiz mish-mish.
ru: Узкоспециализированная точка зрения, которой придерживаются немногие эксперты.
Тайное соглашение, заключенное между двумя влиятельными сторонами.
Беспочвенный слух, быстро распространяющийся по маленькому городку.

translation.en: Shared ideas or interests that people can agree on.
translation.uz: Umumiy til
translation.ru: Общая почва

example: Despite their differences, they found common ground on environmental issues.
Finding common ground is essential for successful negotiations.
They struggled to find common ground to resolve the dispute.

quiz.correct_answer: Shared ideas or interests that people can agree on.

en: A point of intense disagreement between opposing parties.
A unique perspective held by only one individual.
A hidden agenda known only to a secret society.
uz: Qarama-qarshi tomonlar o'rtasidagi keskin kelishmovchilik nuqtasi.
Faqat bir shaxs tomonidan bildirilgan noyob nuqtai nazar.
Yashirin jamiyatga ma'lum bo'lgan yashirin kun tartibi.
ru: Точка сильного разногласия между противоборствующими сторонами.
Уникальная точка зрения, которой придерживается только один человек.
Скрытая повестка дня, известная только тайному обществу.

translation.en: To express a strong opinion on something.
translation.uz: Pozitsiya bildirmoq
translation.ru: Занять позицию

example: It's time to take a stand against injustice.
The organization decided to take a firm stand on human rights.
She felt it was important to take a stand on the issue.

quiz.correct_answer: To express a strong opinion on something.

en: To remain completely neutral and avoid any involvement.
To change one's opinion frequently and without reason.
To secretly support an idea without public declaration.
uz: Butunlay betaraf qolish va har qanday ishtirokdan qochish.
Fikrni tez-tez va sababsiz o'zgartirish.
G'oyani ommaga e'lon qilmasdan yashirincha qo'llab-quvvatlash.
ru: Оставаться полностью нейтральным и избегать любого участия.
Часто и без причины менять свое мнение.
Тайно поддерживать идею без публичного заявления.

translation.en: A survey of public opinion.
translation.uz: So'rovnoma
translation.ru: Опрос

example: The latest poll shows a slight increase in support for the ruling party.
They conducted a poll to gauge public sentiment on the new policy.
According to a recent poll, most people prefer working from home.

quiz.correct_answer: A survey of public opinion.

en: A formal debate between political candidates.
A detailed historical record of past events.
A legal document outlining specific rules and regulations.
uz: Siyosiy nomzodlar o'rtasidagi rasmiy munozara.
O'tmishdagi voqealarning batafsil tarixiy yozuvi.
Muayyan qoidalar va qoidalarni belgilaydigan yuridik hujjat.
ru: Официальные дебаты между политическими кандидатами.
Подробный исторический отчет о прошлых событиях.
Юридический документ, содержащий конкретные правила и положения.

translation.en: Giving rise or likely to give rise to public disagreement.
translation.uz: Munozarali
translation.ru: Спорный

example: The new tax proposal is highly controversial.
He made a controversial statement that sparked a lot of debate.
It's a controversial topic, so be careful how you discuss it.

quiz.correct_answer: Giving rise or likely to give rise to public disagreement.

en: Widely accepted as true and causing no disagreement.
Providing clear and unambiguous instructions.
Unlikely to cause any strong reactions or discussions.
uz: Haqiqat deb keng qabul qilingan va kelishmovchilikka sabab bo'lmaydigan.
Aniq va tushunarli ko'rsatmalar berish.
Kuchli reaksiyalar yoki munozaralarga sabab bo'lish ehtimoli kam.
ru: Широко признанный как истинный и не вызывающий разногласий.
Предоставление четких и недвусмысленных инструкций.
Вряд ли вызовет какие-либо сильные реакции или дискуссии.

translation.en: A series of actions to achieve a specific goal, often political.
translation.uz: Kampaniya
translation.ru: Кампания

example: The environmental group launched a campaign to protect the forest.
He is running a strong campaign for mayor.
The advertising campaign successfully boosted sales.

quiz.correct_answer: A series of actions to achieve a specific goal, often political.

en: A casual gathering of friends for social interaction.
A single, isolated event without a larger objective.
A secret mission carried out by a small, unknown group.
uz: Ijtimoiy o'zaro aloqa uchun do'stlar yig'ilishi.
Kattaroq maqsadsiz yagona, izolyatsiya qilingan voqea.
Kichik, noma'lum guruh tomonidan amalga oshirilgan maxfiy missiya.
ru: Неформальная встреча друзей для социального взаимодействия.
