uz: Mamlakat hukumati tomonidan savdoni tartibga solish uchun qabul qilingan qonun.
Bir davlatning boshqasiga qarshi e'lon qilgan urush deklaratsiyasi.
Potentsial bosqinchilarga qarshi harbiy mudofaa rejasi.
ru: Закон, принятый правительством страны для регулирования торговли.
Объявление войны одной нацией против другой.
План военной обороны от потенциальных захватчиков.

translation.en: A country or area controlled politically by a more powerful country.
translation.uz: Kuchliroq davlat tomonidan siyosiy jihatdan boshqariladigan mamlakat yoki hudud.
translation.ru: Страна или территория, политически контролируемая более могущественной страной.

example: India was once a British colony.
Many European powers established colonies in Africa.
The settlers founded a new colony in the distant land.

quiz.correct_answer: A country or area controlled politically by a more powerful country.

en: An independent nation with its own elected government.
A small, isolated community in a remote area.
A piece of land purchased by one country from another.
uz: O'z saylangan hukumati bo'lgan mustaqil davlat.
Uzoq hududda joylashgan kichik, ajratilgan jamoa.
Bir mamlakat tomonidan boshqasidan sotib olingan yer maydoni.
ru: Независимая нация со своим избранным правительством.
Небольшое, изолированное сообщество в отдаленном районе.
Участок земли, купленный одной страной у другой.

translation.en: A formal agreement or union between countries for mutual benefit.
translation.uz: O'zaro manfaat uchun mamlakatlar o'rtasidagi rasmiy kelishuv yoki ittifoq.
translation.ru: Формальное соглашение или союз между странами для взаимной выгоды.

example: The two countries formed a military alliance.
Economic alliances can promote trade and cooperation.
Their long-standing alliance was tested during the crisis.

quiz.correct_answer: A formal agreement or union between countries for mutual benefit.

en: A competitive rivalry between two opposing nations.
A declaration of independence by a newly formed state.
A system of direct popular vote on important national issues.
uz: Ikki qarama-qarshi davlat o'rtasidagi raqobat.
Yangi tashkil topgan davlat tomonidan mustaqillik deklaratsiyasi.
Muhim milliy masalalar bo'yicha to'g'ridan-to'g'ri xalq ovozi tizimi.
ru: Конкурентное соперничество между двумя противоборствующими нациями.
Декларация независимости вновь образованного государства.
Система прямого народного голосования по важным национальным вопросам.

translation.en: A succession of rulers from the same family or line.
translation.uz: Bir xil oila yoki avloddan bo'lgan hukmdorlarning ketma-ketligi.
translation.ru: Последовательность правителей из одной семьи или линии.

example: The Ming Dynasty ruled China for centuries.
Many ancient civilizations were governed by dynasties.
The new dynasty brought significant changes to the kingdom.

quiz.correct_answer: A succession of rulers from the same family or line.

en: A political party that holds power for only a short period.
A group of religious leaders who govern a spiritual community.
A series of elected officials who serve consecutive terms.
uz: Qisqa muddatga hokimiyatda bo'lgan siyosiy partiya.
Ruhiy jamoani boshqaradigan diniy rahbarlar guruhi.
Ketma-ket muddatlarda xizmat qiladigan saylangan amaldorlar qatori.
ru: Политическая партия, находящаяся у власти лишь короткое время.
Группа религиозных лидеров, управляющих духовной общиной.
Ряд избранных должностных лиц, которые занимают последовательные сроки.

translation.en: The movement of people from one place to another to settle.
translation.uz: Odamlarning bir joydan boshqa joyga joylashish uchun harakatlanishi.
translation.ru: Перемещение людей из одного места в другое для поселения.

example: Historical records show patterns of human migration.
Economic opportunities often lead to large-scale migration.
The great migration significantly altered the region's demographics.

quiz.correct_answer: The movement of people from one place to another to settle.

en: The process of establishing a new trade route between countries.
The exchange of goods and services within a local community.
The development of new technologies for faster transportation.
uz: Mamlakatlar o'rtasida yangi savdo yo'lini o'rnatish jarayoni.
Mahalliy jamiyat ichida tovarlar va xizmatlar almashinuvi.
Tezroq transport uchun yangi texnologiyalarni ishlab chiqish.
ru: Процесс создания нового торгового пути между странами.
Обмен товарами и услугами внутри местного сообщества.
Разработка новых технологий для более быстрой транспортировки.

translation.en: An advanced stage of human society with complex culture.
translation.uz: Murakkab madaniyatga ega inson jamiyatining ilg'or bosqichi.
translation.ru: Продвинутая стадия человеческого общества со сложной культурой.

example: Ancient Egyptian civilization was highly advanced.
The collapse of a major civilization can have lasting effects.
Archaeologists study the remains of ancient civilizations.

quiz.correct_answer: An advanced stage of human society with complex culture.

en: A small, isolated community that lives off the land.
A nomadic group of people who travel constantly.
A simple social structure without organized government.
uz: Yerdan foydalanib yashovchi kichik, ajratilgan jamoa.
Doimiy sayohat qiluvchi ko'chmanchi odamlar guruhi.
Uyushgan hukumatga ega bo'lmagan oddiy ijtimoiy tuzilma.
ru: Маленькое, изолированное сообщество, живущее за счет земли.
Кочевая группа людей, постоянно путешествующих.
Простая социальная структура без организованного правительства.

translation.en: The act of finding something that was previously unknown.
translation.uz: Ilgari noma'lum bo'lgan narsani topish harakati.
translation.ru: Акт нахождения чего-либо ранее неизвестного.

example: The discovery of America changed world history.
New archaeological discoveries are always exciting.
His scientific discovery led to a medical breakthrough.

quiz.correct_answer: The act of finding something that was previously unknown.

en: The process of losing something valuable accidentally.
The act of forgetting important information or facts.
The process of selling goods in a large market.
uz: Tasodifan qimmatli narsani yo'qotish jarayoni.
Muhim ma'lumot yoki faktlarni unutish harakati.
Katta bozorda tovarlarni sotish jarayoni.
ru: Процесс случайной потери чего-либо ценного.
Акт забывания важной информации или фактов.
Процесс продажи товаров на большом рынке.

translation.en: An act of entering a country or region with an army to take control.
translation.uz: Mamlakat yoki mintaqaga nazoratni egallash uchun armiya bilan kirish harakati.
translation.ru: Акт вторжения в страну или регион с армией для захвата контроля.

example: The country prepared for a possible invasion.
Historical records describe various invasions and their impacts.
The unexpected invasion caught the kingdom off guard.

quiz.correct_answer: An act of entering a country or region with an army to take control.

en: A peaceful diplomatic discussion between two nations.
The withdrawal of troops from a disputed territory.
The development of new defensive military technologies.
uz: Ikki davlat o'rtasidagi tinch diplomatik muhokama.
Bahsli hududdan qo'shinlarni olib chiqish.
Yangi mudofaa harbiy texnologiyalarini ishlab chiqish.
ru: Мирная дипломатическая дискуссия между двумя нациями.
Вывод войск со спорной территории.
Развитие новых оборонительных военных технологий.

translation.en: An act of open, organized resistance to an established government or ruler.
translation.uz: O'rnatilgan hukumat yoki hukmdorga ochiq, uyushgan qarshilik ko'rsatish harakati.
translation.ru: Акт открытого, организованного сопротивления установленному правительству или правителю.

example: The rebellion was eventually crushed by the army.
Many historical figures led rebellions against injustice.
The students staged a peaceful rebellion against the new rules.

quiz.correct_answer: An act of open, organized resistance to an established government or ruler.

en: The act of supporting a political leader wholeheartedly.
A negotiation process to resolve a conflict peacefully.
The creation of new laws to strengthen the government's power.
uz: Siyosiy rahbarini chin dildan qo'llab-quvvatlash harakati.
Mojaroni tinch yo'l bilan hal qilish uchun muzokaralar jarayoni.
Hukumat hokimiyatini mustahkamlash uchun yangi qonunlarni yaratish.
ru: Действие по безоговорочной поддержке политического лидера.
Процесс переговоров для мирного разрешения конфликта.
Создание новых законов для укрепления власти правительства.

translation.en: A social system in medieval Europe where land was exchanged for service.
translation.uz: O'rta asr Yevropasida yer xizmat evaziga almashilgan ijtimoiy tizim.
translation.ru: Социальная система в средневековой Европе, где земля обменивалась на службу.

example: Feudalism dominated society during the Middle Ages.
Under feudalism, lords controlled vast territories.
The decline of feudalism led to the rise of new social structures.

quiz.correct_answer: A social system in medieval Europe where land was exchanged for service.

en: An economic system based on free markets and private ownership.
A political theory advocating for communal ownership of property.
A system of government where power is held by the people.
uz: Erkin bozorlar va xususiy mulkchilikka asoslangan iqtisodiy tizim.
Mulkni jamoaviy egalik qilishni targ'ib qiluvchi siyosiy nazariya.
Hokimiyat xalq qo'lida bo'lgan hukumat tizimi.
ru: Экономическая система, основанная на свободных рынках и частной собственности.
Политическая теория, выступающая за общественную собственность на имущество.
Система правления, где власть принадлежит народу.

translation.en: A period of European cultural, artistic, political, and economic 'rebirth' after the Middle Ages.
translation.uz: O'rta asrlardan keyin Yevropa madaniy, badiiy, siyosiy va iqtisodiy 'qayta tug'ilish' davri.
translation.ru: Период европейского культурного, художественного, политического и экономического «возрождения» после Средневековья.

example: The Renaissance brought about a flourishing of art and science.
Many famous artists lived during the Renaissance period.
Florence was a key center of the Italian Renaissance.

quiz.correct_answer: A period of European cultural, artistic, political, and economic 'rebirth' after the Middle Ages.

en: A time of great conflict and widespread warfare across continents.
A rapid decline in art and culture due to economic hardship.
The early stages of industrial development and factory growth.
uz: Qit'alar bo'ylab katta mojarolar va keng miqyosli urushlar davri.
Iqtisodiy qiyinchiliklar tufayli san'at va madaniyatning tez pasayishi.
Sanoat rivojlanishining va zavod o'sishining dastlabki bosqichlari.
ru: Время больших конфликтов и широкомасштабных войн на континентах.
Быстрый упадок искусства и культуры из-за экономических трудностей.
Ранние стадии промышленного развития и роста фабрик.

translation.en: The act of taking control of a country or group of people by force.
translation.uz: Davlat yoki odamlar guruhini kuch bilan nazorat qilish harakati.
translation.ru: Акт захвата контроля над страной или группой людей силой.

example: The Norman Conquest changed England significantly.
Throughout history, empires expanded through conquest.
The small village resisted the army's conquest attempts.

quiz.correct_answer: The act of taking control of a country or group of people by force.

en: The process of establishing diplomatic relations with other nations.
The peaceful negotiation of a new border agreement.
The cultural exchange between different civilizations.
uz: Boshqa davlatlar bilan diplomatik aloqalar o'rnatish jarayoni.
Yangi chegara kelishuvini tinch yo'l bilan muzokaralar olib borish.
Turli sivilizatsiyalar o'rtasidagi madaniy almashinuv.
ru: Процесс установления дипломатических отношений с другими нациями.
Мирные переговоры о новом пограничном соглашении.
Культурный обмен между различными цивилизациями.

translation.en: A place where people establish a community; the process of settling.
translation.uz: Odamlar jamoa tashkil etadigan joy; joylashish jarayoni.
translation.ru: Место, где люди основывают общину; процесс заселения.

example: The first European settlement in the area was small.
Archaeologists found evidence of an ancient settlement.
The new settlement grew rapidly over the years.

quiz.correct_answer: A place where people establish a community; the process of settling.

en: A type of military fortification designed for defense.
A natural disaster that causes widespread destruction.
A legal document that outlines terms of an agreement.
uz: Mudofaa uchun mo'ljallangan harbiy istehkom turi.
Keng tarqalgan vayronagarchilikka olib keladigan tabiiy ofat.
Kelishuv shartlarini belgilaydigan yuridik hujjat.
ru: Тип военного укрепления, предназначенного для обороны.
Стихийное бедствие, вызывающее широкомасштабные разрушения.
Юридический документ, определяющий условия соглашения.

translation.en: A traditional story or myth from the past, often believed to be true.
translation.uz: O'tmishdagi an'anaviy hikoya yoki afsona, ko'pincha rost deb hisoblanadi.
translation.ru: Традиционная история или миф из прошлого, часто считающийся правдой.

example: The legend of King Arthur is very popular.
Many cultures have local legends about their origins.
The old man told fascinating legends about the hidden treasure.

quiz.correct_answer: A traditional story or myth from the past, often believed to be true.

en: A scientific theory based on extensive research and evidence.
A factual news report detailing recent events.
A historical document containing verifiable facts and figures.
uz: Keng qamrovli tadqiqotlar va dalillarga asoslangan ilmiy nazariya.
So'nggi voqealarni batafsil bayon etuvchi faktik yangiliklar hisoboti.
Tekshirilishi mumkin bo'lgan faktlar va raqamlarni o'z ichiga olgan tarixiy hujjat.
ru: Научная теория, основанная на обширных исследованиях и доказательствах.
Фактический новостной репортаж, подробно описывающий недавние события.
Исторический документ, содержащий проверяемые факты и цифры.

translation.en: A three-dimensional work of art, often made by carving or molding.
translation.uz: Uch o'lchovli san'at asari, ko'pincha o'yib yoki qoliplash orqali yasalgan.
translation.ru: Трехмерное произведение искусства, часто создаваемое путем резьбы или лепки.

example: The museum has an impressive collection of modern sculpture.
He is learning how to create sculptures from clay.
The artist is famous for his bronze sculptures.

quiz.correct_answer: A three-dimensional work of art, often made by carving or molding.

en: A painting created using various colors on a flat surface.
A musical composition played by a large orchestra.
A type of literature focused on storytelling and character development.
uz: Yassi yuzaga turli ranglar yordamida yaratilgan rasm.
Katta orkestr tomonidan ijro etiladigan musiqiy kompozitsiya.
Hikoya qilish va xarakter rivojlanishiga qaratilgan adabiyot turi.
ru: Картина, созданная с использованием различных цветов на плоской поверхности.
Музыкальное произведение, исполняемое большим оркестром.
Вид литературы, ориентированный на рассказывание историй и развитие персонажей.

translation.en: Skills involved in making things by hand, often artistic.
translation.uz: Narsalarni qo'lda yasashda ishtirok etadigan ko'nikmalar, ko'pincha badiiy.
translation.ru: Навыки, связанные с изготовлением вещей вручную, часто художественные.

example: Local crafts are popular souvenirs for tourists.
She enjoys various crafts like knitting and pottery.
The fair showcased handmade crafts from different regions.

quiz.correct_answer: Skills involved in making things by hand, often artistic.

en: Advanced techniques used in scientific research.
Methods of preparing food in a professional kitchen.
Digital processes for creating computer graphics and animations.
uz: Ilmiy tadqiqotlarda qo'llaniladigan ilg'or texnikalar.
Professional oshxonada ovqat tayyorlash usullari.
Kompyuter grafikasi va animatsiyalarini yaratish uchun raqamli jarayonlar.
ru: Передовые методы, используемые в научных исследованиях.
Способы приготовления пищи на профессиональной кухне.
Цифровые процессы для создания компьютерной графики и анимации.

translation.en: A room or building for the display or sale of works of art.
translation.uz: San'at asarlarini namoyish qilish yoki sotish uchun xona yoki bino.
translation.ru: Комната или здание для демонстрации или продажи произведений искусства.

example: The new art gallery opened last month.
They visited a small gallery in the old town.
Many artists dream of having their work displayed in a gallery.

quiz.correct_answer: A room or building for the display or sale of works of art.

en: A large public library with a vast collection of books.
A concert hall designed for musical performances.
A historical archive preserving ancient documents and records.
uz: Katta kitoblar to'plamiga ega yirik jamoat kutubxonasi.
Musiqiy ijrolar uchun mo'ljallangan konsert zali.
Qadimgi hujjatlar va yozuvlarni saqlovchi tarixiy arxiv.
ru: Большая публичная библиотека с обширной коллекцией книг.
Концертный зал, предназначенный для музыкальных выступлений.
Исторический архив, хранящий древние документы и записи.

translation.en: A public display of works of art or other items.
translation.uz: San'at asarlari yoki boshqa buyumlarning ommaviy namoyishi.
translation.ru: Публичная демонстрация произведений искусства или других предметов.

example: The museum is currently hosting an exhibition of ancient artifacts.
Her photographs were part of a new exhibition downtown.
Attending art exhibitions is a great way to experience culture.

quiz.correct_answer: A public display of works of art or other items.

en: A formal debate competition between different teams.
A theatrical performance with actors on a stage.
A scientific experiment conducted in a specialized laboratory.
uz: Turli jamoalar o'rtasidagi rasmiy munozara musobaqasi.
Sahnada aktyorlar ishtirokidagi teatr tomoshasi.
Ixtisoslashgan laboratoriyada o'tkazilgan ilmiy tajriba.
ru: Формальные дебаты между различными командами.
Театральное представление с актерами на сцене.
Научный эксперимент, проводимый в специализированной лаборатории.

translation.en: The activity of making pots, dishes, and other objects from clay.
translation.uz: Loydan idishlar, plastinkalar va boshqa narsalarni yasash faoliyati.
translation.ru: Деятельность по изготовлению горшков, посуды и других предметов из глины.

example: She took a class to learn how to do pottery.
Ancient civilizations are known for their intricate pottery.
Many people find making pottery to be very relaxing.

quiz.correct_answer: The activity of making pots, dishes, and other objects from clay.

en: The process of creating jewelry from precious metals and gems.
The technique of weaving textiles using a traditional loom.
The skill of designing and constructing buildings.
uz: Qimmatbaho metallar va toshlardan zargarlik buyumlari yasash jarayoni.
An'anaviy dastgoh yordamida to'qimachilik mahsulotlarini to'qish texnikasi.
Binolarni loyihalash va qurish ko'nikmasi.
ru: Процесс создания ювелирных изделий из драгоценных металлов и камней.
Техника ткачества текстиля с использованием традиционного ткацкого станка.
Навык проектирования и строительства зданий.

translation.en: Any type of woven fabric or cloth.
translation.uz: Har qanday turdagi to'qilgan mato yoki kiyim.
translation.ru: Любой тип тканого материала или ткани.

example: The museum had an exhibit of ancient textiles.
She uses natural dyes to color her handmade textiles.
The fashion industry relies heavily on new textile innovations.

quiz.correct_answer: Any type of woven fabric or cloth.

en: A type of material used in building construction.
A musical instrument with a series of keys and strings.
A method of preserving food for long periods of time.
uz: Qurilishda ishlatiladigan material turi.
Klavishlar va torlar qatoriga ega musiqa asbobi.
Oziq-ovqat mahsulotlarini uzoq vaqt davomida saqlash usuli.
ru: Тип материала, используемого в строительстве.
Музыкальный инструмент с серией клавиш и струн.
Метод консервации продуктов питания на длительный срок.

translation.en: A work of outstanding artistry, skill, or workmanship.
translation.uz: Yuqori badiiy, mohirlik yoki mahoratga ega bo'lgan asar.
translation.ru: Произведение выдающегося художественного мастерства, навыка или исполнения.

example: The Mona Lisa is considered a true masterpiece.
The architect's latest building is a modern masterpiece.
It took years to complete this musical masterpiece.

quiz.correct_answer: A work of outstanding artistry, skill, or workmanship.

en: A quick sketch or rough draft of an artwork idea.
A short piece of writing with a simple plot or theme.
A scientific experiment that yielded unexpected results.
uz: San'at asari g'oyasining tezkor eskizi yoki qoralamasi.
Oddiy syujet yoki mavzuga ega qisqa yozma asar.
Kutilmagan natijalarni bergan ilmiy tajriba.
ru: Быстрый эскиз или черновик идеи произведения искусства.
Короткое литературное произведение с простым сюжетом или темой.
Научный эксперимент, давший неожиданные результаты.

translation.en: A particular method of doing something, especially in art.
translation.uz: Biror narsani, ayniqsa san'atda, bajarishning o'ziga xos usuli.
translation.ru: Определенный метод выполнения чего-либо, особенно в искусстве.

example: He has developed a unique painting technique.
Mastering this artistic technique takes years of practice.
The pottery class teaches various shaping techniques.

quiz.correct_answer: A particular method of doing something, especially in art.

en: A type of material used for creating sculptures.
A famous work of art exhibited in a museum.
A specific genre of music or literary work.
uz: Haykallar yaratish uchun ishlatiladigan material turi.
Muzeyda namoyish etilgan mashhur san'at asari.
Musiqiy yoki adabiy asarning o'ziga xos janri.
ru: Тип материала, используемого для создания скульптур.
Известное произведение искусства, выставленное в музее.
Конкретный жанр музыки или литературного произведения.

translation.en: A rough or unfinished drawing or painting.
translation.uz: Qo'pol yoki tugallanmagan rasm yoki surat.
translation.ru: Грубый или незаконченный рисунок или картина.

example: He quickly made a sketch of the landscape.
Artists often start with a basic sketch.
The architect presented a preliminary sketch of the building.

quiz.correct_answer: A rough or unfinished drawing or painting.

en: A completely finished and detailed artwork ready for display.
A complex mathematical formula used in engineering projects.
A long written essay providing in-depth analysis of a topic.
uz: Namoyishga tayyor, to'liq tugallangan va batafsil san'at asari.
Muhandislik loyihalarida qo'llaniladigan murakkab matematik formula.
Mavzuning chuqur tahlilini taqdim etuvchi uzun yozma insho.
ru: Полностью законченное и детализированное произведение искусства, готовое к показу.
Сложная математическая формула, используемая в инженерных проектах.
Длинное письменное эссе, содержащее углубленный анализ темы.

translation.en: The art of cutting or shaping wood, stone, or other materials.
translation.uz: Yog'och, tosh yoki boshqa materiallarni kesish yoki shakllantirish san'ati.
translation.ru: Искусство резки или придания формы дереву, камню или другим материалам.

example: The intricate wood carving showed great skill.
He specializes in stone carving.
Ancient cultures were known for their detailed carvings.

quiz.correct_answer: The art of cutting or shaping wood, stone, or other materials.

en: The process of applying colors to a flat surface with brushes.
The technique of melting metal to create new shapes.
The method of joining pieces of fabric together by sewing.
uz: Cho'tkalar yordamida yassi yuzaga ranglarni qo'llash jarayoni.
Yangi shakllar yaratish uchun metallni eritish texnikasi.
Mato bo'laklarini tikish orqali birlashtirish usuli.
ru: Процесс нанесения красок на плоскую поверхность кистями.
Техника плавления металла для создания новых форм.
Метод соединения кусков ткани путем шитья.

translation.en: A distinctive and recurring design, pattern, or theme in art.
translation.uz: San'atda o'ziga xos va takrorlanuvchi dizayn, naqsh yoki mavzu.
translation.ru: Отличительный и повторяющийся дизайн, узор или тема в искусстве.

example: The artist often uses floral motifs in her work.
This ancient pottery features a common animal motif.
The same musical motif appears several times in the symphony.

quiz.correct_answer: A distinctive and recurring design, pattern, or theme in art.

en: A specific type of brush used for painting fine details.
A historical document that certifies the authenticity of an artwork.
A type of frame used to protect and display artworks.
uz: Nozik detallarni bo'yash uchun ishlatiladigan o'ziga xos cho'tka turi.
San'at asarining haqiqiyligini tasdiqlovchi tarixiy hujjat.
San'at asarlarini himoya qilish va namoyish qilish uchun ishlatiladigan ramka turi.
ru: Особый тип кисти, используемый для прорисовки мелких деталей.
Исторический документ, подтверждающий подлинность произведения искусства.
Тип рамы, используемой для защиты и демонстрации произведений искусства.

translation.en: A machine or device for weaving thread or yarn into fabric.
translation.uz: Ip yoki junni matoga to'qish uchun mashina yoki qurilma.
translation.ru: Машина или устройство для ткачества нитей или пряжи в ткань.

example: Traditional rugs are often made on a hand loom.
She learned to operate a loom at the craft center.
The textile factory uses large industrial looms.

quiz.correct_answer: A machine or device for weaving thread or yarn into fabric.

en: A tool used for shaping clay in pottery making.
A special paint used for creating abstract art.
A type of camera designed for professional photography.
uz: Kulolchilikda loyni shakllantirish uchun ishlatiladigan asbob.
Abstrakt san'at yaratish uchun ishlatiladigan maxsus bo'yoq.
Professional fotografiya uchun mo'ljallangan kamera turi.
ru: Инструмент, используемый для придания формы глине в гончарном деле.
Специальная краска, используемая для создания абстрактного искусства.
Тип камеры, предназначенный для профессиональной фотографии.

translation.en: A picture or pattern produced by arranging together small pieces of colored stone, glass, or other material.
translation.uz: Rangli tosh, shisha yoki boshqa materiallarning kichik bo'laklarini bir joyga yig'ish orqali yaratilgan rasm yoki naqsh.
translation.ru: Картина или узор, созданный путем расположения вместе мелких кусочков цветного камня, стекла или другого материала.

example: The floor of the ancient villa was covered in beautiful mosaics.
She created a mosaic on her garden wall.
Byzantine art is famous for its intricate mosaics.

quiz.correct_answer: A picture or pattern produced by arranging together small pieces of colored stone, glass, or other material.

en: A type of large painting on a single canvas with bold colors.
A technique for creating sculptures from a solid block of marble.
A method of printmaking using carved woodblocks to transfer ink.
uz: Jasur ranglar bilan bitta kanvasga ishlangan katta rasm turi.
Marmar blokdan haykallar yaratish texnikasi.
Siyohni o'tkazish uchun o'yib ishlangan yog'och bloklardan foydalanadigan bosma nashr usuli.
ru: Тип большой картины на одном холсте с яркими цветами.
Техника создания скульптур из цельного блока мрамора.
Метод гравюры с использованием резных деревянных блоков для переноса чернил.

translation.en: Art objects, such as pottery, made from clay and hardened by heat.
translation.uz: Loydan yasalgan va issiqlik bilan qattiqlashtirilgan san'at buyumlari, masalan, kulolchilik.
translation.ru: Художественные объекты, такие как гончарные изделия, сделанные из глины и затвердевшие при нагревании.

example: The course covers various aspects of ceramics.
Her studio is filled with beautiful ceramic pieces.
Ancient cultures produced functional and decorative ceramics.

quiz.correct_answer: Art objects, such as pottery, made from clay and hardened by heat.

en: Musical instruments made primarily from wood and strings.
Textile products woven from natural fibers like cotton or wool.
Paintings created using oil-based pigments on a canvas surface.
uz: Asosan yog'och va torlardan yasalgan musiqa asboblari.
Paxta yoki jundan kabi tabiiy tolalardan to'qilgan to'qimachilik mahsulotlari.
Kanvas yuzasida yog'li pigmentlar yordamida yaratilgan rasmlar.
ru: Музыкальные инструменты, сделанные преимущественно из дерева и струн.
Текстильные изделия, сотканные из натуральных волокон, таких как хлопок или шерсть.
Картины, созданные с использованием пигментов на масляной основе на холсте.

translation.en: Decorative handwriting or handwritten lettering.
translation.uz: Dekorativ qo'lyozma yoki qo'lda yozilgan harflar.
translation.ru: Декоративное рукописное письмо или написанные от руки буквы.

example: She practices Japanese calligraphy every day.
His wedding invitations were written in beautiful calligraphy.
Calligraphy is considered a high art form in many cultures.

quiz.correct_answer: Decorative handwriting or handwritten lettering.

en: The process of creating digital art using computer software.
The technique of capturing images with a camera lens.
A method of playing a musical instrument with great skill.
uz: Kompyuter dasturlari yordamida raqamli san'at yaratish jarayoni.
Kamera linzasi bilan tasvirlarni olish texnikasi.
Musiqa asbobini katta mahorat bilan chalish usuli.
ru: Процесс создания цифрового искусства с использованием компьютерного программного обеспечения.
Техника съемки изображений с помощью объектива камеры.
Метод игры на музыкальном инструменте с большим мастерством.

translation.en: The art of decorating fabric or other materials with needle and thread.
translation.uz: Mato yoki boshqa materiallarni igna va ip bilan bezash san'ati.
translation.ru: Искусство украшения ткани или других материалов иглой и нитью.

example: The traditional dress features intricate embroidery.
She enjoys doing embroidery in her free time.
Hand embroidery adds a personal touch to clothing.

quiz.correct_answer: The art of decorating fabric or other materials with needle and thread.

en: The process of painting large murals on public walls.
The technique of shaping metal with a hammer and anvil.
The creation of sculptures from blocks of solid stone.
uz: Jamoat devorlariga katta devoriy rasmlar chizish jarayoni.
Metallni bolg'a va anjirdan foydalanib shakllantirish texnikasi.
Qattiq tosh bloklaridan haykallar yaratish.
ru: Процесс рисования больших фресок на общественных стенах.
Техника придания формы металлу молотом и наковальней.
Создание скульптур из цельных каменных блоков.

translation.en: The Japanese art of folding paper into decorative shapes and figures.
translation.uz: Yaponlarning qog'ozni dekorativ shakllar va figuralarga buklash san'ati.
translation.ru: Японское искусство складывания бумаги в декоративные формы и фигуры.

example: She taught me how to make an origami crane.
Origami requires patience and precision.
Children often learn simple origami figures at school.

quiz.correct_answer: The Japanese art of folding paper into decorative shapes and figures.

en: A type of traditional Japanese music played on string instruments.
A method of painting using watercolors on rice paper.
A traditional Japanese dance performed during festivals.
uz: Torli asboblarda ijro etiladigan an'anaviy yapon musiqasi turi.
Guruch qog'oziga akvarel bilan rasm chizish usuli.
Festivallar paytida ijro etiladigan an'anaviy yapon raqsi.
ru: Вид традиционной японской музыки, исполняемой на струнных инструментах.
Метод рисования акварелью на рисовой бумаге.
Традиционный японский танец, исполняемый во время фестивалей.

translation.en: A piece of art made by sticking various materials onto a surface.
translation.uz: Turli materiallarni bir yuzaga yopishtirish orqali yasalgan san'at asari.
translation.ru: Произведение искусства, созданное путем наклеивания различных материалов на поверхность.

example: The artist created a collage using old newspaper clippings.
Children often make collages with magazines and glue.
Her latest art project is a multimedia collage.

quiz.correct_answer: A piece of art made by sticking various materials onto a surface.

en: A photograph taken with a wide-angle lens for broad perspective.
A type of sculpture carved from a single block of wood.
A detailed drawing created with precise lines and shading.
uz: Keng burchakli linza bilan olingan keng ko'lamli fotosurat.
Bir bo'lak yog'ochdan o'yilgan haykal turi.
Aniqlik chiziqlari va soyalash bilan yaratilgan batafsil rasm.
ru: Фотография, сделанная широкоугольным объективом для широкой перспективы.
Тип скульптуры, вырезанной из цельного куска дерева.
Детальный рисунок, созданный точными линиями и штриховкой.
